assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

combat.control_effects_v1: A content owner may request a finite control effect after a connected delivered hit. The anonymous dummy's authored control_immune flag defaults false and is independent of Boss classification, airborne inputs and damage magnitude. A living source can control a living nonimmune recipient; a defeated source/target or immune recipient produces no successful-control receipt or status. Positive exact hits that round to zero HP loss still reach after-hit control, distinct from positive-HP-loss consumers. Successful applications preserve source actor, actual target and parent command, record exact world-time duration/expiry and apply one target-scoped status. Control represents gameplay eligibility only, without movement, geometry or target AI. Source death does not erase an already applied finite target effect. Native immunity and after-hit ordering remain explicit scenario/owner hypotheses.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

fireflies.all_in_range_v1: Under the all-in-range dummy contract the source's "nearby enemy" condition is a declared scenario rule: every eligible scenario-declared dummy is nearby by definition, so no position, radius, shape or placement check gates the trigger on a connected Anima hit. Defeated dummies never produce connected hits and keep their existing skip rules; the source must be living. This is not a claim about native proximity radius or recipient selection; native trigger consumer behavior remains unresolved.

fireflies.team_anima_hit_v1: A connected, nonzero elemental Anima packet from any living team member grants one independent Fireflies CRIT DMG stack to each living team member wearing Fireflies, including off-field wearers. A wearer does not grant an extra stack merely for being the source; each wearer receives exactly one stack per packet.

gear.cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Ultimate admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Weapon and set effects retain their own recipient, stacking and expiry policies. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis; native animation timing remains unresolved.

iroi.action_clock_v1: Iroi ordinary Normal uses the selected rate-one montage coordinates rounded once to microseconds, with exact next-Basic boundaries and distinct Skill/movement/other gates. Positive normal contacts add one33000us actor pause at rate.1 per causal projectile, delayed33000us for stages4/5; a zero-duration stage3 rate supplies no pause. Normal1/2 select one living locked recipient per projectile with deterministic fallback; stages3/4/5 cover all living eligible stationary dummies. Stage3 spawns one finite world actor at268779us progress, first contact200000us later then100000us spacing for eight contacts; launched actors survive caster progression/field exit, while unborn montage notifies cancel. Owner death prevents future actor ticks. Resource channels remain per causal packet, and live stats are sampled at impact. Continuing stages require the exact native queued Basic boundary; an idle input restarts stage1. This is a selected source-coordinate/contact inference, not measured playback. Canonical tap Skill uses montage cooldown249777us, heal/carrier498799us, Gun birth498827us with1200000us travel, Syringe birth551115us with seven100000us-spaced world contacts, and Trumpet birth601775us. Connected Skill actors add100000us player pauses at rate.1 once per causal packet, including on a replacement player montage; overlapping windows use minimum rate and never delay world ticks. Skill cooldown is12 World seconds from its notify, or3 seconds from interruption before that notify. Actual healing grants16 Moon once outside Dream and the self-excluded capped flat-ATK buff; normal healing callbacks retain live stats and passives. The tiny Skill carrier grants its sourced10 Charge once per effect application to an eligible living target, even when fractional damage rounds to zero integer HP loss; this disclosed rounding interpretation uses the ordinary exact carry/team ledger without fake HP or double grants. Other packets require positive HP loss. Explicit interruption removes unborn notifications and preserves launched actors and committed cooldowns. Selected A2 Skill diagnoses until its native assist exists. Native Burst reserves Moon at input, heals at1925956us, emits its Ivory-only direct packet at3385389us, installs pulses at3882835us and releases Dream drain/periods at4004747us montage progress; switch gate3764482us differs from4015812us ordinary recovery. Its real16s cooldown never follows montage pause. Setup projections shift only this owner reservation and pending Dream deadlines. Interrupted setup before any carrier retains unspent Moon without a Dream; after installation, actual cancellation releases only installed carriers with their full remaining Moon lifetime. These are explicit interruption/lifecycle inferences. Native pulses retain the actual Burst command/talent and reach all eligible living stationary dummies, with no inferred recipient cap. Existing Dream threshold, strict-before-end periods and death/generation invalidation remain authoritative. Held Branch/Transform, Lucid Dream, A2 assists, secondary and Regression interactions remain concrete dependencies before source selection.

iroi.live_atk_healing_v1: Iroi ordinary Skill and the currently bound one-time Burst healing scale their frozen 13-level .943/1.413 starting coefficients from live source final ATK, superseding the historical MaxHP model. The accepted owner card's recovered GetAtk calculator owns this stat choice; the native coefficients are unchanged. Read compiled source ATK plus base-scaled live ATK percentages and flat buffs, including applicable equipped passive stats, at each real recipient callback without creating a damage packet or applying damage/crit/target modifiers. Apply source outgoing and recipient incoming healing bonuses, including selected A3 exactly once, then round gross once and clamp to missing HP. Each living recipient gets its actual settlement and positive gross, including overheal, may trigger compatible equipment. Dead sources and recipients do not heal or trigger listeners. Effective admitted talent coordinates are preserved. Skill's existing callback-at-admission and Burst's existing post-impact callback timing remain explicitly bounded caller models; native montage dispatch, QTE/A2 healing, Dream periodic healing, Moon gains and application-level B4/A5 dispatch remain separate queued bindings. This does not certify a complete Iroi kit.

iroi.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Iroi character:1075 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Iroi NATURE are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

mint.ordinary_clock_v1: Mint canonical ordinary Normal, Skill and Burst use the selected rate-one source montage coordinates rounded once to nearest microseconds, not measured game playback. Explicit positive contact pauses integrate actor-local slowdown at rate.01, once per causal packet across stationary dummy recipients; missing durations and zero HP loss add none. All living eligible dummies receive each selected ordinary packet, without geometry. Native Normal stages retain2/1/2/1/2 packets, reset only on a greater-than2s input-start gap or a different ability/field exit, and keep the existing resource callbacks. Skill has two distinct contacts, starts its real6s cooldown at182791us progress and takes3s cancel cooldown only if interrupted before that notify; Burst keeps seven distinct contacts and its admitted real cooldown/energy cost. Pending montage deliveries and unborn notifications cancel on replacement, field exit or defeat, preserving settled damage, resources, passives and continuing cooldowns; live remaining contact pause carries into a replacement. Entry and explicitly selected approach replace Normal1 and advance to2. A new admitted Jump opens one declared plunge flight; landing has no implicit geometry. Paid Front/Back Dodge uses owner-specific Jump, Skill and movement gates; explicit successful parry requests Back after20000us without another payment or a damage packet. Critical Dodge grants one replacement Riposte opportunity. Engine-qualified switching alone invokes the739424us Support contact, with a delayed400000us actor pause at rate.2 and separate1333238us switch/1366703us recovery gates. Unqualified entry arms only the next Basic, and no-op self switches do not reset it. Canonical held Normal additionally uses mint.hold_attack_v1. Native source initializes the owner clock before entry and submits approach, Jump/declared landing, paid controls and family windows to these same native gates; its Burst cooldown is15 World seconds. The frozen scheduled Studio adapter retains its separate caller-timing scope until Phase4. The selected source timing and cancellation policies remain revisable hypotheses.

owner.action_role.character_1046_skill_v1: Classify this exact Zero action as Skill because the frozen character action identity names its normal skill and the effect-config row is absent; owner role is an explicit model hypothesis.

owner.action_role.character_1046_ultimate_v1: Classify this exact Zero action as UltraSkill because the frozen character action identity names its ultimate and the effect-config row is absent; owner role is an explicit model hypothesis.

owner.action_role.character_1075_qte_v1: Classify this exact frozen character action as QTE because its DT_CharacterAbilityConfig identity names the owner action as QTE while DT_CharacterAbilityEffectConfig has no row; this role is an owner-reviewed model hypothesis for this ability only.

sakiri.burst_atk_v1: Current GA_Sagiri_UltraSkill activation independently requests ordinary Buff_Sagiri003_QDamUp and, only with node4, Buff_Sagiri003_Level4_1. Each adds30percent of the source GetAtkBase to other living teammates for20 World seconds, with no self grant. The separate cap1 carriers refresh rather than stack. Base includes compiled character and equipped weapon base ATK, excluding console flat/percent and recipient ATK. The selected managed snapshot lifetime survives source defeat; dead recipients receive no new grant and existing dead carriers contribute nothing. Actual admitted activation produces the grants, without hit or damage requirements. This explicit lifetime/recipient model does not simulate multiplayer global-component routing.

sakiri.normal_chain_v1: Sakiri Normal advances five stages per admitted input: native Melee1; Melee2+3; Melee8+4; Melee5 three times; Melee6+7. Frozen neverness_sagiri descriptions and DT_SkillDamageData coefficients agree on all nine released talent levels. The chain loops after stage five and resets on a different admitted ability, field exit or a gap greater than 2 seconds between input starts. Reset rules and the gap are tested hypotheses pending animation/cancel evidence. Each stage's packets deliver in order at the research primary impact time; travel, AoE, plunge, riposte and complete kit behavior remain unsupported.

sakiri.skill_burst_packets_v1: Sakiri Devour Whole delivers Skill1 and Skill2 once each on target zero; Feast of Gluttony delivers UltraSkill1 five times and UltraSkill2 once. All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, eating mode or complete kit behavior.

sakiri.suppress_v1: Sakiri's first connected Ultimate packet per admitted input and actual recipient attempts the source-bound Suppress effect once. Child pulses and other recipients retain their causal command identity; switching does not rearm an earlier attempt. Suppress lasts 3 World seconds, or 6 with selected A1, using Sagiri_Suppress and Sagiri_lv1_Suppress. Only successful control applies the Impish Trick child DEF reduction: one shared target instance subtracts 10 percent of authored base DEF for 20 seconds, independently of the shorter control lifetime. If base_def is omitted, authored total DEF is also the assumed base; an explicit base 1000/total 1500 yields 1400, not 1350. The reduction refreshes at the next successful control and clamps effective DEF at zero. These choices bind the recovered SKILL_EVENT_AFTER_HIT -> suppress object -> control marker and DEF-child chain, not every damage input or mere preexisting airborne state. Native control immunity, hybrid-server routing, exact application/capture clocks and passive unlock dispatch remain unverified; the reviewed baseline enables the passive. Other floating/Skill control and A5 transitions retain their separate owner limits.

weapons.good_boy_v3: Good Boy retains the once-compiled additive Charge Efficiency from v2 and its admitted-Ultimate shared team ATK window. A successful control receipt produced by that wearer's same admitted Ultimate upgrades the single active named window from its frozen base ATK ratio to base plus the frozen 6/7/8/9/10 percent refinement ratio. The extra ratio latches once per cast across recipients and survives the control status ending; it lasts only the remainder of the original 20-second world-time deadline. It never stacks per target, refreshes on repeated hit/control callbacks, or extends from control time. Expired windows, stale commands and an older wearer's control after another wearer replaced the shared snapshot cannot upgrade it. Ordinary Ultimate damage, mere airborne state, Boss metadata, other actors and non-Ultimate control are insufficient; the engine's actual successful-control receipt is required. This supersedes v2's missing-control-consumer limit under the explicit combat.control_effects_v1 model, currently produced by Sakiri Suppress. Native conditional capture, original application ordering and cross-wearer priority remain tested product assumptions. Legacy explicit TeamAtk-only procs default their omitted control ratio to zero; native projectors bind it at every refinement.

zero.a1_first_hit_v1: Zero A1 triggers on the first nonzero connected Skill hit per admitted activation and target, only when target level <= Zero level. Prefer the explicit Chinese not-above-level condition over the English lower-level translation; child packets cannot retrigger and retain the struck target.

zero.burst_all_in_range_v1: Zero Burst delivers its ordered seven-packet train to every eligible scenario-declared dummy under the all-in-range dummy contract: by scenario definition all eligible dummies are in range and inside attack areas, so no position, radius, shape, or placement check gates delivery. Targets are delivered in ascending target_index order; for each target, UltraSkill1, UltraSkill2 four times, UltraSkill3, then UltraSkill4 (target-major order), all at the admitted primary impact time. Defeated or otherwise ineligible dummies keep their existing skip rules. This is a declared scenario rule, not a claim about native AoE geometry; native recipient caps/selection/distribution and packet spacing remain unresolved.

zero.burst_packets_v1: Zero Burst delivers native UltraSkill1 once, UltraSkill2 four times, UltraSkill3 once, and UltraSkill4 once, in that order, matching DT_GameplayAbilityTipsData.GA_Female046_UltraSkill.GALevelUpArray[0] and each native DT_SkillDamageData row. All seven packets use the admitted primary impact time and target 0, the simulator's current default target. Native packet intervals remain unresolved.

Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Zero COSMOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. zero.skill_packets_v1: Zero ordinary Skill delivers Skill1, Skill2, Skill3, and Skill4 once each from one admitted cast, matching the four ordered ratios in frozen neverness_zero and native DT_SkillDamageData rows. The admitted Skill fills this owner's Cycle pool to its existing capacity of 100 once, including semantic Hotori replay, independently of damage recipient count, ordinary energy and hit-generated channels. Existing charge is retained without duplicate grant or overflow. Cast-time fill is the selected interpretation of the published instant-Cycle Skill; native callback timing remains unverified. Children use the admitted primary impact time; animation intervals and travel are unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.single_packet_support_v1: Single-packet qualified Support actions use their owner packet, purchased QTE coordinate, recovered or documented bounded timing, and owner-local recovery gates. Living in-range dummy recipients share one packet's ordinary Charge and connected owner effects.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

hotori.katana_chain_v1: While Hotori's World's Tide Time Stop is active, an admitted Basic input selects the five-stage Q-category Katana chain instead of the ordinary Normal chain: stage1 delivers one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkillMelee1_Damage, stage2 one UltraSkillMelee2 plus one UltraSkillMelee2_1, stage3 three UltraSkillMelee3 plus one UltraSkillMelee3_1, stage4 one UltraSkillMelee4 plus UltraSkillMelee4_1..4_3, and stage5 one UltraSkillMelee5 plus one UltraSkillMelee5_1, all Cosmos with zero raw energy, Cycle and Break. Each admitted input increments the count marker once at its native marker time regardless of misses, up to exactly 10; inputs 1..10 select stages 1..5 twice and the count persists across both subchains. At exactly 10 the next Basic selects one finisher instead of a stage, does not increment the count, and ordinary legal inputs cannot reach 11. The finisher is one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkillMelee6_Damage, replaced by one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkillMelee6Pas2_Damage when breakthrough4 enables Passive2, and never both rows. Each input delivers its stage's local source hits at the selected real offsets to every eligible dummy under hotori.aoe_all_in_range_dummy_v1, with live talent and modifier sampling; inputs chain through the native queued-next windows, stage source pauses and Any recoveries, the finisher keeps its recovery in real time and ends the Time Stop benefits at its damage delivery. No Timepiece, stamina or conventional Ultimate Energy is paid per Katana input. Mode end or a new World's Tide resets the count, an already admitted stage may finish after expiry with live mode bonuses removed, no finisher is manufactured at count9 or on expiry, and after the mode the next Basic returns to ordinary Entry1. sets.diabolos_v2: An equipped Diabolos four-piece wearer ignores twelve Chaos resistance percentage points for its own Chaos packets. On a qualified engine Esper Cycle admission that produces Nova or Scorch, both living outgoing/incoming actors are participants independently of captured reaction ownership; each equipped wearer receives one self-only twenty-second window before Cycle spend and reaction production. During that window the frozen twenty-four-point ignore replaces the baseline twelve, rather than adding to it. Further eligible participation refreshes the nonstacking window; field exit preserves its world-clock deadline and exact expiry restores the baseline. Ineligible switches, same-actor swaps, other reactions, nonwearers and non-Chaos packets receive no powered benefit. Participant effects are prepared atomically before publishing buffs/receipts. This extends the switch-based reaction model and supersedes v1's unconditional-only implementation; native participation dispatch and clock fidelity remain unverified.

weapons.black_book_v1: Black Tome grants the wearer its frozen Break Intensity points unconditionally. The points join the break damage zone as 1 + BI/300 + break_bonus_sum; they do not enter gauge accumulation. Arc: Black Tome is sealed by two chains by default; each team Support Skill cast unleashes one chain. When fully unleashed, explicit Arc admission enters a 0.2-second startup. Successful startup summons the Black Tome for 20 seconds with no normal cooldown and reseals the Arc with two chains; an interruption during startup instead applies a 30-second cancellation cooldown and does not summon or reseal. A pending startup or live summon prevents overlapping activation. The summon designates an enemy at spawn and refreshes designation every 5 seconds, preferring living locked targets else lowest index. The wearer gains its frozen Chaos damage bonus against designated enemies. When a designated enemy takes Break damage while the summon is active, the wearer deals an immediate Chaos ATK hit. Switching preserves the summon; death during startup cancels it, while ticks and designation stop on wearer death and pending hits cancel postmortem. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.demon_blade_v1: Ravenous Blade adds its frozen Crit Rate ratio to the wearer's crit rate in the additive base-rate zone. Dealing Incantation DMG grants one wearer stack of Crit DMG through ProcCallback up to seven stacks, with a 0.3s trigger cooldown. Each trigger refreshes the group's duration to 15s, including at cap. Switching preserves stacks and cooldown; exact expiry precedes equal-time hits. Cooldown, stacking, and world-time clocks are tested hypotheses. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.good_boy_v3: Good Boy retains the once-compiled additive Charge Efficiency from v2 and its admitted-Ultimate shared team ATK window. A successful control receipt produced by that wearer's same admitted Ultimate upgrades the single active named window from its frozen base ATK ratio to base plus the frozen 6/7/8/9/10 percent refinement ratio. The extra ratio latches once per cast across recipients and survives the control status ending; it lasts only the remainder of the original 20-second world-time deadline. It never stacks per target, refreshes on repeated hit/control callbacks, or extends from control time. Expired windows, stale commands and an older wearer's control after another wearer replaced the shared snapshot cannot upgrade it. Ordinary Ultimate damage, mere airborne state, Boss metadata, other actors and non-Ultimate control are insufficient; the engine's actual successful-control receipt is required. This supersedes v2's missing-control-consumer limit under the explicit combat.control_effects_v1 model, currently produced by Sakiri Suppress. Native conditional capture, original application ordering and cross-wearer priority remain tested product assumptions. Legacy explicit TeamAtk-only procs default their omitted control ratio to zero; native projectors bind it at every refinement.

weapons.the_wrong_gate_healing_v1: The Wrong Gate's static ATK percentage applies to the wearer on every hit. An Edgar Ultimate or Iroi ordinary Skill healing callback triggers only when the living equipped wearer heals a living team actor and the once-rounded pre-cap amount is positive; a full-HP overheal qualifies. After settlement, one shared-name reset effect grants the wearer Anima (NATURE) DMG and every other living configured team actor general DMG for 20 world seconds. Repeated triggers refresh at callback time; source attribution is the latest trigger and buffs capture a snapshot that persists if its source later dies. Failed/dead-recipient callbacks and nonpositive rounded healing do not trigger. These trigger, recipient, clock, order, snapshot, and shared-name rules are tested hypotheses because the frozen descriptions do not specify them. Global release availability remains unverified.

zankou.form_modifiers_v1: Zankou Reality/Illusion Normal and held actions grant self Hunt25percent damage or team Delusion25percent DoT critical damage during the admitted owner action. Positive contact projection extends only that action component. A legally adjacent entry/return Skill carries its existing component through setup; successful entry retains Hunt for eight World seconds and successful Soulcross retains Delusion for eight World seconds. World retention never follows montage pauses. Rejected input grants nothing; cancellation discards its action component and A0 field exit discards both retained components. Selected A1 instead keeps living-source self Hunt40percent and team Delusion50percent permanent on and off field, without double counting or extending the source after defeat. This explicit finite action/retention lifecycle interprets the current class and published duration contracts; it is not a certified native ability-task executor.

zankou.forms_v1: Current rolling Zankou source selects Reality entry or Illusion return from live owner state. Skill has a real five-second admission cooldown; selected rate-one montage transitions commit at496507us entry and2039354us return, independently of HP loss. Illusion lasts eight World seconds, half open; enhanced Soulcross is earned during its final3500000us. Enhanced entry requires a current eligible Reality action section. Field exit discards form and permissions without restoring them on return. Pending montage contacts and transition/grant notifications cancel on replacement or interruption while committed costs, cooldowns and launched DoT trains continue. Natural expiry uses a generation guard and does not cancel an already admitted Soulcross. Source coordinates and finite transition interpretation are bounded models, not certified native playback.

zankou.normal_chain_v1: Zankou canonical Normal derives the current Reality five-stage2/1/3/5/6 or Illusion four-stage1/3/4/3 packet chain from live form. Exact native ATK coefficients retain A talent and Incantation scaling; Illusion direct Normal/held packets carry their source Follow-up tag. Source montage spacing, explicit contact pauses and action gates use zankou.forms_v1. Conservative ordinary continuation uses AnySkill recovery followed by a maximum two-second idle gap. A different admitted action, form transition, field exit or longer idle resets the chain. Current form Normal1/2 permits its held branch after at least200000us declared hold; Reality and Illusion branches retain four and five direct contacts. Reality Normal4/5 and held branch earn enhanced entry only inside their live Skill window. Positive HP resource channels are per causal packet, independent of recipient count. These finite timing, continuation and prerequisite interpretations are bounded source models, not measured playback.

zankou.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Zankou character:1036 only, a modeled ordinary Normal native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Zankou INCANTATION are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Skill, Burst, alternate forms, summons, DoT, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

blackbird.b2_nova_v1: Living breakthrough2 Blackbird captures baseATK per target Nova generation and accumulates actual positive applied HP loss during its half-open lifetime, excluding its triggering Support/QTE command and children, all ordinary Nova ticks and Blackbird settlement packets. At end, after pending shared damage, settle min(accumulatedHP/5,1000*capturedBaseATK) as fixed Mental HP damage unaffected by crit, DEF, RES or buffs, with no resources. The initial generation may create one fresh shared Nova with its own accumulator; that child cannot reapply. A new authored refresh takes precedence over the automatic child. Source defeat disables the extra/reapplication; target death cancels without postmortem settlement.

blackbird.coordinated_bird_v1: Ordinary Skill re-arms one Blackbird bird controller per cast generation, clears marks/count, starts ready at cast time and enforces an inclusive2s interval between accepted requests, with five accepted requests maximum. Each positive surviving Skill recipient refreshes its own15s mark without resetting the controller. Positive HP damage by a different currently active living ally to a live marked dummy accepts once per causal packet, selecting the first/lowest live marked recipient. Blackbird own/off-field/zero-HP/Nova/bird damage cannot request coordination. Dispatch one full uncapped native SkillAssist AoE after the causal packet HP/resource/Break settlement, using invested Skill talent, zero inferred travel, ordinary live stats and per-target RNG, one Charge/Cycle/Break opportunity across recipients. An accepted count is not refunded on target death. Recast cancels uncommitted old-generation requests; field exit preserves marks/count, owner death disables new requests. A6 positively connected birds grant4 exact Malice once outside form through the separate resource model. Autonomous receipts retain both the original Skill command and real earlier triggering hit without inventing an authored cast. Requires ordinary Malice; does not establish transformed action/form lifetimes.

blackbird.evolve_actions_v1: Bind Blackbird evolved abilities during active transformation form: GA_BlackBird_Evolve_Melee (5 stages delivering 2, 5, 6, 1, 6 primary packets with native progress and hit-pause .0297s, Melee5 .015s), GA_BlackBird_Evolve_Skill (4 packets, 1s cooldown, requiring and consuming the 30s permission granted by Melee5 at progress .351288s, healing 4x base ATK with A2, multiplied by 2.5 with A1), and GA_BlackBird_Evolve_UltraSkill (finishing Burst delivering 7 packets, removing form at commit, multiplied by 1.5 with R3). Each connected primary hit consuming Malice spends up to its native threshold (Melee1..5: .541591, .369949, .349951, 2.258020, .784891; Skill: 3.25) and enqueues one separate category A Extra packet at hit+.067s (Melee5 hit+.100s) with coefficient k*spent (k+k3 with A3, k reading Normal talent level). With A1 finisher first hit spends all remaining Malice (max 60) for one extra; without A1 finisher preserves Malice with no extra. Requires primary form and exact Malice models.

blackbird.ordinary_clock_v1: Bind ordinary Blackbird Normal1..5 and four-hit Skill to their native montage progress coordinates, rounded once to nearest microsecond, at rate1. Positive applied HP from each causal primary packet adds one .03s owner hit-pause at .01 rate, shared across AoE recipients; zero HP loss adds none. The shared exact HitlagTracker projects only pending montage contacts and owner recovery, retaining real cooldowns, marks, birds, buffs and other actors. Simultaneous recipients retain their already emitted packet time. Normal continuity extends through its actual full recovery and2 World seconds afterward, with stage wrap/reset on other actions or field exit. Ordinary Skill has16s real cooldown, independent of hit-pause; generic caller clocks remain the historical boundary when this model is absent. This bounded clock does not certify Burst/form replacement, transformed/secondary actions or early cancel gates, which retain their separately tracked owner admission dependencies.

blackbird.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Blackbird character:1042 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. blackbird.skill_burst_packets_v1: Blackbird Netherplume Rite delivers four Skill hits on target zero; Requies Animarum delivers nine UltraSkill hits. All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, Evolve forms, Malice gauge or complete kit behavior.

blackbird.skill_cycle_fill_v1: An admitted ordinary Blackbird Skill executes its Skill.2 HeterochromeExecution once at activation, filling the owner's Cycle pool to100 before any damage even when all packets miss. Grant only the missing whole amount, independent of Cycle gain efficiency, preserve exact fractional carry and prior overflow/spend accounting, and keep Ultimate Energy unchanged. character.zankou.crimson_reverie_v1: Zankou Crimson Reverie sets her living owner's Cycle pool to exactly one hundred once at scenario combat entry, replacing the authored starting value without adding Ultimate Energy. Field returns, waits and continuing cycles never repeat that initialization. One permanent nonstacking self modifier adds one hundred Cycle Intensity stat points to Zankou on or off field; teammates receive none. It composes with her authored and equipped CI before live/captured reaction consumers. An initially defeated owner receives no entry Cycle. Current player Passive2 configuration and its self carrier establish the recipient correction from the earlier team-aura shortcut. The thirty-second entry cooldown has no second combat entry to govern in this single-combat model.

character.zankou.dot_packet_semantics_v1: Treat the exact Zankou GE_Player_Zankou_DotDamage and GE_Player_Zankou_DotUltraDamage packet rows as DoT damage sources carrying State.Damage, State.Damage.Dot, and State.Damage.Melee. This maps the researched serialized periodic-effect source tags; it does not model stack application, target spreading, or periodic scheduling.

character.zankou.silent_sunset_v1: With a living team Zankou, qualified Scorch uses one source-preserving target aggregate capped at three stacks. Initial application gives one stack; further qualified applications and each connected ordinary DoT delivery on that live enhanced target add one, cap at three, and refresh fifteen seconds without resetting the .99-second tick phase or adding an immediate tick. A DoT-triggered replacement is a newly inflicted Scorch by Zankou: all existing stacks take his live level, Cycle Intensity, Incantation element and captured ordinary plus DoT crit damage, using the shared Scorch base and fixed fifty-percent crit policy. It does not copy the ally's applied HP damage or its DoT coefficient/duration. This selects the description's newly inflicted effect as the new Scorch and the native carrier's fifteen-second/.99-second clocks. Replacement receipts retain the original switch and link the exact earlier triggering hit separately from the new damage owner. Scorch's own ticks cannot trigger this effect; zero HP-loss connected DoT hits may, following the reached callback's absent positive-damage gate. Dead Zankou cannot create replacements; existing captured Scorch remains independent. R6 kill enhancement, native prediction/callback fidelity and unbound ordinary Skill application remain outside this model.

character.zankou.vile_ash_dot_scheduling_v2: The current canonical Zankou Bloodfeast variant applies five Vile Ash stacks at4216667us montage progress after same-time direct damage, to each eligible living declared dummy. Ordinary and free enhanced Inferno do not apply it. Each original source/target carrier caps at ten, lasts thirty World seconds and ticks once per World second strictly before expiry, without immediate execution. A live reapplication adds its captured stack count, refreshes duration and preserves the existing tick phase; an expired carrier starts a fresh phase with no old stacks. Pending old deliveries are cancelled before replacement. Its native coefficient is multiplied once by1+clamp(stacks-1,0,10); positive native expansion bypasses that additional stack term. Owner-specific spread notifications copy captured attached carriers, including to their donor, preserving ownership and independent caps; DoT ticks never recursively spread. Living sources continue off field, source defeat cancels pending deliveries and target defeat removes that recipient. Native talent and live source stats remain authoritative. These composition, finite montage and half-open refresh/expiry interpretations are bounded models, not recovered native executor playback.

combat.control_effects_v1: A content owner may request a finite control effect after a connected delivered hit. The anonymous dummy's authored control_immune flag defaults false and is independent of Boss classification, airborne inputs and damage magnitude. A living source can control a living nonimmune recipient; a defeated source/target or immune recipient produces no successful-control receipt or status. Positive exact hits that round to zero HP loss still reach after-hit control, distinct from positive-HP-loss consumers. Successful applications preserve source actor, actual target and parent command, record exact world-time duration/expiry and apply one target-scoped status. Control represents gameplay eligibility only, without movement, geometry or target AI. Source death does not erase an already applied finite target effect. Native immunity and after-hit ordering remain explicit scenario/owner hypotheses.

combat.discord_break_gauge_v1: A newly admitted Scorch/Nova generation pair on the same living target emits one Discord callback, deduplicated by that pair; periodic ticks, readiness checks and reuse of the same pair emit none. A breakable target must explicitly declare discord_fraction in (0,1]. Discord subtracts original capacity times that fraction times the target's accepted incoming Break efficiency from the current non-Broken gauge, clamps at zero, then enters at most one causal Broken transition. A Broken target records the callback and loses no gauge; a no-bar or defeated target has no gauge to lose. This selected content model creates no HP packet, critical roll, ordinary damage modifier, resource grant or recursive reaction and does not establish a universal native Discord percentage.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

daffodil.action_cancels_v1: Daffodil action cancels require ordinary_clock_v1. Jump and Skill use the selected native stage gates through the same owner lost-progress clock; an ordinary invalid early input does not interrupt. Accepted Jump/replacement removes unreached montage requests and resets the Normal pointer without refunding costs or captured Resonance. A new montage inherits any still-live owner pause, while World deadlines retain their exact remaining duration through shared pauses. Explicit forced interruption releases recovery and cancels pending montage work; pre-notify Skill starts3s cancel cooldown at interruption, post-notify retains its original16s deadline. A completed cast is not interrupted retroactively. This binds finite source gates and causal cancellation, not airborne geometry, paid Dodge, suspended combo or a recovered native interruption body.

daffodil.branch_entry_direct_packet_energy_v1: For Daffodil character:1054 only, an explicitly modeled GA_Daffodill_Melee Branch1-7 or EntryAttack1/2/4 direct packet grants its frozen DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the frozen source-element to recipient-element coefficient from DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (3/5 for Daffodil CHAOS), then applies their own Charge Efficiency, exact fractional carry, capacity and overflow accounting. This exact direct-input policy is a tested hypothesis, not evidence of native eligibility. Natural Branch/Entry dispatch, animation, timing, target rules, jump/dodge legality, stamina, costs, cadence, extra packets, other targets and callbacks remain unresolved; Branch6/7 are frozen packet rows without a published-tip binding.

daffodil.discord_cap_reduction_v1: For the supported fully unlocked Daffodil profile with Blade Draw B2 active, each real Discord generation-pair callback on a breakable target adds one stack of 0.10 original-cap reduction, capped at two stacks, and refreshes one shared 30-second deadline. Apply its capacity change before that Discord's direct gauge deduction; on an unbroken target preserve prior gauge depletion by adding the capacity delta and clamping to the new cap. If the cap step reaches zero, use one causal Break transition and skip that callback's later gauge deduction. While Broken, update only future capacity; recovery restores that capacity. Expiry restores original capacity while preserving depleted gauge, and accepted reductions survive source field exit/defeat until expiry. MMO getter output remains unmodeled; this is the selected non-MMO coefficient, not a universal mode value.

daffodil.insight_break_capture_v1: Finale applies independent source-owned target Insight: one refreshed stack for 45 seconds, or up to two stacks with shared refreshed 9999-second expiry at selected A3. Self Eyes remains 30 seconds at every awakening. At a new target Break, selected A4 adds 0.15 Break bonus per own Insight stack and A5 adds one captured own contribution per stack. Capture uses this recipient and source only; marks survive field exit/source death, expire half-open, and clear on target death. Base roster contributions precede repeats in source-slot order; defeated recipients cancel pending contributions. This is a bounded owner model, not proof of native callbacks or montage timing; R6 Broken Chaos shred remains unbound.

Each connected causal request adds its integrated native duration*(1-rate) lost progress only to this owner montage, once across all dummy recipients. Unconnected requests add no pause. Every request retains its native row, captured talent and distinct energy group; AoE does not multiply Charge or Cycle. Normal continuation lasts through actual recovery plus2s. Skill's16s cooldown begins at its reached ordinary.182290/Echoes.110328 marker; Finale costs120 and starts20s cooldown at admission, applying self Eyes and target Insight at progress0. Replacement/field exit cancels unreached montage requests without refund. This is the checked source-coordinate product model, not measured animation timing or a global time stop; secondary actions and entry have separate acceptance.

daffodil.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Daffodil character:1054 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Daffodil CHAOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, Branch, AirAttack, EntryAttack, PerfectEvadeAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. daffodil.phantom_step_v1: Daffodil Phantom Step is funded only by a successful Finale progress-0 reset to two uses with one World-time30s admission handle. assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

combat.control_effects_v1: A content owner may request a finite control effect after a connected delivered hit. The anonymous dummy's authored control_immune flag defaults false and is independent of Boss classification, airborne inputs and damage magnitude. A living source can control a living nonimmune recipient; a defeated source/target or immune recipient produces no successful-control receipt or status. Positive exact hits that round to zero HP loss still reach after-hit control, distinct from positive-HP-loss consumers. Successful applications preserve source actor, actual target and parent command, record exact world-time duration/expiry and apply one target-scoped status. Control represents gameplay eligibility only, without movement, geometry or target AI. Source death does not erase an already applied finite target effect. Native immunity and after-hit ordering remain explicit scenario/owner hypotheses.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

Defeated dummies never produce connected hits and keep their existing skip rules; the source must be living. This is not a claim about native proximity radius or recipient selection; native trigger consumer behavior remains unresolved.

linko.xiaozhen_pet_v1: Linko's canonical Skill retains its four bombardment packets and deploys Xiaozhen once; companion deployment does not also instantiate the separate two-packet Throw route. nanally.action_clock_v1: Nanally uses finite rate-one source asset progress rounded upward to microseconds, not frame-verified playback. Native Normal stages retain1/1/3/7/2 packets and conservative recovery; a greater-than2s idle gap after the latest ordinary/heavy phase or preserving Dash resets it. Aim captures one target and no Cat group; melee/Support/Riposte/plunge/heavy player packets hit all living stationary dummies. One packet group grants resources/contact pause once after its first positive actual HP loss; zero loss adds neither. Shared exact hitlag integrates the strongest overlapping slowdown and projects pending packets, notifications and owner gates. Located contact pauses (seconds/rate) are Normal3 final.13/.01; Normal5 .06/.01 and.12/.01; Support .25/.2 delayed.06; Riposte .3/.01; landing .06/.01; Heavy1 .08/.01 then.17/.01; Heavy2 Intro1 each.1/.5 then Intro2 .1/.01; Heavy3 .2/.01 delayed.05. Burst ability/Jump3582140us, switch3583025us and movement3756871us retain separate gates. Interruption/new legal inputs cancel unissued owner packets, unborn notifications and unlaunched Cat groups, retaining settled damage/resources/cooldowns/states and independent launched children. Reached contact lag continues into later inputs; expired intervals are pruned. Actual non-damaging input command identity, spent dodge stamina and already granted one-use Riposte permission survive interruption; no Parry is inferred.
