Heavy1/2 continue after progress greater than.6/.98s without re-adding hold time. Exclusive positions use the next microsecond; release at a boundary prevents continuation. Started heavy sections deliver2/3/1 packets unless cancelled. Cat heavy groups1/3/3 use captured Burst talent, uncapped recipients and one A1/A5 callback per group. Original input identity/role owns all subsections; native heavy packet categoryA is separate, with no fake commands or extra cast observers. Remaining hold after Heavy3 consumes real time without attacks and blocks a new Normal until release; legal cancel gates may release early. Recipient, release, contact, dispatch and subsection input-accounting policies are revisable models. A fresh admitted Dash preserves next Normal/heavy progress and rebases its2s idle window without refunding stamina or restoring unissued packets. A new hold of at least200ms resumes reached Heavy1/2 into Heavy2/3 after consuming200ms; a short hold/tap or stale permission takes Normal. Paid Critical Riposte has priority. Other abilities, Jump/Special, field exit, defeat or explicit interruption clear continuation; no-op same-actor swap preserves it. Retention/entry are revisable policies; the selected native full-kit baseline is accepted.

nanally.authority_removal_v1: Nanally Skill's ordinary sixteen-second cooldown begins at the reached native425571us progress notify through action_clock_v1. While living Nanally has live Authority, an authored Skill selects source-granted GA_Nanally_RemoveSkill after its own two-second gate from Authority application, instead of waiting for or replacing ordinary cooldown. A fresh rate-one E applies Authority at429917us, hence unlocks removal at2429917us. Field, life, recovery and monotone-time admission still apply; readiness reports the selected gate. Removal ends Authority and its source command, creates no damage, Cat group, A3/A1/A5 callback, ordinary Skill cast proc or energy payment, and preserves the original ordinary cooldown, A5 and independent Underboss generation/eligible pending groups. A repeated Skill after removal again uses ordinary cooldown; expiry, field exit and death remove replacement eligibility. Authored input and nominal packet template remain in the admission ledger with utility/Other provenance; no nominal packet is delivered. The source non-damaging route grounds selection; instantaneous zero-cost utility recovery, preservation and observer policy are revisable choices, not a measured or prorated finisher model.

nanally.blossom_enhancement_v1: A living Nanally unlocked at breakthrough2 enhances each newly created party Blossom Bud to ten Vita Pistils at one-second intervals, first emission one second after birth. The native extension row's five additional bullets and the published ten-pistil/one-second description ground count and cadence; the saved negative countdown field alone is not a timer. Party-wide living-provider eligibility at creation, captured generation schedule and independent Cycle damage ownership are selected policies. Switching or later loss of the provider does not rewrite an existing Bud, while newly born Buds recheck eligibility. Base five/two-second behavior, owner level/CI snapshot, three-Bud cap, Jiuyuan's separate cap/count extension, replacement cancellation, target settlement and copied-pistil rules retain their own owners. Duplicate providers do not stack. No Authority, Underboss, awakening or extra resource payment is required. This is a revisable execution model, not frame-verified native behavior.

nanally.burst_seven_hits_v1: Nanally Burst's finite rate-one action_clock_v1 delivers UltraSkill1 once, UltraSkill2 five times and UltraSkill3 once at2300192/2382032/2468449/2547640/2634465/2716783/3015465us progress. Frozen effective Burst coefficients and native Q/NATURE metadata remain separate from live per-hit stats. Packets hit all living stationary dummies; no ordinary energy or free Cat attack is inferred. Public Burst pays100 energy and starts its15s cooldown at commitment; interruption preserves paid cost/cooldown, settled damage and already applied effects while cancelling unissued owner packets and unborn summon notification. Underboss applies separately at3415870us via burst_summon_state_v1. General ability/Jump recovery3582140us, switch3583025us and movement3756871us retain distinct gates. No positive pause duration is invented from rate-only Q source rows. Saved asset progress, conservative playback, uncapped recipients and cancellation policy are revisable models, not measured animation fidelity.

nanally.burst_summon_state_v1: Nanally's ordinary Burst applies one Underboss generation at the reached3415870us progress notification, after all seven direct Q markers, through action_clock_v1. The captured effective Burst coordinate and actual admitted source command remain attached. It lasts6 ObjectLifetime seconds or9 with selected Effect2, with half-open expiry and generation replacement only when a new summon actually applies. Cancelling before birth issues no new summon; cancelling after birth preserves its remaining lifetime. At equal time BuffTickOrExpiry application precedes explicit SettlementAndDeath interruption. Owner death clears the summon and cancels affected groups; field exit preserves remaining lifetime and already dispatched independent children. Creation/direct Q produce no Cat_AirAttack hit, coordination or A1/A5 callback. The budget is time only, without an eight-input cap or unused auxiliary-minion stocks. Later supported inputs select their own Cat groups. These are selected revisable execution policies, not frame-verified game behavior.

nanally.cycle_followups_v1: Nanally with breakthrough4, living and active Authority reacts to positive settled team Esper Cycle damage with one Fair Duel follow-up at effective Normal talent, native level1 coefficient0.6, and an independent source-owned2-second guard. The triggering live target is captured, otherwise the lowest-index living target; a later defeat cancels without retargeting. Owner state is enabled by the real Authority Skill command and the exact actual damage receipt; both parents are retained by the shared autonomous coordinated-hit ledger. Ordinary damage does not directly trigger Fair Duel. Nanally-owned Cycle damage and connected Fair Duel can trigger her selected A3 under its separate1-second guard, while actual own Hexed follow-ups and Fair Duel request A1/A5 once through shared callback accounting. Queries do not trigger these effects. Native rows and published descriptions ground coefficient/guards; positive-HP-loss qualification, captured recipient, source command lifetime and ordered same-time dispatch are selected execution policies, not frame-verified native behavior.

nanally.normal_chain_v1: Five admitted ordinary inputs advance stages Melee1 through Melee5 with multiplicities 1,1,3,7,2 (fourteen hits). The chain loops, retaining native effective talent projection including resonance_3.

nanally.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Nanally character:1010 only, each scoped ordinary Normal/heavy/Aim/plunge or Skill packet group grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after its first positive actual HP loss, including a surviving non-primary dummy. Recipient multiplicity cannot duplicate charge. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives1x; each other living configured recipient receives the frozen source-element to recipient-element coefficient (Nanally NATURE's six recipient-element rows are.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency, exact carry and capacity/overflow. Delivery-time owner attribution survives switching for already emitted independent packets. Aim uses native.7 charge; landing uses native2.5 charge without the authored height multiplier. Burst, Cat, unsupported Branch rows, PerfectEvadeAttack, QTE and callbacks outside these bindings do not use this grant. Recipient/contact policies remain selected hypotheses; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

nanally.skill_five_hits_v1: Nanally Colucci Howling Technique uses finite rate-one action_clock_v1: five E packets at429637/497363/563001/631341/696485us progress, rounded upward from saved source coordinates. Each packet hits all living stationary dummies and grants ordinary energy once per positive group. Skill cooldown starts at the425571us notify and lasts16 World seconds; pre-notify cancellation leaves none and later cancellation preserves it. Authority begins at429917us, after the first hit, adding30 percentage points CRIT DMG for12 World seconds or selected Effect6's15 in combat/20 outside, captured at actual application via combat_lifecycle_v1. Field exit, death, expiry and explicit removal end it. Separate next-ability/Jump1164219us and movement1512797us gates apply; interruption cancels unissued packets and unborn notifications, without refunding settled resources. Live Authority selects non-damaging RemoveSkill after2 World seconds from its application through authority_removal_v1; removal preserves ordinary cooldown and invokes no ordinary cast observers. A3 follows settled positive owner damage under live Authority with its own1s guard, so a fresh E's second packet can request it. Conservative playback, uncapped recipients, dispatch and positive-loss policies are revisable models, not frame verification. Heavy/plunge remain separate bindings.

nanally.support_packets_v1: Nanally Support delivers one frozen Anima/category-H QTE1 at .666410 seconds after accepted entry and retains the parent reaction-qualified switch. Rate-one impact, distinct switch/next-ability gates, delayed positive-contact hitstop and cancellation execute through action_clock_v1: nominal recovery1.108275s becomes1.308275s after contact, switch1.083416 becomes1.283416, while a miss retains nominal recovery. Reaction qualification has no Support cooldown. The uncapped all-in-range dummy model hits every living recipient with live owner stats, purchased Support talent and no R3 Support upgrade. Native7.000 charge is granted once on the first positive recipient per packet, with living teammates at the existing .6 relation, exact efficiency/carry/cap/overflow and no Cycle. A living current Underboss generation also emits one primary-recipient Cat QTE packet at that admitted impact under the existing generation/death/expiry policy, using its captured effective Burst coordinate independently from Support talent. The Cat packet keeps the actual Support parent, native GA_Nanally_UltraSkill and category A; its1.5-starting coefficient is not another Support or Ultimate packet and grants no ordinary energy/Break/Cycle. Existing coordinated A1/A5 callbacks remain owner rules. Interruption cancels unissued owner packets/unlaunched Cat groups; switching preserves already launched independent children and the summon generation. Native caps, measured playback and exact summon travel remain uncertified.

nanally.underboss_coordination_v2: A living Nanally summon starts at the reached Burst3415870us notification and lasts6 ObjectLifetime seconds, or9 with selected Effect2, with half-open expiry and generation replacement. It coordinates one published packet group per later supported Normal or Skill input or reached heavy section; native Support, Critical Riposte and plunge bindings select their own groups. The summon uses a time budget only: no separate three-minion pool or inferred eight-group limit. Normal groups are Cat_Melee1; Cat_Melee2; Cat_Melee3+4; Cat_Melee5 x3; Cat_Melee6+7. Skill is Cat_Skill x5. Heavy groups are Cat_Branch1; Cat_Branch2+3+4; Cat_Branch5 x3, with selected uncapped recipients and one performed group each. Each uses the creating Burst talent coordinate with native A/NATURE metadata and zero ordinary energy/Cycle/Break. One admitted group is one performed follow-up attack for A1/A5, even when it contains several packets. After surviving group delivery one selected A1 callback uses its shared one-second ICD and exact efficiency/carry, and one selected A5 stack adds 2 percent base-ATK scaling to a ten-stack cap with 15-second refresh and a fresh stack pool after half-open expiry. A5 cannot regrant off field or outside combat and clears on field exit or an explicitly modeled combat exit. Coincident post-parent delivery against the selected recipient is a scheduling approximation; no synthetic 0.3-second FIFO is imposed. Waiting creates no autonomous attack. Owner death, target loss, expiry or replacement cancels pending groups; switching preserves eligible pending groups and remaining summon lifetime. Burst direct hits, summon creation and Aim create no Cat group. These selected rules are revisable models, not frame-verified game claims.

owner.action_role.character_1003_qte_v1: Classify this exact frozen character action as QTE because its DT_CharacterAbilityConfig identity names the owner action as QTE while DT_CharacterAbilityEffectConfig has no row; this role is an owner-reviewed model hypothesis for this ability only.

owner.action_role.character_1010_qte_v1: Classify this exact frozen character action as QTE because its DT_CharacterAbilityConfig identity names the owner action as QTE while DT_CharacterAbilityEffectConfig has no row; this role is an owner-reviewed model hypothesis for this ability only.

owner.action_role.character_1046_ultimate_v1: Classify this exact Zero action as UltraSkill because the frozen character action identity names its ultimate and the effect-config row is absent; owner role is an explicit model hypothesis.

sakiri.burst_atk_v1: Current GA_Sagiri_UltraSkill activation independently requests ordinary Buff_Sagiri003_QDamUp and, only with node4, Buff_Sagiri003_Level4_1. Each adds30percent of the source GetAtkBase to other living teammates for20 World seconds, with no self grant. The separate cap1 carriers refresh rather than stack. The selected managed snapshot lifetime survives source defeat; dead recipients receive no new grant and existing dead carriers contribute nothing. Actual admitted activation produces the grants, without hit or damage requirements. This explicit lifetime/recipient model does not simulate multiplayer global-component routing.

sakiri.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Sakiri character:1003 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Sakiri INCANTATION are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. The explicit GE_Player_Sagiri_AirAttack1_Damage packet input is excluded from this energy adapter; native plunge energy eligibility remains unresolved. Burst, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

sakiri.skill_burst_packets_v1: Sakiri Devour Whole delivers Skill1 and Skill2 once each on target zero; Feast of Gluttony delivers UltraSkill1 five times and UltraSkill2 once. All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, eating mode or complete kit behavior.

sakiri.support_packets_v1: Sakiri Squash Support delivers one frozen Incantation/category-H QTE1 packet at the admitted .100s impact, with the reviewed .600s recovery. The saved public Squash description explicitly deals damage to an area; with no recovered cap, the bounded stationary-dummy model hits every living in-range target. Live wearer/target stats and purchased Support talent apply; the frozen resonance row upgrades Normal/Skill/Burst only, so QTE receives no inferred level bonus. Native ChargeAdd is 10.900 and UnbalValue 2.500, superseding the older card summary's 7.500 energy and Cosmos label. A shared packet group grants the native raw energy once on its first positive recipient, even when target zero is defeated or immune; living source receives 1/1 and living teammates 3/5 with independent efficiency, carry, capacity and overflow. QTE grants no Cycle. Switching alone retains launched packets and source ownership; source defeat cancels pending hits and grants. The owner model is preflighted before automatic admission. Cast/eligibility timing and uncapped all-in-range recipient selection remain disclosed reviewed-card models rather than measured native geometry or caps.

sakiri.suppress_v1: Sakiri's first connected Ultimate packet per admitted input and actual recipient attempts the source-bound Suppress effect once. Child pulses and other recipients retain their causal command identity; switching does not rearm an earlier attempt. Suppress lasts 3 World seconds, or 6 with selected A1, using Sagiri_Suppress and Sagiri_lv1_Suppress. Only successful control applies the Impish Trick child DEF reduction: one shared target instance subtracts 10 percent of authored base DEF for 20 seconds, independently of the shorter control lifetime. If base_def is omitted, authored total DEF is also the assumed base; an explicit base 1000/total 1500 yields 1400, not 1350. The reduction refreshes at the next successful control and clamps effective DEF at zero. These choices bind the recovered SKILL_EVENT_AFTER_HIT -> suppress object -> control marker and DEF-child chain, not every damage input or mere preexisting airborne state. Native control immunity, hybrid-server routing, exact application/capture clocks and passive unlock dispatch remain unverified; the reviewed baseline enables the passive. Other floating/Skill control and A5 transitions retain their separate owner limits.

sets.crimson_v1: Crimson: Twin Butterflies binds Incantation_4_1/4_2/4_3 to the four-piece description (.06/6/10). Each connected delivered wearer hit grants one independent self ATK stack before same-time queued hits, including multi-packet inputs. The cap discards new applications without refreshing existing stacks. Each stack expires independently on world time, before equal-time hits; switching preserves stacks and allies cannot grant or receive them. The native trigger is AsyncTaskCharacterAttacked with an element check the frozen evidence does not fully resolve; hit-granted stacks are a tested hypothesis. Trigger timing and cap behavior are tested hypotheses; set count declares matching native geometry. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.good_boy_v3: Good Boy retains the once-compiled additive Charge Efficiency from v2 and its admitted-Ultimate shared team ATK window. A successful control receipt produced by that wearer's same admitted Ultimate upgrades the single active named window from its frozen base ATK ratio to base plus the frozen 6/7/8/9/10 percent refinement ratio. The extra ratio latches once per cast across recipients and survives the control status ending; it lasts only the remainder of the original 20-second world-time deadline. It never stacks per target, refreshes on repeated hit/control callbacks, or extends from control time. Expired windows, stale commands and an older wearer's control after another wearer replaced the shared snapshot cannot upgrade it. Ordinary Ultimate damage, mere airborne state, Boss metadata, other actors and non-Ultimate control are insufficient; the engine's actual successful-control receipt is required. This supersedes v2's missing-control-consumer limit under the explicit combat.control_effects_v1 model, currently produced by Sakiri Suppress. Native conditional capture, original application ordering and cross-wearer priority remain tested product assumptions. Legacy explicit TeamAtk-only procs default their omitted control ratio to zero; native projectors bind it at every refinement.

weapons.moon_v1: Stellar Veil adds its frozen Psyche ratio to matching delivered packets in the additive damage-bonus zone. Dealing Psyche DMG grants one wearer stack of Crit DMG through ProcCallback up to ten stacks, with a 0.1s trigger cooldown. Each trigger refreshes the group's duration to 5s, including at cap. Switching preserves stacks and cooldown; exact expiry precedes equal-time hits. Cooldown, stacking, and world-time clocks are tested hypotheses. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.rishi_v2: Eclipse grants the wearer its frozen ATK percentage unconditionally, joining the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum. The ratio is not a final, special, or multiplicative factor. Arc: Eclipse: explicit Arc admission by the living active wearer outside recovery creates a 40s Eclipse field; each wearer-credited enemy defeat during the field restores flat frozen energy (6/7/8/9/10 per T1-T5) up to 5 defeats per field; re-creating the field waits a 300s arc cooldown. Arc activation uses the shared action admission and cooldown service, with no HP or energy cost and no added recovery under the bounded instantaneous field-creation model. Ultimate casts alone create no field. Wearer-kill credit (not team kills), field-window boundaries, charge scaling and instantaneous activation remain tested hypotheses. The energy grant flows through actor.grant_energy, so it scales by charge_multiplier (tested; native scaling unknown). Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog. A dead wearer cannot claim further field defeats or activate pending field/energy callbacks. A grant already reserved before death is skipped without changing energy, overflow or carry; its consumed defeat slot and admitted cooldown are not refunded. Living off-field wearers remain eligible. Delivery-time living eligibility is a bounded inference consistent with living-recipient team generation and absence of a revival rule, not native callback proof.

weapons.tiger_tally_v2: Commander Tiger Talisman grants the wearer its frozen ATK percentage unconditionally, joining the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum. Each admitted wearer Redirect Skill or Ultimate cast adds one wearer-only damage instance of the frozen Normal ratio for the frozen duration, stacking to 2 with independent per-instance expiry; a grant at the cap is dropped without refreshing survivors. The damage bonus joins the additive M_bonus zone and applies only to delivered packets classified as native Basic Attack (A) or Critical Riposte (Z), independently of the initiating input role; other recognized packet categories are excluded and missing/unknown reached classifications diagnose. Redirect Skill records one Left Tiger Talisman and Ultimate records one Right Tiger Talisman until cast time + the frozen 15s window; a same-side grant refreshes that side, and receiving the opposite side strictly before its deadline consumes the pair and immediately activates Arc. The automatic activation and pair consumption are bounded hypotheses because the text says the pair unlocks Arc but no separate Arc action is represented. Arc refreshes one wearer-only 10s damage bonus in M_bonus, read only against targets whose explicit scenario is_boss flag is true; retriggers reset its duration. Talisman refresh/consumption, Arc auto-activation/refresh and scenario Boss eligibility are tested model hypotheses. Critical Riposte category Z receives the Basic Attack damage bonus; its owner admission remains a separate mechanic. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

zero.a1_first_hit_v1: Zero A1 triggers on the first nonzero connected Skill hit per admitted activation and target, only when target level <= Zero level. Prefer the explicit Chinese not-above-level condition over the English lower-level translation; child packets cannot retrigger and retain the struck target.

zero.burst_a3_crit_rate_v1: Zero A3 Anomalies Record adds 0.50 to ordinary crit rate for each native Burst packet, in addition to static, live, and gear crit rate; normal packet eligibility and the shared 1.0 crit-rate clamp still apply. The 1046AwakenEffect Effect4 text and Female051_LV4_1/2/3 figures bind the formula; assignment to the additive damage-bonus zone is an explicit tested hypothesis.

zero.burst_all_in_range_v1: Zero Burst delivers its ordered seven-packet train to every eligible scenario-declared dummy under the all-in-range dummy contract: by scenario definition all eligible dummies are in range and inside attack areas, so no position, radius, shape, or placement check gates delivery. Targets are delivered in ascending target_index order; for each target, UltraSkill1, UltraSkill2 four times, UltraSkill3, then UltraSkill4 (target-major order), all at the admitted primary impact time. Defeated or otherwise ineligible dummies keep their existing skip rules. This is a declared scenario rule, not a claim about native AoE geometry; native recipient caps/selection/distribution and packet spacing remain unresolved.

All seven packets use the admitted primary impact time and target 0, the simulator's current default target. Native packet intervals remain unresolved.

The outgoing payer identifies the trigger independently of the higher-CI reaction damage owner. The same carrier refreshes without stacking and persists through field exit. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Zero COSMOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. zero.skill_packets_v1: Zero ordinary Skill delivers Skill1, Skill2, Skill3, and Skill4 once each from one admitted cast, matching the four ordered ratios in frozen neverness_zero and native DT_SkillDamageData rows. The admitted Skill fills this owner's Cycle pool to its existing capacity of 100 once, including semantic Hotori replay, independently of damage recipient count, ordinary energy and hit-generated channels. Existing charge is retained without duplicate grant or overflow. Cast-time fill is the selected interpretation of the published instant-Cycle Skill; native callback timing remains unverified. entries.label: Nanally · Hexed / Iroi
assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

combat.control_effects_v1: A content owner may request a finite control effect after a connected delivered hit. The anonymous dummy's authored control_immune flag defaults false and is independent of Boss classification, airborne inputs and damage magnitude. A living source can control a living nonimmune recipient; a defeated source/target or immune recipient produces no successful-control receipt or status. Positive exact hits that round to zero HP loss still reach after-hit control, distinct from positive-HP-loss consumers. Successful applications preserve source actor, actual target and parent command, record exact world-time duration/expiry and apply one target-scoped status. Control represents gameplay eligibility only, without movement, geometry or target AI. Source death does not erase an already applied finite target effect. Native immunity and after-hit ordering remain explicit scenario/owner hypotheses.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Each admitted wearer Redirect Skill or Ultimate cast adds one wearer-only damage instance of the frozen Normal ratio for the frozen duration, stacking to 2 with independent per-instance expiry; a grant at the cap is dropped without refreshing survivors. The damage bonus joins the additive M_bonus zone and applies only to delivered packets classified as native Basic Attack (A) or Critical Riposte (Z), independently of the initiating input role; other recognized packet categories are excluded and missing/unknown reached classifications diagnose. Redirect Skill records one Left Tiger Talisman and Ultimate records one Right Tiger Talisman until cast time + the frozen 15s window; a same-side grant refreshes that side, and receiving the opposite side strictly before its deadline consumes the pair and immediately activates Arc. The automatic activation and pair consumption are bounded hypotheses because the text says the pair unlocks Arc but no separate Arc action is represented. Arc refreshes one wearer-only 10s damage bonus in M_bonus, read only against targets whose explicit scenario is_boss flag is true; retriggers reset its duration. Talisman refresh/consumption, Arc auto-activation/refresh and scenario Boss eligibility are tested model hypotheses. Critical Riposte category Z receives the Basic Attack damage bonus; its owner admission remains a separate mechanic. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

zero.a1_first_hit_v1: Zero A1 triggers on the first nonzero connected Skill hit per admitted activation and target, only when target level <= Zero level. Prefer the explicit Chinese not-above-level condition over the English lower-level translation; child packets cannot retrigger and retain the struck target.

zero.burst_a3_crit_rate_v1: Zero A3 Anomalies Record adds 0.50 to ordinary crit rate for each native Burst packet, in addition to static, live, and gear crit rate; normal packet eligibility and the shared 1.0 crit-rate clamp still apply. The native 1046AwakenEffect Effect3 text and DT_Female051EffectFigure Female051_LV3 support the value; additive stacking is the tested interpretation.

zero.burst_a4_damage_bonus_v1: Zero A4 Undecided Factors adds min(compiled base ATK × DT_Female051EffectFigure Female051_LV4_2, Female051_LV4_3) to the ordinary damage-bonus zone for native Burst packets. The 1046AwakenEffect Effect4 text and Female051_LV4_1/2/3 figures bind the formula; assignment to the additive damage-bonus zone is an explicit tested hypothesis.

zero.burst_all_in_range_v1: Zero Burst delivers its ordered seven-packet train to every eligible scenario-declared dummy under the all-in-range dummy contract: by scenario definition all eligible dummies are in range and inside attack areas, so no position, radius, shape, or placement check gates delivery. Targets are delivered in ascending target_index order; for each target, UltraSkill1, UltraSkill2 four times, UltraSkill3, then UltraSkill4 (target-major order), all at the admitted primary impact time. Defeated or otherwise ineligible dummies keep their existing skip rules. This is a declared scenario rule, not a claim about native AoE geometry; native recipient caps/selection/distribution and packet spacing remain unresolved.

zero.burst_packets_v1: Zero Burst delivers native UltraSkill1 once, UltraSkill2 four times, UltraSkill3 once, and UltraSkill4 once, in that order, matching DT_GameplayAbilityTipsData.GA_Female046_UltraSkill.GALevelUpArray[0] and each native DT_SkillDamageData row. All seven packets use the admitted primary impact time and target 0, the simulator's current default target. Native packet intervals remain unresolved.

zero.cosmos_cycle_atk_v1: Resonance 6 Zero grants each living party member, including Zero, 12% base-ATK-scaled ATK for 20 World seconds on a qualified Cosmos Cycle for which Zero pays the outgoing Cycle cost. The outgoing payer identifies the trigger independently of the higher-CI reaction damage owner. The same carrier refreshes without stacking and persists through field exit. The published trigger wording and frozen amount/duration inform this selected ownership and lifetime model.

zero.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Zero character:1046 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Zero COSMOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

zero.skill_packets_v1: Zero ordinary Skill delivers Skill1, Skill2, Skill3, and Skill4 once each from one admitted cast, matching the four ordered ratios in frozen neverness_zero and native DT_SkillDamageData rows. The admitted Skill fills this owner's Cycle pool to its existing capacity of 100 once, including semantic Hotori replay, independently of damage recipient count, ordinary energy and hit-generated channels. Existing charge is retained without duplicate grant or overflow. Cast-time fill is the selected interpretation of the published instant-Cycle Skill; native callback timing remains unverified. Children use the admitted primary impact time; animation intervals and travel are unresolved.

entries.label: Hotori · Blossom
assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.single_packet_support_v1: Single-packet qualified Support actions use their owner packet, purchased QTE coordinate, recovered or documented bounded timing, and owner-local recovery gates. Living in-range dummy recipients share one packet's ordinary Charge and connected owner effects.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

fireflies.all_in_range_v1: Under the all-in-range dummy contract the source's "nearby enemy" condition is a declared scenario rule: every eligible scenario-declared dummy is nearby by definition, so no position, radius, shape or placement check gates the trigger on a connected Anima hit. Defeated dummies never produce connected hits and keep their existing skip rules; the source must be living. This is not a claim about native proximity radius or recipient selection; native trigger consumer behavior remains unresolved.

fireflies.team_anima_hit_v1: A connected, nonzero elemental Anima packet from any living team member grants one independent Fireflies CRIT DMG stack to each living team member wearing Fireflies, including off-field wearers. A wearer does not grant an extra stack merely for being the source; each wearer receives exactly one stack per packet.

gear.cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Ultimate admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Weapon and set effects retain their own recipient, stacking and expiry policies. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis; native animation timing remains unresolved.

gear.skill_cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Skill admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Source-owned recipient, stacking and expiry rules still apply. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis.

hotori.katana_chain_v1: While Hotori's World's Tide Time Stop is active, an admitted Basic input selects the five-stage Q-category Katana chain instead of the ordinary Normal chain: stage1 delivers one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkillMelee1_Damage, stage2 one UltraSkillMelee2 plus one UltraSkillMelee2_1, stage3 three UltraSkillMelee3 plus one UltraSkillMelee3_1, stage4 one UltraSkillMelee4 plus UltraSkillMelee4_1..4_3, and stage5 one UltraSkillMelee5 plus one UltraSkillMelee5_1, all Cosmos with zero raw energy, Cycle and Break. Each admitted input increments the count marker once at its native marker time regardless of misses, up to exactly 10; inputs 1..10 select stages 1..5 twice and the count persists across both subchains. At exactly 10 the next Basic selects one finisher instead of a stage, does not increment the count, and ordinary legal inputs cannot reach 11. The finisher is one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkillMelee6_Damage, replaced by one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkillMelee6Pas2_Damage when breakthrough4 enables Passive2, and never both rows. Each input delivers its stage's local source hits at the selected real offsets to every eligible dummy under hotori.aoe_all_in_range_dummy_v1, with live talent and modifier sampling; inputs chain through the native queued-next windows, stage source pauses and Any recoveries, the finisher keeps its recovery in real time and ends the Time Stop benefits at its damage delivery. No Timepiece, stamina or conventional Ultimate Energy is paid per Katana input. Mode end or a new World's Tide resets the count, an already admitted stage may finish after expiry with live mode bonuses removed, no finisher is manufactured at count9 or on expiry, and after the mode the next Basic returns to ordinary Entry1. Count markers, stage input starts and the finisher hit are checked exact scheduling choices, not native-body observations.

hotori.normal_chain_v1: Hotori ordinary Normal advances five stages with multiplicities 1,4,5,3,2 from frozen neverness_jin descriptions and native DT_SkillDamageData coefficients. The chain loops after stage five and resets on a different admitted ability, field exit or a gap greater than 2 seconds between input starts. Reset rules, gap and ordered delivery at the research impact coordinates are tested hypotheses pending animation/cancel evidence. Katana combo mode replaces this chain only while World's Tide Time Stop is active and is covered separately by hotori.katana_chain_v1.

hotori.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Hotori character:1052 only, any reachable ordinary Normal, Skill, Burst or Katana native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd (an explicit zero for the Q rows) once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Hotori COSMOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Branch, AirAttack, PerfectEvadeAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet trains remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

hotori.skill_burst_packets_v1: Hotori Present Replay delivers seven Skill hits on target zero at the native real coordinates (four GE_Player_Jin_Skill1_Damage and two GE_Player_Jin_Skill3_Damage following the Skill.3/Skill.1 schedule, plus one final GE_Player_Jin_Skill2_Damage) with total Any recovery 1.4086605 after the final hit's 0.1 source pause. World's Tide delivers ten UltraSkill hits (one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill1_Damage, five GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill1_1..5_Damage, one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill2_Damage, one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill4_Damage, and two GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill3_Damage) at their native post-entry coordinates with no source pause. All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently, and every packet hits all eligible dummies under hotori.aoe_all_in_range_dummy_v1. Delivery at those source coordinates is the selected timing hypothesis and does not model travel. Katana stage and finisher packets are covered by hotori.katana_chain_v1.

hotori.time_stop_clock_v1: World's Tide commitment opens its generation-owned cinematic pause; entry at action progress+2.183333 seconds transitions the same owner to active Time Stop, ending at the earlier finisher delivery, reserved deadline entry+12 seconds, forced cancellation or death. Overlapping pauses count once in relative combat time. Shared paused-world timers include ordinary cooldowns, buffs, status and periodic phases, passive resource recovery and incoming attacks; retained remainders resume without backlog. Only the finite committing cinematic and permitted Katana/replay action contexts advance through their own supported pause, and unrelated cinematics still dominate. Reserved-stop drain is independent of local hitlag. Deployed object lifetime advances during active stop while ordinary emissions pause; living B2 exempts Vita Bud emissions only, with lifetime and finite count still consumed. Explicit HP costs, grants and removals keep causal ordering. Damage rates use actual relative elapsed time; absolute timestamps retain event order. The conservative shared policy and object-lifetime distinction are explicit model assumptions, not observed native timer bodies.

hotori.timepiece_v1: Hotori character:1052 maintains one exact Timepiece account in[0,120] separate from conventional Ultimate Energy, Cycle, Charge and stamina. It starts at combat entry at 0; rotation boundaries never restore an initial value, and switching preserves it together with records, completed recording and paused-world cooldowns. Living Hotori recovers exactly 6 units per paused-world second whether on or off field, except while rewinding or during Burst setup and Time Stop; recovery clamps at 120 and reports the wasted overflow with no sixth-second polling. Present Replay requires living on field, ordinary permission, no active rewind or Time Stop, available_time strictly greater than 60 and paused-world Skill cooldown ready; at commit it spends exactly 60 once, suspends passive recovery, invalidates previous records and any pending A3 refund, and opens a fixed five-second recording interval at Skill+0.16747499 whose 60-unit rewind reservation settles at Skill+5.16747499 without a second deduction, resuming passive recovery with the post-payment remainder. World's Tide requires living Hotori on field, ordinary permission, no rewind or Time Stop, available_time equal to 120 and cooldown ready; at commit it atomically reserves all 120, stops passive and A3, freezes the record count for A1, and resets A4 and Katana counts; the reserved budget drains from setup entry at 10 per second, a finisher ends the mode early discarding the remainder, and interrupt or death before entry spends the committed 120 and cancels pending entry and replay. A3 selected starts an additional 6 per second refund of exactly 60 after a completed recording and full rewind settlement when its 60-second ICD from refund start is ready; any new Timepiece expenditure cancels the outstanding remainder while ordinary hits and switches do not. A4 grants 10 Timepiece per credited team kill while living and not rewinding, not during Burst reservation, setup or Time Stop, up to 3 accepted callbacks since the last actual World's Tide commit, counting the callback at cap with overflow lost and resetting only on World's Tide; kills during rewind do not consume an opportunity. Death cancels recording and Time Stop, discards reservations and disables passive recovery until revive, which keeps the retained pool. Held branch control, native-body deduction timing, copy-cooldown branches and any geometry interaction remain outside this model.

iroi.action_clock_v1: Iroi ordinary Normal uses the selected rate-one montage coordinates rounded once to microseconds, with exact next-Basic boundaries and distinct Skill/movement/other gates. Positive normal contacts add one33000us actor pause at rate.1 per causal projectile, delayed33000us for stages4/5; a zero-duration stage3 rate supplies no pause. Normal1/2 select one living locked recipient per projectile with deterministic fallback; stages3/4/5 cover all living eligible stationary dummies. Stage3 spawns one finite world actor at268779us progress, first contact200000us later then100000us spacing for eight contacts; launched actors survive caster progression/field exit, while unborn montage notifies cancel. Owner death prevents future actor ticks. Resource channels remain per causal packet, and live stats are sampled at impact. Continuing stages require the exact native queued Basic boundary; an idle input restarts stage1. This is a selected source-coordinate/contact inference, not measured playback. Canonical tap Skill uses montage cooldown249777us, heal/carrier498799us, Gun birth498827us with1200000us travel, Syringe birth551115us with seven100000us-spaced world contacts, and Trumpet birth601775us. Connected Skill actors add100000us player pauses at rate.1 once per causal packet, including on a replacement player montage; overlapping windows use minimum rate and never delay world ticks. Skill cooldown is12 World seconds from its notify, or3 seconds from interruption before that notify. Actual healing grants16 Moon once outside Dream and the self-excluded capped flat-ATK buff; normal healing callbacks retain live stats and passives. The tiny Skill carrier grants its sourced10 Charge once per effect application to an eligible living target, even when fractional damage rounds to zero integer HP loss; this disclosed rounding interpretation uses the ordinary exact carry/team ledger without fake HP or double grants. Other packets require positive HP loss. Explicit interruption removes unborn notifications and preserves launched actors and committed cooldowns. Selected A2 Skill diagnoses until its native assist exists. Native Burst reserves Moon at input, heals at1925956us, emits its Ivory-only direct packet at3385389us, installs pulses at3882835us and releases Dream drain/periods at4004747us montage progress; switch gate3764482us differs from4015812us ordinary recovery. Its real16s cooldown never follows montage pause. Setup projections shift only this owner reservation and pending Dream deadlines. Interrupted setup before any carrier retains unspent Moon without a Dream; after installation, actual cancellation releases only installed carriers with their full remaining Moon lifetime. These are explicit interruption/lifecycle inferences. Native pulses retain the actual Burst command/talent and reach all eligible living stationary dummies, with no inferred recipient cap. Existing Dream threshold, strict-before-end periods and death/generation invalidation remain authoritative. Held Branch/Transform, Lucid Dream, A2 assists, secondary and Regression interactions remain concrete dependencies before source selection.

iroi.burst_primary_packet_v1: An ordinary Iroi UltraSkill cast delivers the canonical GE_Player_Oneiroi_UltraSkill_Damage primary packet once at the selected impact timestamp, using the admitted effective Burst talent coordinate and native ATK array. This hypothesis covers only the direct packet; the sourced one-time post-cast heal has its own bounded model assumption. Conditional continuous healing, continuous damage, Imagination threshold/cost, dream duration and Regression revival remain unsupported; no periodic ticks or extra targets are inferred.

iroi.dream_state_v1: Burst admission captures Moon >= 30 as Ivory (direct UltraSkill damage and pulses) or Horn (healing only). Initial pause release at 4.0047474s starts 8 Moon/s drain, blocking all Moon gains. Every 1s provides periodic team heal and Ivory pulse until Moon reaches 0.

iroi.live_atk_healing_v1: Iroi ordinary Skill and the currently bound one-time Burst healing scale their frozen 13-level .943/1.413 starting coefficients from live source final ATK, superseding the historical MaxHP model. The accepted owner card's recovered GetAtk calculator owns this stat choice; the native coefficients are unchanged. Read compiled source ATK plus base-scaled live ATK percentages and flat buffs, including applicable equipped passive stats, at each real recipient callback without creating a damage packet or applying damage/crit/target modifiers. Apply source outgoing and recipient incoming healing bonuses, including selected A3 exactly once, then round gross once and clamp to missing HP. Each living recipient gets its actual settlement and positive gross, including overheal, may trigger compatible equipment. Dead sources and recipients do not heal or trigger listeners. Effective admitted talent coordinates are preserved. Skill's existing callback-at-admission and Burst's existing post-impact callback timing remain explicitly bounded caller models; native montage dispatch, QTE/A2 healing, Dream periodic healing, Moon gains and application-level B4/A5 dispatch remain separate queued bindings. This does not certify a complete Iroi kit.

Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Seed lasts five World seconds and Bud a further twenty-five, with one live-ATK native Normal-talent Attachment packet per World second, including both phase endpoints, and one native BudEnd settlement after the thirtieth tick.
