Set count declares matching geometry; native parameter-caller and clock applicability remain hypotheses. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.marching_beyond_time_v1: Marching Beyond Time adds its frozen ATK ratio unconditionally. An admitted wearer Redirect Skill enters Wastelab and clears stacks; each admitted Redirect Skill or Support Skill by another living teammate while Wastelab is active adds one stack up to three, including off-field wearer observation. An admitted wearer Ultimate exits Wastelab and consumes current stacks; only while active it adds base State Crit DMG plus per-stack Crit DMG to every packet delivered from that Ultimate command, including delayed packets. Three consumed stacks also grant wearer-only DEF ignore beginning at Ultimate admission and ending exactly at the frozen duration boundary; each hit samples it at delivery. Rejected inputs, other roles, stack overflow, and Ultimates outside Wastelab do not trigger those effects. These action-time, recipient, and expiry boundaries are explicit tested hypotheses; frozen data does not establish Global release availability.

weapons.reality_refuge_v2: Reality Refuge adds its frozen Anima ratio to wearer Nature packets and its frozen Attachment ratio to wearer Attachment packets in one additive damage-bonus zone. Jiuyuan natural Seed/Bud and BudEnd now supply native Attachment packets through jiuyuan.natural_pact_v1, retaining live wearer ATK, Normal talent, source-target identity and continuing clocks. Successful wearer Ultimate admission refreshes one six-second self window replacing the base Attachment ratio with the refinement Ultimate value; bonuses do not stack, and off-field delivery samples the current window. Exact expiry precedes an equal-time hit; another actor's Ultimate cannot grant or refresh the wearer window. Native cast/clock semantics remain checked assumptions, and unbound active Pact settlement and character branches remain separate limits. This supersedes v1's inert-Attachment roster limit without certifying native callback execution or Global availability.

weapons.rishi_v2: Eclipse grants the wearer its frozen ATK percentage unconditionally, joining the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum. The ratio is not a final, special, or multiplicative factor. Arc: Eclipse: explicit Arc admission by the living active wearer outside recovery creates a 40s Eclipse field; each wearer-credited enemy defeat during the field restores flat frozen energy (6/7/8/9/10 per T1-T5) up to 5 defeats per field; re-creating the field waits a 300s arc cooldown. Arc activation uses the shared action admission and cooldown service, with no HP or energy cost and no added recovery under the bounded instantaneous field-creation model. Ultimate casts alone create no field. Wearer-kill credit (not team kills), field-window boundaries, charge scaling and instantaneous activation remain tested hypotheses. The energy grant flows through actor.grant_energy, so it scales by charge_multiplier (tested; native scaling unknown). Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog. A dead wearer cannot claim further field defeats or activate pending field/energy callbacks. A grant already reserved before death is skipped without changing energy, overflow or carry; its consumed defeat slot and admitted cooldown are not refunded. Living off-field wearers remain eligible. Delivery-time living eligibility is a bounded inference consistent with living-recipient team generation and absence of a revival rule, not native callback proof.

weapons.the_wrong_gate_healing_v1: The Wrong Gate's static ATK percentage applies to the wearer on every hit. An Edgar Ultimate or Iroi ordinary Skill healing callback triggers only when the living equipped wearer heals a living team actor and the once-rounded pre-cap amount is positive; a full-HP overheal qualifies. After settlement, one shared-name reset effect grants the wearer Anima (NATURE) DMG and every other living configured team actor general DMG for 20 world seconds. Repeated triggers refresh at callback time; source attribution is the latest trigger and buffs capture a snapshot that persists if its source later dies. Failed/dead-recipient callbacks and nonpositive rounded healing do not trigger. These trigger, recipient, clock, order, snapshot, and shared-name rules are tested hypotheses because the frozen descriptions do not specify them. Global release availability remains unverified.

zero.a1_first_hit_v1: Zero A1 triggers on the first nonzero connected Skill hit per admitted activation and target, only when target level <= Zero level. Prefer the explicit Chinese not-above-level condition over the English lower-level translation; child packets cannot retrigger and retain the struck target.

zero.burst_a3_crit_rate_v1: Zero A3 Anomalies Record adds 0.50 to ordinary crit rate for each native Burst packet, in addition to static, live, and gear crit rate; normal packet eligibility and the shared 1.0 crit-rate clamp still apply. The native 1046AwakenEffect Effect3 text and DT_Female051EffectFigure Female051_LV3 support the value; additive stacking is the tested interpretation.

zero.burst_a4_damage_bonus_v1: Zero A4 Undecided Factors adds min(compiled base ATK × DT_Female051EffectFigure Female051_LV4_2, Female051_LV4_3) to the ordinary damage-bonus zone for native Burst packets. The 1046AwakenEffect Effect4 text and Female051_LV4_1/2/3 figures bind the formula; assignment to the additive damage-bonus zone is an explicit tested hypothesis.

zero.burst_all_in_range_v1: Zero Burst delivers its ordered seven-packet train to every eligible scenario-declared dummy under the all-in-range dummy contract: by scenario definition all eligible dummies are in range and inside attack areas, so no position, radius, shape, or placement check gates delivery. Targets are delivered in ascending target_index order; for each target, UltraSkill1, UltraSkill2 four times, UltraSkill3, then UltraSkill4 (target-major order), all at the admitted primary impact time. Defeated or otherwise ineligible dummies keep their existing skip rules. This is a declared scenario rule, not a claim about native AoE geometry; native recipient caps/selection/distribution and packet spacing remain unresolved.

zero.burst_packets_v1: Zero Burst delivers native UltraSkill1 once, UltraSkill2 four times, UltraSkill3 once, and UltraSkill4 once, in that order, matching DT_GameplayAbilityTipsData.GA_Female046_UltraSkill.GALevelUpArray[0] and each native DT_SkillDamageData row. All seven packets use the admitted primary impact time and target 0, the simulator's current default target. Native packet intervals remain unresolved.

zero.cosmos_cycle_atk_v1: Resonance 6 Zero grants each living party member, including Zero, 12% base-ATK-scaled ATK for 20 World seconds on a qualified Cosmos Cycle for which Zero pays the outgoing Cycle cost. The outgoing payer identifies the trigger independently of the higher-CI reaction damage owner. The same carrier refreshes without stacking and persists through field exit. The published trigger wording and frozen amount/duration inform this selected ownership and lifetime model.

zero.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Zero character:1046 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Zero COSMOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

zero.skill_packets_v1: Zero ordinary Skill delivers Skill1, Skill2, Skill3, and Skill4 once each from one admitted cast, matching the four ordered ratios in frozen neverness_zero and native DT_SkillDamageData rows. The admitted Skill fills this owner's Cycle pool to its existing capacity of 100 once, including semantic Hotori replay, independently of damage recipient count, ordinary energy and hit-generated channels. Existing charge is retained without duplicate grant or overflow. Cast-time fill is the selected interpretation of the published instant-Cycle Skill; native callback timing remains unverified. Children use the admitted primary impact time; animation intervals and travel are unresolved.

entries.label: Mint · Blossom
assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.single_packet_support_v1: Single-packet qualified Support actions use their owner packet, purchased QTE coordinate, recovered or documented bounded timing, and owner-local recovery gates. Living in-range dummy recipients share one packet's ordinary Charge and connected owner effects.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

fireflies.all_in_range_v1: Under the all-in-range dummy contract the source's "nearby enemy" condition is a declared scenario rule: every eligible scenario-declared dummy is nearby by definition, so no position, radius, shape or placement check gates the trigger on a connected Anima hit. Defeated dummies never produce connected hits and keep their existing skip rules; the source must be living. This is not a claim about native proximity radius or recipient selection; native trigger consumer behavior remains unresolved.

fireflies.team_anima_hit_v1: A connected, nonzero elemental Anima packet from any living team member grants one independent Fireflies CRIT DMG stack to each living team member wearing Fireflies, including off-field wearers. A wearer does not grant an extra stack merely for being the source; each wearer receives exactly one stack per packet.

gear.cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Ultimate admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Weapon and set effects retain their own recipient, stacking and expiry policies. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis; native animation timing remains unresolved.

hotori.katana_chain_v1: While Hotori's World's Tide Time Stop is active, an admitted Basic input selects the five-stage Q-category Katana chain instead of the ordinary Normal chain: stage1 delivers one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkillMelee1_Damage, stage2 one UltraSkillMelee2 plus one UltraSkillMelee2_1, stage3 three UltraSkillMelee3 plus one UltraSkillMelee3_1, stage4 one UltraSkillMelee4 plus UltraSkillMelee4_1..4_3, and stage5 one UltraSkillMelee5 plus one UltraSkillMelee5_1, all Cosmos with zero raw energy, Cycle and Break. Each admitted input increments the count marker once at its native marker time regardless of misses, up to exactly 10; inputs 1..10 select stages 1..5 twice and the count persists across both subchains. At exactly 10 the next Basic selects one finisher instead of a stage, does not increment the count, and ordinary legal inputs cannot reach 11. The finisher is one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkillMelee6_Damage, replaced by one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkillMelee6Pas2_Damage when breakthrough4 enables Passive2, and never both rows. Each input delivers its stage's local source hits at the selected real offsets to every eligible dummy under hotori.aoe_all_in_range_dummy_v1, with live talent and modifier sampling; inputs chain through the native queued-next windows, stage source pauses and Any recoveries, the finisher keeps its recovery in real time and ends the Time Stop benefits at its damage delivery. No Timepiece, stamina or conventional Ultimate Energy is paid per Katana input. Mode end or a new World's Tide resets the count, an already admitted stage may finish after expiry with live mode bonuses removed, no finisher is manufactured at count9 or on expiry, and after the mode the next Basic returns to ordinary Entry1. Count markers, stage input starts and the finisher hit are checked exact scheduling choices, not native-body observations.

hotori.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Hotori character:1052 only, any reachable ordinary Normal, Skill, Burst or Katana native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd (an explicit zero for the Q rows) once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Hotori COSMOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Branch, AirAttack, PerfectEvadeAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet trains remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

hotori.skill_burst_packets_v1: Hotori Present Replay delivers seven Skill hits on target zero at the native real coordinates (four GE_Player_Jin_Skill1_Damage and two GE_Player_Jin_Skill3_Damage following the Skill.3/Skill.1 schedule, plus one final GE_Player_Jin_Skill2_Damage) with total Any recovery 1.4086605 after the final hit's 0.1 source pause. World's Tide delivers ten UltraSkill hits (one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill1_Damage, five GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill1_1..5_Damage, one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill2_Damage, one GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill4_Damage, and two GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill3_Damage) at their native post-entry coordinates with no source pause. All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently, and every packet hits all eligible dummies under hotori.aoe_all_in_range_dummy_v1. Delivery at those source coordinates is the selected timing hypothesis and does not model travel. Katana stage and finisher packets are covered by hotori.katana_chain_v1.

hotori.time_stop_clock_v1: World's Tide commitment opens its generation-owned cinematic pause; entry at action progress+2.183333 seconds transitions the same owner to active Time Stop, ending at the earlier finisher delivery, reserved deadline entry+12 seconds, forced cancellation or death. Overlapping pauses count once in relative combat time. Shared paused-world timers include ordinary cooldowns, buffs, status and periodic phases, passive resource recovery and incoming attacks; retained remainders resume without backlog. Only the finite committing cinematic and permitted Katana/replay action contexts advance through their own supported pause, and unrelated cinematics still dominate. Reserved-stop drain is independent of local hitlag. Deployed object lifetime advances during active stop while ordinary emissions pause; living B2 exempts Vita Bud emissions only, with lifetime and finite count still consumed. Explicit HP costs, grants and removals keep causal ordering. Damage rates use actual relative elapsed time; absolute timestamps retain event order. The conservative shared policy and object-lifetime distinction are explicit model assumptions, not observed native timer bodies.

hotori.timepiece_v1: Hotori character:1052 maintains one exact Timepiece account in[0,120] separate from conventional Ultimate Energy, Cycle, Charge and stamina. It starts at combat entry at 0; rotation boundaries never restore an initial value, and switching preserves it together with records, completed recording and paused-world cooldowns. Living Hotori recovers exactly 6 units per paused-world second whether on or off field, except while rewinding or during Burst setup and Time Stop; recovery clamps at 120 and reports the wasted overflow with no sixth-second polling. Present Replay requires living on field, ordinary permission, no active rewind or Time Stop, available_time strictly greater than 60 and paused-world Skill cooldown ready; at commit it spends exactly 60 once, suspends passive recovery, invalidates previous records and any pending A3 refund, and opens a fixed five-second recording interval at Skill+0.16747499 whose 60-unit rewind reservation settles at Skill+5.16747499 without a second deduction, resuming passive recovery with the post-payment remainder. World's Tide requires living Hotori on field, ordinary permission, no rewind or Time Stop, available_time equal to 120 and cooldown ready; at commit it atomically reserves all 120, stops passive and A3, freezes the record count for A1, and resets A4 and Katana counts; the reserved budget drains from setup entry at 10 per second, a finisher ends the mode early discarding the remainder, and interrupt or death before entry spends the committed 120 and cancels pending entry and replay. A3 selected starts an additional 6 per second refund of exactly 60 after a completed recording and full rewind settlement when its 60-second ICD from refund start is ready; any new Timepiece expenditure cancels the outstanding remainder while ordinary hits and switches do not. A4 grants 10 Timepiece per credited team kill while living and not rewinding, not during Burst reservation, setup or Time Stop, up to 3 accepted callbacks since the last actual World's Tide commit, counting the callback at cap with overflow lost and resetting only on World's Tide; kills during rewind do not consume an opportunity. Death cancels recording and Time Stop, discards reservations and disables passive recovery until revive, which keeps the retained pool. Held branch control, native-body deduction timing, copy-cooldown branches and any geometry interaction remain outside this model.

No tick executes on application or conversion. Selected A2 doubles only periodic coefficients. The Pact continues off field and stops after source or target defeat; no death settlement is emitted. Natural settlement retains the target attachment for its two-tenths-second closing interval. Current direct-action clocks and Normal5 target-zero policy remain the existing admitted models. Burst force-growth/active settlement, powered-shot consumption, ammo and reaction planting remain unbound separate branches. Native periodic endpoint and contact ordering are checked product assumptions, not observed native callbacks.

mint.ordinary_clock_v1: Mint canonical ordinary Normal, Skill and Burst use the selected rate-one source montage coordinates rounded once to nearest microseconds, not measured game playback. Explicit positive contact pauses integrate actor-local slowdown at rate.01, once per causal packet across stationary dummy recipients; missing durations and zero HP loss add none. All living eligible dummies receive each selected ordinary packet, without geometry. Native Normal stages retain2/1/2/1/2 packets, reset only on a greater-than2s input-start gap or a different ability/field exit, and keep the existing resource callbacks. Native source initializes the owner clock before entry and submits approach, Jump/declared landing, paid controls and family windows to these same native gates; its Burst cooldown is15 World seconds. The frozen scheduled Studio adapter retains its separate caller-timing scope until Phase4. The selected source timing and cancellation policies remain revisable hypotheses.

weapons.reality_refuge_v2: Reality Refuge adds its frozen Anima ratio to wearer Nature packets and its frozen Attachment ratio to wearer Attachment packets in one additive damage-bonus zone. Jiuyuan natural Seed/Bud and BudEnd now supply native Attachment packets through jiuyuan.natural_pact_v1, retaining live wearer ATK, Normal talent, source-target identity and continuing clocks. Successful wearer Ultimate admission refreshes one six-second self window replacing the base Attachment ratio with the refinement Ultimate value; bonuses do not stack, and off-field delivery samples the current window. Exact expiry precedes an equal-time hit; another actor's Ultimate cannot grant or refresh the wearer window. Native cast/clock semantics remain checked assumptions, and unbound active Pact settlement and character branches remain separate limits. This supersedes v1's inert-Attachment roster limit without certifying native callback execution or Global availability.

weapons.rishi_v2: Eclipse grants the wearer its frozen ATK percentage unconditionally, joining the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum. The ratio is not a final, special, or multiplicative factor. Arc: Eclipse: explicit Arc admission by the living active wearer outside recovery creates a 40s Eclipse field; each wearer-credited enemy defeat during the field restores flat frozen energy (6/7/8/9/10 per T1-T5) up to 5 defeats per field; re-creating the field waits a 300s arc cooldown. Arc activation uses the shared action admission and cooldown service, with no HP or energy cost and no added recovery under the bounded instantaneous field-creation model. Ultimate casts alone create no field. Wearer-kill credit (not team kills), field-window boundaries, charge scaling and instantaneous activation remain tested hypotheses. The energy grant flows through actor.grant_energy, so it scales by charge_multiplier (tested; native scaling unknown). Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog. A dead wearer cannot claim further field defeats or activate pending field/energy callbacks. A grant already reserved before death is skipped without changing energy, overflow or carry; its consumed defeat slot and admitted cooldown are not refunded. Living off-field wearers remain eligible. Delivery-time living eligibility is a bounded inference consistent with living-recipient team generation and absence of a revival rule, not native callback proof.

zero.a1_first_hit_v1: Zero A1 triggers on the first nonzero connected Skill hit per admitted activation and target, only when target level <= Zero level. Prefer the explicit Chinese not-above-level condition over the English lower-level translation; child packets cannot retrigger and retain the struck target.

zero.burst_a3_crit_rate_v1: Zero A3 Anomalies Record adds 0.50 to ordinary crit rate for each native Burst packet, in addition to static, live, and gear crit rate; normal packet eligibility and the shared 1.0 crit-rate clamp still apply. The native 1046AwakenEffect Effect3 text and DT_Female051EffectFigure Female051_LV3 support the value; additive stacking is the tested interpretation.

zero.burst_a4_damage_bonus_v1: Zero A4 Undecided Factors adds min(compiled base ATK × DT_Female051EffectFigure Female051_LV4_2, Female051_LV4_3) to the ordinary damage-bonus zone for native Burst packets. The 1046AwakenEffect Effect4 text and Female051_LV4_1/2/3 figures bind the formula; assignment to the additive damage-bonus zone is an explicit tested hypothesis.

zero.burst_all_in_range_v1: Zero Burst delivers its ordered seven-packet train to every eligible scenario-declared dummy under the all-in-range dummy contract: by scenario definition all eligible dummies are in range and inside attack areas, so no position, radius, shape, or placement check gates delivery. Targets are delivered in ascending target_index order; for each target, UltraSkill1, UltraSkill2 four times, UltraSkill3, then UltraSkill4 (target-major order), all at the admitted primary impact time. Defeated or otherwise ineligible dummies keep their existing skip rules. This is a declared scenario rule, not a claim about native AoE geometry; native recipient caps/selection/distribution and packet spacing remain unresolved.

zero.burst_packets_v1: Zero Burst delivers native UltraSkill1 once, UltraSkill2 four times, UltraSkill3 once, and UltraSkill4 once, in that order, matching DT_GameplayAbilityTipsData.GA_Female046_UltraSkill.GALevelUpArray[0] and each native DT_SkillDamageData row. All seven packets use the admitted primary impact time and target 0, the simulator's current default target. Native packet intervals remain unresolved.

zero.cosmos_cycle_atk_v1: Resonance 6 Zero grants each living party member, including Zero, 12% base-ATK-scaled ATK for 20 World seconds on a qualified Cosmos Cycle for which Zero pays the outgoing Cycle cost. The outgoing payer identifies the trigger independently of the higher-CI reaction damage owner. The same carrier refreshes without stacking and persists through field exit. The published trigger wording and frozen amount/duration inform this selected ownership and lifetime model.

zero.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Zero character:1046 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Zero COSMOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

zero.skill_packets_v1: Zero ordinary Skill delivers Skill1, Skill2, Skill3, and Skill4 once each from one admitted cast, matching the four ordered ratios in frozen neverness_zero and native DT_SkillDamageData rows. The admitted Skill fills this owner's Cycle pool to its existing capacity of 100 once, including semantic Hotori replay, independently of damage recipient count, ordinary energy and hit-generated channels. Existing charge is retained without duplicate grant or overflow. Cast-time fill is the selected interpretation of the published instant-Cycle Skill; native callback timing remains unverified. Children use the admitted primary impact time; animation intervals and travel are unresolved.

zero.support_packets_v1: Zero Support QTE delivers the frozen Cosmos/category-H QTE1 and QTE2 packets once each, with the second impact 0.250 seconds after the admitted first impact. Engine entry timing is 0.100/0.350 seconds, 0.600-second recovery, from the reviewed Zero card's bounded timing model rather than measured native montage seconds. Both uncapped packets hit all living script-authored stationary dummies in range and read live owner/target stats; each packet grants its frozen 2.899/4.801 raw energy once across recipients on its first positive hit, without granting Cycle. The purchased Support talent coordinate applies to both packets; the frozen Zero resonance row upgrades Normal/Skill/Burst only, so it grants no QTE level despite the older card summary. Child projection uses the actual admitted action coordinate even when the source command is a switch or another implicit action, preserving the original command and Support switch origin. Zero A5's existing ten-percent base-ATK buff is granted once on admission before both impacts. Switching alone preserves launched follow-ups; source defeat cancels pending owner hits, while defeated targets simply miss that packet. Exact target caps and native cast/eligibility timing remain unverified; this is an explicit all-in-range dummy model, not geometry or enemy identity.

entries.label: Zankou A1 · Break / Daffodill A2
assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

adler.a5_burst_energy_refund_v1: When Adler awakening effect 5 is selected, one successful native GA_Adler_UltraSkill admission schedules a same-time ProcCallback restoring 20 whole Ultimate Energy to the captured Adler. This flat refund uses restore_energy, so Charge Efficiency and fractional carry do not scale or consume it; capacity excess is overflow. It is independent of hit delivery, target count and later field switches, but requires the captured owner to remain alive when the callback runs. Frozen 1033AwakenEffect.json Effect5 localized text says Adler gains 20 Ultimate Energy when casting Tranquility and DT_AdlerEffectFigure.Adler_lv5=20; the exact native timing/applicability remains unverified. Optional PC_140 ChargeExecution20 does not establish runtime wiring. Other awakening mechanics remain pending.

adler.blessing_party_interception_v1: Adler Blessing shield acts as a party shield pool that protects the current living active actor, following field ownership on switch without resetting capacity, snapshot or expiry.

adler.blessing_r6_v1: At hit delivery, a living Adler with six selected awakening effects grants one additive +10 percentage-point Incantation damage bonus to all team Incantation packets while any living actor holds that Adler source's positive, nonexpired Blessing shield. The packet owner and active field actor do not affect eligibility; shield depletion, half-open expiry, recipient death or source Adler death removes the bonus. Multiple eligible sources enable the same single +10% contribution without stacking. This is a tested bounded hypothesis based on 1033AwakenEffect.json resonance_6 text; the referenced Buff_Adler033_Level6_extra blueprint does not expose its property or protected-actor predicate in frozen evidence. DamageUpIncantationBase identifies the matching native-style stat, and the bonus is modeled in the additive damage-bonus zone.

adler.blessing_shield_v1: On successful GA_Adler_Skill admission, capture the current active actor and Adler's exact effective DEF (base DEF scaled by static+live DefUp, then static+live flat DEF); a same-time ProcCallback grants that captured actor a shield using the native flat+coefficient curve at the effective Skill level. The grant samples Adler's static+live outgoing ShieldEfficiency and adds 20% capacity only when awakening effect 3 is selected, in the same additive shield-bonus zone, then rounds once. Resonance count does not substitute for effect 3. Recasting replaces only this Adler source shield on that recipient; the shield persists across switching, expires at its half-open deadline, and recipient death clears it. Shield amount is a cast-time snapshot. This is a tested bounded hypothesis because native source tables do not establish recipient snapshot, stat snapshot or ShieldEfficiency stacking.

adler.burst_intervals_v1: Adler Burst delivers five Sunya projectiles at 2.1851034s and a second conditional five-projectile volley at 2.343074s if exactly one dummy was living at admission. A1 (+20 Karma) and A5 (+20 flat Ultimate Energy) callbacks occur at UltraSkill.2 (2.343074s) if the source is alive.

adler.karma_v1: A connected modeled Deliverance normal-chain packet grants one held Karma stack; a connected aimed Liberation packet grants two; each grant is capped at 20. A successful Tranquility admission adds 20 stacks only when effect 1 is selected, up to the same cap. Skill admission captures and clears all held stacks before damage. Optional PC_140 decoded AdlerSkill_DamUp and Buff_AdlerQiHai_SkillDamUP assets reconstruct additive FinalDamageUp of 2% per captured stack, selected as 3% only when effect 2 is selected; Global cutoff applicability and runtime reachability are unproven. The frozen .01 Adler_lv2 figure and localized descriptions conflict, and a separate live-held A2 general damage bonus is omitted to avoid double application of this Skill carrier. Karma gain follows its connected packet; zero-damage, unmodeled melee siblings, and other Karma producers remain unsupported.

adler.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Adler character:1033 only, modeled ordinary Normal, aimed Normal, and GA_Adler_Skill native packets grant their exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. Skill2's native initial row has ChargeAdd 4; Skill3 siblings and Skill_Damage periodic rows have zero and grant nothing. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Adler INCANTATION are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, defensive passives, alternate forms, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.
adler.righteous_heart_v1: Adler Breakthrough 4 passive Righteous Heart adds .20 DEF% to Adler base-DEF zone, active in party on/off field.

adler.skill_all_in_range_dummy_v1: For one admitted GA_Adler_Skill command, capture every living scenario-declared dummy in ascending target_index at admission; the product scenario assumes each is in range and in the attack area, with no geometry, recipient cap, or distribution check. Schedule one modeled Skill2/Skill3x2 initial train and one +1s through +10s periodic train per captured target. The target-zero primary packet supplies its Skill2; child packets supply Skill2 on other captured targets. Initial packet delivery and each periodic stream recheck target survival; all streams share owner survival and the cast generation, so recasting replaces them together. One Skill command spends its action cost once. Additional Skill2 packets do not extend the currently target-zero-only energy adapter. This is a product dummy semantic, not a native target selection/count/cap/geometry claim.

adler.skill_train_v1: Under the separate adler.skill_all_in_range_dummy_v1 product assumption, schedule one Skill2 and two Skill3 coincident initial DEF packets and GE_Player_Adler_Skill_Damage at +1s through +10s inclusive for each living captured target. The mapped initial Skill2 row and published 70% DEF x3 description disagree about multiplicity; Skill3 activation is not proven, and using it twice is a bounded numeric-three-hit hypothesis. The 1s/10s frozen figure curves ground the tick train, but exact impact/refresh timing is assumed. At Skill admission, consumed Karma is captured and cleared; each captured stack adds 2% FinalDamageUp, or 3% only when Adler awakening effect 2 is selected, to every packet admitted by that Skill command, including initial packets that deliver after a later recast. This uses optional PC_140 decoded AdlerSkill_DamUp and Buff_AdlerQiHai_SkillDamUP evidence (Global cutoff applicability and runtime reachability unproven); the frozen .01 A2 figure and localized descriptions conflict, and no separate held-stack general A2 bonus is modeled to avoid double applying the reconstructed FinalDamageUp carrier. Recast cancels only the old periodic train; living owners continue off-field, defeated owners cancel, and each defeated target stops its own future ticks. One admission spends action cost once; complete kit behavior remains pending.

adler.temperance_v1: Living Breakthrough 2 Adler selects one of the three source-ordered Temperance target effects on each successful Scorch application or refresh, including off field. Selection uses a separate seeded unbiased uniform stream, an inference from the unweighted source candidate array. Each result has its own 15 World second cap-one timer: subtract 20% of original target ATK, reduce Physical, all six Esper channels and Mental resistance by 10 percentage points, or add 10 percentage points to incoming Break efficiency. Target defeat clears the statuses. Existing selections survive source defeat until expiry. Authored incoming damage is independent of dummy ATK.

character.adler.skill_dot_packet_semantics_v1: Treat only Adler GE_Player_Adler_Skill_Damage as State.Damage and State.Damage.Dot because its frozen periodic Skill description schedules this exact effect. This packet-semantic mapping is a bounded hypothesis; the separate Skill model owns scheduling, target scope, recast, and duration.

character.zankou.crimson_reverie_v1: Zankou Crimson Reverie sets her living owner's Cycle pool to exactly one hundred once at scenario combat entry, replacing the authored starting value without adding Ultimate Energy. Field returns, waits and continuing cycles never repeat that initialization. One permanent nonstacking self modifier adds one hundred Cycle Intensity stat points to Zankou on or off field; teammates receive none. It composes with her authored and equipped CI before live/captured reaction consumers. An initially defeated owner receives no entry Cycle. Current player Passive2 configuration and its self carrier establish the recipient correction from the earlier team-aura shortcut. The thirty-second entry cooldown has no second combat entry to govern in this single-combat model.

character.zankou.dot_packet_semantics_v1: Treat the exact Zankou GE_Player_Zankou_DotDamage and GE_Player_Zankou_DotUltraDamage packet rows as DoT damage sources carrying State.Damage, State.Damage.Dot, and State.Damage.Melee. This maps the researched serialized periodic-effect source tags; it does not model stack application, target spreading, or periodic scheduling.

character.zankou.silent_sunset_v1: With a living team Zankou, qualified Scorch uses one source-preserving target aggregate capped at three stacks. Initial application gives one stack; further qualified applications and each connected ordinary DoT delivery on that live enhanced target add one, cap at three, and refresh fifteen seconds without resetting the .99-second tick phase or adding an immediate tick. A DoT-triggered replacement is a newly inflicted Scorch by Zankou: all existing stacks take his live level, Cycle Intensity, Incantation element and captured ordinary plus DoT crit damage, using the shared Scorch base and fixed fifty-percent crit policy. It does not copy the ally's applied HP damage or its DoT coefficient/duration. This selects the description's newly inflicted effect as the new Scorch and the native carrier's fifteen-second/.99-second clocks. Replacement receipts retain the original switch and link the exact earlier triggering hit separately from the new damage owner. Scorch's own ticks cannot trigger this effect; zero HP-loss connected DoT hits may, following the reached callback's absent positive-damage gate. Dead Zankou cannot create replacements; existing captured Scorch remains independent. R6 kill enhancement, native prediction/callback fidelity and unbound ordinary Skill application remain outside this model.

combat.control_effects_v1: A content owner may request a finite control effect after a connected delivered hit. The anonymous dummy's authored control_immune flag defaults false and is independent of Boss classification, airborne inputs and damage magnitude. A living source can control a living nonimmune recipient; a defeated source/target or immune recipient produces no successful-control receipt or status. Positive exact hits that round to zero HP loss still reach after-hit control, distinct from positive-HP-loss consumers. Successful applications preserve source actor, actual target and parent command, record exact world-time duration/expiry and apply one target-scoped status. Control represents gameplay eligibility only, without movement, geometry or target AI. Source death does not erase an already applied finite target effect. Native immunity and after-hit ordering remain explicit scenario/owner hypotheses.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

daffodil.action_cancels_v1: Daffodil action cancels require ordinary_clock_v1. Jump and Skill use the selected native stage gates through the same owner lost-progress clock; an ordinary invalid early input does not interrupt. Accepted Jump/replacement removes unreached montage requests and resets the Normal pointer without refunding costs or captured Resonance. A new montage inherits any still-live owner pause, while World deadlines retain their exact remaining duration through shared pauses. Explicit forced interruption releases recovery and cancels pending montage work; pre-notify Skill starts3s cancel cooldown at interruption, post-notify retains its original16s deadline. A completed cast is not interrupted retroactively. This binds finite source gates and causal cancellation, not airborne geometry, paid Dodge, suspended combo or a recovered native interruption body.

daffodil.branch_entry_direct_packet_energy_v1: For Daffodil character:1054 only, an explicitly modeled GA_Daffodill_Melee Branch1-7 or EntryAttack1/2/4 direct packet grants its frozen DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the frozen source-element to recipient-element coefficient from DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (3/5 for Daffodil CHAOS), then applies their own Charge Efficiency, exact fractional carry, capacity and overflow accounting. This exact direct-input policy is a tested hypothesis, not evidence of native eligibility. Natural Branch/Entry dispatch, animation, timing, target rules, jump/dodge legality, stamina, costs, cadence, extra packets, other targets and callbacks remain unresolved; Branch6/7 are frozen packet rows without a published-tip binding.

daffodil.insight_break_capture_v1: Finale applies independent source-owned target Insight: one refreshed stack for 45 seconds, or up to two stacks with shared refreshed 9999-second expiry at selected A3. Self Eyes remains 30 seconds at every awakening. At a new target Break, selected A4 adds 0.15 Break bonus per own Insight stack and A5 adds one captured own contribution per stack. Capture uses this recipient and source only; marks survive field exit/source death, expire half-open, and clear on target death. Base roster contributions precede repeats in source-slot order; defeated recipients cancel pending contributions. This is a bounded owner model, not proof of native callbacks or montage timing; R6 Broken Chaos shred remains unbound.

daffodil.ordinary_clock_v1: Daffodil's selected finite Normal, ordinary/Echoes Skill and Finale montage coordinates advance on real combat time, rounded once to nearest microsecond. Each connected causal request adds its integrated native duration*(1-rate) lost progress only to this owner montage, once across all dummy recipients. Unconnected requests add no pause. Every request retains its native row, captured talent and distinct energy group; AoE does not multiply Charge or Cycle. Normal continuation lasts through actual recovery plus2s. Skill's16s cooldown begins at its reached ordinary.182290/Echoes.110328 marker; Finale costs120 and starts20s cooldown at admission, applying self Eyes and target Insight at progress0. Replacement/field exit cancels unreached montage requests without refund. This is the checked source-coordinate product model, not measured animation timing or a global time stop; secondary actions and entry have separate acceptance.

daffodil.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Daffodil character:1054 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Daffodil CHAOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, Branch, AirAttack, EntryAttack, PerfectEvadeAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

daffodil.phantom_step_v1: Daffodil Phantom Step is funded only by a successful Finale progress-0 reset to two uses with one World-time30s admission handle. A distinct-actor switch to a living Daffodil while the handle and a captured living target are live selects one Entry1/2/2_1/3/4 train; A2 adds Entry3_1. When a qualified entry also admits Support, use the QTE owner clock and the guarded AppearAttack transition at 1.150000 seconds of montage progress to start the full Step train. A successful pre-transition Support parry settles its finisher first. Each admitted Step spends one remaining charge. An explicit successful Daffodil parry before the Step final marker selects one AppearSuccess finisher; without it A2 alone selects that same single finisher. The one charge is committed at admitted entry and is not refunded by interruption, switching away or missing. The first positive finisher connection fills only Daffodil's energy pool to capacity once; other AoE recipients cannot duplicate it. The entry target and route are captured at admission. The owner-only Step clock uses source contact coordinates, pauses, and recovery; field exit or defeat cancels unreached packets while the independent charge deadline follows World time. The declared stationary-dummy model supplies no geometry or enemy response.

daffodil.resonance_skill_capture_v1: Each admitted native-role party Support grants one persistent Daffodil Resonance stack, capped at two. Skill consumes and captures its pool at admission: per stack general Skill damage +0.50 and additive Break Efficiency +1.25, replaced by +1.00 and +2.50 at selected A1. Two stacks select six Skill3 packets and one Skill4 finisher (Echoes). Later Supports affect only the next pool; failed admission consumes nothing. This bounded owner model does not establish native animation timing or automatic Support eligibility.

daffodil.secondary_actions_v1: Daffodil secondary actions require ordinary_clock_v1 and action_cancels_v1. Plunge uses authored positive landing time and height0..1, one native.424ATK level1 landing request, recovery.281249s and connected.0396s lost progress. Ordinary front/back Dodge pays shared declared stamina15 and its selected1.014541/1.007068s owner recovery, with immunity only until that action is cancelled or completes. One explicit successful paid Critical Dodge authorizes the next canonical Normal as Close Call, one1.04ATK level1 request with.874201s recovery and connected.297s lost progress; another non-Normal input, field exit or defeat clears authorization. Qualified adjacent-element switching admits one actual Support/QTE instead of a raw authored packet, at.745033s with.900691s recovery plus connected.34965s lost progress and.863029s switch lock. The summon designates an enemy at spawn and refreshes designation every 5 seconds, preferring living locked targets else lowest index. The wearer gains its frozen Chaos damage bonus against designated enemies. When a designated enemy takes Break damage while the summon is active, the wearer deals an immediate Chaos ATK hit. Switching preserves the summon; death during startup cancels it, while ticks and designation stop on wearer death and pending hits cancel postmortem. combat.control_effects_v1: A content owner may request a finite control effect after a connected delivered hit. The anonymous dummy's authored control_immune flag defaults false and is independent of Boss classification, airborne inputs and damage magnitude. A living source can control a living nonimmune recipient; a defeated source/target or immune recipient produces no successful-control receipt or status. Positive exact hits that round to zero HP loss still reach after-hit control, distinct from positive-HP-loss consumers. Successful applications preserve source actor, actual target and parent command, record exact world-time duration/expiry and apply one target-scoped status. Control represents gameplay eligibility only, without movement, geometry or target AI. Source death does not erase an already applied finite target effect. Native immunity and after-hit ordering remain explicit scenario/owner hypotheses.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

sets.crimson_v1: Crimson: Twin Butterflies binds Incantation_4_1/4_2/4_3 to the four-piece description (.06/6/10). weapons.good_boy_v3: Good Boy retains the once-compiled additive Charge Efficiency from v2 and its admitted-Ultimate shared team ATK window. Expired windows, stale commands and an older wearer's control after another wearer replaced the shared snapshot cannot upgrade it. Ordinary Ultimate damage, mere airborne state, Boss metadata, other actors and non-Ultimate control are insufficient; the engine's actual successful-control receipt is required. entries.label: Lacrimosa · Quickswap / Nova
assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

combat.control_effects_v1: A content owner may request a finite control effect after a connected delivered hit. The anonymous dummy's authored control_immune flag defaults false and is independent of Boss classification, airborne inputs and damage magnitude. A living source can control a living nonimmune recipient; a defeated source/target or immune recipient produces no successful-control receipt or status. Positive exact hits that round to zero HP loss still reach after-hit control, distinct from positive-HP-loss consumers. Successful applications preserve source actor, actual target and parent command, record exact world-time duration/expiry and apply one target-scoped status. Control represents gameplay eligibility only, without movement, geometry or target AI. Source death does not erase an already applied finite target effect. Native immunity and after-hit ordering remain explicit scenario/owner hypotheses.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

Accepted Jump/replacement removes unreached montage requests and resets the Normal pointer without refunding costs or captured Resonance. A new montage inherits any still-live owner pause, while World deadlines retain their exact remaining duration through shared pauses. Explicit forced interruption releases recovery and cancels pending montage work; pre-notify Skill starts3s cancel cooldown at interruption, post-notify retains its original16s deadline. A completed cast is not interrupted retroactively. This binds finite source gates and causal cancellation, not airborne geometry, paid Dodge, suspended combo or a recovered native interruption body.

Burst, Branch, AirAttack, EntryAttack, PerfectEvadeAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. daffodil.phantom_step_v1: Daffodil Phantom Step is funded only by a successful Finale progress-0 reset to two uses with one World-time30s admission handle. A distinct-actor switch to a living Daffodil while the handle and a captured living target are live selects one Entry1/2/2_1/3/4 train; A2 adds Entry3_1. The owner-only Step clock uses source contact coordinates, pauses, and recovery; field exit or defeat cancels unreached packets while the independent charge deadline follows World time.
