haniel.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Haniel character:1020 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Haniel PSYCHE are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, enhanced/alternate forms, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

lacrimosa.broken_shatter_v1: Preserve the selected Lacrimosa Broken-target callback: each delivered ranged Melee4/Melee6 or ordinary Skill1 packet against an actively Broken dummy queues one B_Melee3_Explode child at the same real timestamp with coefficient0.686 and the content-owned shatter tag. The child retains the initiating action and target; its tag and owner-child binding share this hypothesis. This is the existing bounded trigger/timing/coefficient model, separate from the melee-chain projectile shatter; it does not establish native projectile dispatch or geometry.

lacrimosa.nightmare_all_targets_v1: Requires the separately accepted lacrimosa.nightmare_dot_scheduling_v1 model and extends it to all living declared dummies, including the uncapped Skill explosion. Each admitted Skill/Burst captures source, command, effective Normal-talent Blood coefficient and A0/A4 duration during admission, then applies five Nightmare stacks per living target in a ProcCallback at its primary impact time, after same-time HitDelivery. Dead sources apply nothing; target eligibility is rechecked at application. Each source/target retains an independent aggregate, expiry and NeverReset one-second grid; refresh cancels only that target's superseded ticks. Blood uses the effective Normal talent, including resonance, independently of Skill/Burst talent. Without this extension the legacy target-zero/cast-coordinate policy remains. The cap-20/remove-one-and-refresh model is retained despite the serialized cap-10 conflict; awakening variant/settlement/healing policies remain unresolved. Recipients, callback order and coordinate selection are bounded owner-model rules, not verified native dispatch.

lacrimosa.nightmare_dot_scheduling_v1: Lacrimosa GA_Lacrimosa_Skill and GA_Lacrimosa_UltraSkill casts apply the Nightmare blood DoT (GE_Player_Lacrimosa_Blood_Damage) to target zero: +5 stacks capped at 20, aggregate duration refreshed to 3s (6s when awakening effect 4 is selected). Ticks are pre-scheduled HitDelivery events on a 1s grid anchored at first application (NeverReset; first tick at +1s, no immediate tick) and rebuilt on every reapply; a reapply after full expiry re-anchors the grid. Stack expiry follows RemoveSingleStackAndRefreshDuration with expiry processed before a tick on coinciding timestamps. Each tick carries the native per-stack ATK ratio at the applying cast's talent coordinate and the State.Damage.Dot tag; the stack multiplier ratio*clamp(count-1,0,20) is added in the coefficient-addition zone from the live count at tick time (positive expansion bypass is modeled as never active). Melee, QTE, LV6 packet selection, E/Q value conflicts and per-application own-deadline expiry remain unbound; stack cap 20 conflicts with the serialized GE stack_limit=10. Tested bounded hypothesis; native executor, tick order and clock remain unproven.

lacrimosa.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Lacrimosa character:1004 only, a modeled ranged/melee Normal, Flavor Variation transition or ordinary Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Lacrimosa INCANTATION are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. The modeled melee projectile shatter has its own frozen ChargeAdd and qualifies once per delivered explosion. Burst, blood DoT, Sleep In cooldown resets, Discord, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

lacrimosa.ranged_normal_chain_v1: Lacrimosa Normal retains the existing ranged primary binding and advances five stages from frozen neverness_lacrimosa MeleeModA descriptions and native DT_SkillDamageData: Melee1; Melee2 x3; Melee3; Melee4 x3 plus Melee6; Melee5. The chain loops after stage five and resets on a different admitted ability, field exit or a gap greater than 2 seconds between input starts. Reset rules, gap and ordered coincident delivery at the research primary impact time are tested hypotheses pending animation/cancel evidence. This hypothesis covers the ranged chain only; travel, AoE, Nightmare DoT, Sleep In cooldown resets and complete kit behavior remain unsupported.

lacrimosa.skill_burst_packets_v1: Lacrimosa Morning Tomato delivers one Skill hit on target zero; Working Day Judgement delivers five UltraSkill hits (four GE_Player_Lacrimosa_UltraSkill1_Damage plus one GE_Player_Lacrimosa_UltraSkill2_Damage). All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, Nightmare DoT ticks or complete kit behavior.

lacrimosa.sleep_in_v1: Lacrimosa has one ordinary Skill cooldown, without stock charges or an independent12s recharge. Source selects16s at ordinary admission under its disclosed caller timing model; native notify/cancellation timing remains separate. During that live cooldown, five admitted ordinary Normal sections grant one Sleep In extra Skill. The grant waives remaining ordinary cooldown once, and its commit consumes the grant/counter while preserving the original ordinary deadline. Further sections cannot grant another extra in the same window. Ordinary expiry clears unused permission/counter; a new ordinary cast starts a fresh window. Counting is per admitted Normal section rather than per damage packet/recipient, independent of hit success and persistent through field exit. Existing selected melee-shatter cooldown reduction changes this one deadline rather than restoring invented stocks. Source cooldown selection, grant consumption and per-window bounds are explicit revisable model rules; native notify/interrupt behavior and stolen monster abilities are not established.

owner.action_role.character_1020_qte_v1: Classify this exact frozen character action as QTE because its DT_CharacterAbilityConfig identity names the owner action as QTE while DT_CharacterAbilityEffectConfig has no row; this role is an owner-reviewed model hypothesis for this ability only.

sakiri.burst_atk_v1: Current GA_Sagiri_UltraSkill activation independently requests ordinary Buff_Sagiri003_QDamUp and, only with node4, Buff_Sagiri003_Level4_1. Each adds30percent of the source GetAtkBase to other living teammates for20 World seconds, with no self grant. The separate cap1 carriers refresh rather than stack. Base includes compiled character and equipped weapon base ATK, excluding console flat/percent and recipient ATK. The selected managed snapshot lifetime survives source defeat; dead recipients receive no new grant and existing dead carriers contribute nothing. Actual admitted activation produces the grants, without hit or damage requirements. This explicit lifetime/recipient model does not simulate multiplayer global-component routing.

sakiri.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Sakiri character:1003 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Sakiri INCANTATION are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. The explicit GE_Player_Sagiri_AirAttack1_Damage packet input is excluded from this energy adapter; native plunge energy eligibility remains unresolved. Burst, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

sakiri.skill_burst_packets_v1: Sakiri Devour Whole delivers Skill1 and Skill2 once each on target zero; Feast of Gluttony delivers UltraSkill1 five times and UltraSkill2 once. All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, eating mode or complete kit behavior.

sakiri.suppress_v1: Sakiri's first connected Ultimate packet per admitted input and actual recipient attempts the source-bound Suppress effect once. Child pulses and other recipients retain their causal command identity; switching does not rearm an earlier attempt. Suppress lasts 3 World seconds, or 6 with selected A1, using Sagiri_Suppress and Sagiri_lv1_Suppress. Only successful control applies the Impish Trick child DEF reduction: one shared target instance subtracts 10 percent of authored base DEF for 20 seconds, independently of the shorter control lifetime. If base_def is omitted, authored total DEF is also the assumed base; an explicit base 1000/total 1500 yields 1400, not 1350. The reduction refreshes at the next successful control and clamps effective DEF at zero. These choices bind the recovered SKILL_EVENT_AFTER_HIT -> suppress object -> control marker and DEF-child chain, not every damage input or mere preexisting airborne state. Native control immunity, hybrid-server routing, exact application/capture clocks and passive unlock dispatch remain unverified; the reviewed baseline enables the passive. Other floating/Skill control and A5 transitions retain their separate owner limits.

sets.diabolos_v2: An equipped Diabolos four-piece wearer ignores twelve Chaos resistance percentage points for its own Chaos packets. On a qualified engine Esper Cycle admission that produces Nova or Scorch, both living outgoing/incoming actors are participants independently of captured reaction ownership; each equipped wearer receives one self-only twenty-second window before Cycle spend and reaction production. During that window the frozen twenty-four-point ignore replaces the baseline twelve, rather than adding to it. Further eligible participation refreshes the nonstacking window; field exit preserves its world-clock deadline and exact expiry restores the baseline. Ineligible switches, same-actor swaps, other reactions, nonwearers and non-Chaos packets receive no powered benefit. Participant effects are prepared atomically before publishing buffs/receipts. This extends the switch-based reaction model and supersedes v1's unconditional-only implementation; native participation dispatch and clock fidelity remain unverified.

sets.shadow_creed_v1: Shadow Creed binds Attack2_4_AtkUp/CD to the current four-piece description (.25/20), instead of conflicting Attack_4/CD (.35/10), as a description-matched hypothesis. It uses the selected ratio as a self base-ATK percentage. Successful Skill admission refreshes one nonstacking effect before its delivered hits; switching preserves it until world-time expiry. Set count declares matching geometry; native parameter-caller and clock applicability remain hypotheses. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.bit_game_v1: Blow up the Crowd (Beat King) increases the active character's ATK while the wearer is off-field, and dealing damage while off-field grants the active character an additional stacking ATK bonus up to 4 stacks with a 2.0s ICD, resetting when the wearer becomes active. While the wearer is active, it increases Psyche DMG dealt, and dealing Psyche DMG with Basic Attacks grants an additional stacking Psyche DMG bonus up to 10 stacks with a 0.3s ICD, resetting on character switch. Off-field damage detection, 2.0s and 0.3s ICDs, active-actor recipients, and switch resets are tested hypotheses. Release availability at the cutoff is unverified.

weapons.black_book_v1: Black Tome grants the wearer its frozen Break Intensity points unconditionally. The points join the break damage zone as 1 + BI/300 + break_bonus_sum; they do not enter gauge accumulation. Arc: Black Tome is sealed by two chains by default; each team Support Skill cast unleashes one chain. When fully unleashed, explicit Arc admission enters a 0.2-second startup. Successful startup summons the Black Tome for 20 seconds with no normal cooldown and reseals the Arc with two chains; an interruption during startup instead applies a 30-second cancellation cooldown and does not summon or reseal. A pending startup or live summon prevents overlapping activation. The summon designates an enemy at spawn and refreshes designation every 5 seconds, preferring living locked targets else lowest index. The wearer gains its frozen Chaos damage bonus against designated enemies. When a designated enemy takes Break damage while the summon is active, the wearer deals an immediate Chaos ATK hit. Switching preserves the summon; death during startup cancels it, while ticks and designation stop on wearer death and pending hits cancel postmortem. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.good_boy_v3: Good Boy retains the once-compiled additive Charge Efficiency from v2 and its admitted-Ultimate shared team ATK window. A successful control receipt produced by that wearer's same admitted Ultimate upgrades the single active named window from its frozen base ATK ratio to base plus the frozen 6/7/8/9/10 percent refinement ratio. The extra ratio latches once per cast across recipients and survives the control status ending; it lasts only the remainder of the original 20-second world-time deadline. It never stacks per target, refreshes on repeated hit/control callbacks, or extends from control time. Expired windows, stale commands and an older wearer's control after another wearer replaced the shared snapshot cannot upgrade it. Ordinary Ultimate damage, mere airborne state, Boss metadata, other actors and non-Ultimate control are insufficient; the engine's actual successful-control receipt is required. This supersedes v2's missing-control-consumer limit under the explicit combat.control_effects_v1 model, currently produced by Sakiri Suppress. Native conditional capture, original application ordering and cross-wearer priority remain tested product assumptions. Legacy explicit TeamAtk-only procs default their omitted control ratio to zero; native projectors bind it at every refinement.

weapons.rose_break_extension_v1: Under an explicit target break_profile, a connected positive-damage hit by a Bohemian Rose wearer extends a target that was already in the content runner's Broken state by the frozen buff_Rose_UnbalTime once during that modeled Break generation. The deadline moves from its previous value by exactly the extension duration; the target Broken tag and recovery event follow it. A hit that itself causes the Break cannot extend it, and defeated targets, targets without an explicit profile, unbroken targets and repeated hits in the same Break do not extend. This is a bounded runner hypothesis, not native target-profile, packet-eligibility, recovery, or Break Effect evidence.

weapons.rose_v1: Bohemian Rose grants the wearer its frozen ATK percentage unconditionally, joining the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum. Each time the wearer deals DoT, one Chaos Thorn stack is granted (wearer-only timed buff, 3s, refresh on retrigger, 10-stack cap, 0.3s trigger ICD); each stack adds its frozen CRIT DMG ratio to the additive critical-damage zone. A Redirect Skill cast grants 10 stacks immediately, bypassing the DoT ICD. Redirect admission grants stacks before its hits; each connected wearer DoT packet grants after damage settlement and cannot enhance that same hit. DoT delivery is identified by the owner-declared State.Damage.Dot semantic tag, including delayed off-field packets. Native lacrimosa blood DoT scheduling remains pending. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

entries.label: Lacrimosa · Scorch / Zankou
assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

character.zankou.crimson_reverie_v1: Zankou Crimson Reverie sets her living owner's Cycle pool to exactly one hundred once at scenario combat entry, replacing the authored starting value without adding Ultimate Energy. Field returns, waits and continuing cycles never repeat that initialization. One permanent nonstacking self modifier adds one hundred Cycle Intensity stat points to Zankou on or off field; teammates receive none. It composes with her authored and equipped CI before live/captured reaction consumers. An initially defeated owner receives no entry Cycle. Current player Passive2 configuration and its self carrier establish the recipient correction from the earlier team-aura shortcut. The thirty-second entry cooldown has no second combat entry to govern in this single-combat model.

character.zankou.silent_sunset_v1: With a living team Zankou, qualified Scorch uses one source-preserving target aggregate capped at three stacks. Initial application gives one stack; further qualified applications and each connected ordinary DoT delivery on that live enhanced target add one, cap at three, and refresh fifteen seconds without resetting the .99-second tick phase or adding an immediate tick. A DoT-triggered replacement is a newly inflicted Scorch by Zankou: all existing stacks take his live level, Cycle Intensity, Incantation element and captured ordinary plus DoT crit damage, using the shared Scorch base and fixed fifty-percent crit policy. It does not copy the ally's applied HP damage or its DoT coefficient/duration. This selects the description's newly inflicted effect as the new Scorch and the native carrier's fifteen-second/.99-second clocks. Replacement receipts retain the original switch and link the exact earlier triggering hit separately from the new damage owner. Scorch's own ticks cannot trigger this effect; zero HP-loss connected DoT hits may, following the reached callback's absent positive-damage gate. Dead Zankou cannot create replacements; existing captured Scorch remains independent. R6 kill enhancement, native prediction/callback fidelity and unbound ordinary Skill application remain outside this model.

combat.control_effects_v1: A content owner may request a finite control effect after a connected delivered hit. The anonymous dummy's authored control_immune flag defaults false and is independent of Boss classification, airborne inputs and damage magnitude. A living source can control a living nonimmune recipient; a defeated source/target or immune recipient produces no successful-control receipt or status. Positive exact hits that round to zero HP loss still reach after-hit control, distinct from positive-HP-loss consumers. Successful applications preserve source actor, actual target and parent command, record exact world-time duration/expiry and apply one target-scoped status. Control represents gameplay eligibility only, without movement, geometry or target AI. Source death does not erase an already applied finite target effect. Native immunity and after-hit ordering remain explicit scenario/owner hypotheses.

combat.discord_break_gauge_v1: A newly admitted Scorch/Nova generation pair on the same living target emits one Discord callback, deduplicated by that pair; periodic ticks, readiness checks and reuse of the same pair emit none. A breakable target must explicitly declare discord_fraction in (0,1]. Discord subtracts original capacity times that fraction times the target's accepted incoming Break efficiency from the current non-Broken gauge, clamps at zero, then enters at most one causal Broken transition. A Broken target records the callback and loses no gauge; a no-bar or defeated target has no gauge to lose. This selected content model creates no HP packet, critical roll, ordinary damage modifier, resource grant or recursive reaction and does not establish a universal native Discord percentage.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.single_packet_support_v1: Single-packet qualified Support actions use their owner packet, purchased QTE coordinate, recovered or documented bounded timing, and owner-local recovery gates. Living in-range dummy recipients share one packet's ordinary Charge and connected owner effects.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

damage.fixed_crit_rate_as_probability_v1: Interpret a nonzero native FixedCritRate scalar as the packet's replacement critical-hit probability. Preserve normal critical-damage calculation and only roll when the packet's damage kind is crit-eligible; this does not claim native stat-capture or periodic-tick timing semantics.

gear.cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Ultimate admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Weapon and set effects retain their own recipient, stacking and expiry policies. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis; native animation timing remains unresolved.

gear.skill_cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Skill admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Source-owned recipient, stacking and expiry rules still apply. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis.

haniel.full_kit_v1: Haniel composes the selected ordinary clock, charged Cannon, summon and reversible B2 models with explicit secondary controls. Common paid Dodge costs15 stamina with0.9s cooldown and the shared2s regeneration delay; front/back recovery0.836769/1.005710s, Skill gates0.333611/0.494283s and Jump0.094234/0s. Successful Critical Dodge arms one canonical Normal replacement, cleared by another action or field exit. Explicit parry is accepted only during a paid Dodge, arming that same response after0.02s without another packet or grant. Riposte emits one uncapped Z and immediate fully charged capped Cannon at0.4s, without a Normal opener/hold. Its base recovery0.957007s and Skill/Jump0.514085s acquire0.297s per connected Z and0.02s per actual Cannon leg, once per packet. Authored plunge lands after its explicit descent, emits0.065670s later and recovers0.175616s after landing, coefficient times1+height with height0..1. Engine-qualified outgoing100-Cycle reaction switches select one Support at0.712638s, recovery1.177904s plus0.210s connected pause and switch lock1.112165s; otherwise a living dummy permits one entry Normal1 with0.896381s recovery. Ordinary/entry/Skill/Branch Jump gates and cancellation use the selected source coordinates; only admitted controls cancel unissued contacts/notifies, launched Cannon and summons retain source ownership. World cooldowns/resources retain their remaining duration during shared pauses. These are disclosed stationary-dummy models and source-coordinate inferences, not measured game timing or enemy AI.

haniel.harmony_ensemble_v1: Haniel Hootie and its team ATK aura start in a callback after both direct Skill impacts at the admitted hit time, including an immune or absent primary target fallback. Recasting direct hits can feed an existing Hootie before refresh. Exact native Skill and Burst montage admission remains unbound: admitted impact timing is used and Ace starts on Burst admission, not measured native montage progress. This supersedes v1's before-impact Skill aura grant. Within that bounded clock, one eight-ObjectLifetime-second Hootie (twelve with A2) persists off field and preserves its remaining lifetime through ten-second Ace and recasts. Positive direct packets from the living active actor grant one source-wide Harmony at most every .5 World seconds, including a killing hit, excluding reaction, gear, summon and token damage. Four Harmony consume four and cause one live Psyche/category-E Ensemble across all living stationary dummies, with the captured admitted Skill talent coordinate and current owner stats. Ensemble grants one persistent Plot Armor (two in Ace), capped at four or six with A1. Each Ace Ensemble additionally emits one Psyche/category-Q Symphony and replaces a three-second single-use extra-attack token. The next positive active direct hit on a still living recipient consumes the prior token before Harmony processing; its Haniel-owned Q packet uses the admitted Burst coordinate and current stats, doubles its coefficient only when A4 Haniel herself triggered the arming Ensemble, and does not recurse. Tokens survive Ace ending and follow the active actor. Expiry resets Harmony but preserves Plot; source defeat clears summon, Ace, tokens, Plot and source buffs. Same-time AoE and pellets share the World .5-second gate; no periodic summon polling or Cycle/energy is invented for the three native zero-ChargeAdd rows. Cannon consumption and exact native admission/impact timing remain separate unbound mechanics; this is executable summon coverage, not a claim of the complete Haniel kit.

haniel.nova_extraction_v1: Haniel B2 listens once to each living target's ended Nova generation while she remains in combat membership, including off field and after source death. Capture source baseATK including weapon base at membership entry; each end grants0.08 of it as flatATK to every equipped ally, capped0.16 source-wide per recipient. One target loses half the accepted grant, capped0.20 of its explicitly authored initial ATK across sources; truncate the grant proportionally at either cap. Gains and target losses persist through switches, summon expiry and source death, and only this source's ledger rolls back on combat exit. No target ATK default, damage, healing, Harmony, Plot or resource award is inferred. This is the selected stationary-dummy model, not native execution or enemy AI.

haniel.ordinary_clock_v1: Haniel's ordinary Normal chain and direct Skill/Burst use the selected native montage coordinates rounded once to whole microseconds per action boundary. All living in-range stationary dummies receive whole coefficients; recipients do not multiply one causal packet's energy/Cycle opportunity. Skill contacts occur at0.345126/0.719512s, then one Hootie spawns after the latter settles; cooldown20s (A6 replaces16s) starts at0.684620s. Pre-marker interruption starts3s without A6 subtraction. Burst pays120 at commitment, starts20s cooldown, admits Ace/team buffs only at2.869166s and damage at3.843514s, recovering4.240809s. Queued Normal advances five stages only at the previous recovery boundary; idle, another action or field exit resets it. Unissued contacts/notifies cancel on interruption/exit, while existing summons/Ace and real energy/Cycle clocks continue. This binds the finite ordinary clock and reached Cycle values, not Cannon, plunge, paid Dodge/Riposte or natural Support, and does not claim measured game timing.

haniel.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Haniel character:1020 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Haniel PSYCHE are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, enhanced/alternate forms, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

lacrimosa.broken_shatter_v1: Preserve the selected Lacrimosa Broken-target callback: each delivered ranged Melee4/Melee6 or ordinary Skill1 packet against an actively Broken dummy queues one B_Melee3_Explode child at the same real timestamp with coefficient0.686 and the content-owned shatter tag. The child retains the initiating action and target; its tag and owner-child binding share this hypothesis. This is the existing bounded trigger/timing/coefficient model, separate from the melee-chain projectile shatter; it does not establish native projectile dispatch or geometry.

lacrimosa.nightmare_all_targets_v1: Requires the separately accepted lacrimosa.nightmare_dot_scheduling_v1 model and extends it to all living declared dummies, including the uncapped Skill explosion. Each admitted Skill/Burst captures source, command, effective Normal-talent Blood coefficient and A0/A4 duration during admission, then applies five Nightmare stacks per living target in a ProcCallback at its primary impact time, after same-time HitDelivery. Dead sources apply nothing; target eligibility is rechecked at application. Each source/target retains an independent aggregate, expiry and NeverReset one-second grid; refresh cancels only that target's superseded ticks. Blood uses the effective Normal talent, including resonance, independently of Skill/Burst talent. Without this extension the legacy target-zero/cast-coordinate policy remains. The cap-20/remove-one-and-refresh model is retained despite the serialized cap-10 conflict; awakening variant/settlement/healing policies remain unresolved. Recipients, callback order and coordinate selection are bounded owner-model rules, not verified native dispatch.

lacrimosa.nightmare_dot_scheduling_v1: Lacrimosa GA_Lacrimosa_Skill and GA_Lacrimosa_UltraSkill casts apply the Nightmare blood DoT (GE_Player_Lacrimosa_Blood_Damage) to target zero: +5 stacks capped at 20, aggregate duration refreshed to 3s (6s when awakening effect 4 is selected). Ticks are pre-scheduled HitDelivery events on a 1s grid anchored at first application (NeverReset; first tick at +1s, no immediate tick) and rebuilt on every reapply; a reapply after full expiry re-anchors the grid. Stack expiry follows RemoveSingleStackAndRefreshDuration with expiry processed before a tick on coinciding timestamps. Each tick carries the native per-stack ATK ratio at the applying cast's talent coordinate and the State.Damage.Dot tag; the stack multiplier ratio*clamp(count-1,0,20) is added in the coefficient-addition zone from the live count at tick time (positive expansion bypass is modeled as never active). Melee, QTE, LV6 packet selection, E/Q value conflicts and per-application own-deadline expiry remain unbound; stack cap 20 conflicts with the serialized GE stack_limit=10. Tested bounded hypothesis; native executor, tick order and clock remain unproven.

lacrimosa.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Lacrimosa character:1004 only, a modeled ranged/melee Normal, Flavor Variation transition or ordinary Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Lacrimosa INCANTATION are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. The modeled melee projectile shatter has its own frozen ChargeAdd and qualifies once per delivered explosion. Burst, blood DoT, Sleep In cooldown resets, Discord, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

lacrimosa.ranged_normal_chain_v1: Lacrimosa Normal retains the existing ranged primary binding and advances five stages from frozen neverness_lacrimosa MeleeModA descriptions and native DT_SkillDamageData: Melee1; Melee2 x3; Melee3; Melee4 x3 plus Melee6; Melee5. The chain loops after stage five and resets on a different admitted ability, field exit or a gap greater than 2 seconds between input starts. Reset rules, gap and ordered coincident delivery at the research primary impact time are tested hypotheses pending animation/cancel evidence. This hypothesis covers the ranged chain only; travel, AoE, Nightmare DoT, Sleep In cooldown resets and complete kit behavior remain unsupported.

lacrimosa.skill_burst_packets_v1: Lacrimosa Morning Tomato delivers one Skill hit on target zero; Working Day Judgement delivers five UltraSkill hits (four GE_Player_Lacrimosa_UltraSkill1_Damage plus one GE_Player_Lacrimosa_UltraSkill2_Damage). All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, Nightmare DoT ticks or complete kit behavior.

lacrimosa.sleep_in_v1: Lacrimosa has one ordinary Skill cooldown, without stock charges or an independent12s recharge. Source selects16s at ordinary admission under its disclosed caller timing model; native notify/cancellation timing remains separate. During that live cooldown, five admitted ordinary Normal sections grant one Sleep In extra Skill. The grant waives remaining ordinary cooldown once, and its commit consumes the grant/counter while preserving the original ordinary deadline. Further sections cannot grant another extra in the same window. Ordinary expiry clears unused permission/counter; a new ordinary cast starts a fresh window. Counting is per admitted Normal section rather than per damage packet/recipient, independent of hit success and persistent through field exit. Existing selected melee-shatter cooldown reduction changes this one deadline rather than restoring invented stocks. Source cooldown selection, grant consumption and per-window bounds are explicit revisable model rules; native notify/interrupt behavior and stolen monster abilities are not established.

owner.action_role.character_1004_qte_v1: Classify this exact frozen character action as QTE because its DT_CharacterAbilityConfig identity names the owner action as QTE while DT_CharacterAbilityEffectConfig has no row; this role is an owner-reviewed model hypothesis for this ability only.

owner.action_role.character_1020_qte_v1: Classify this exact frozen character action as QTE because its DT_CharacterAbilityConfig identity names the owner action as QTE while DT_CharacterAbilityEffectConfig has no row; this role is an owner-reviewed model hypothesis for this ability only.

sakiri.burst_atk_v1: Current GA_Sagiri_UltraSkill activation independently requests ordinary Buff_Sagiri003_QDamUp and, only with node4, Buff_Sagiri003_Level4_1. Each adds30percent of the source GetAtkBase to other living teammates for20 World seconds, with no self grant. The separate cap1 carriers refresh rather than stack. Base includes compiled character and equipped weapon base ATK, excluding console flat/percent and recipient ATK. The selected managed snapshot lifetime survives source defeat; dead recipients receive no new grant and existing dead carriers contribute nothing. Actual admitted activation produces the grants, without hit or damage requirements. This explicit lifetime/recipient model does not simulate multiplayer global-component routing.

sakiri.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Sakiri character:1003 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Sakiri INCANTATION are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. The explicit GE_Player_Sagiri_AirAttack1_Damage packet input is excluded from this energy adapter; native plunge energy eligibility remains unresolved. Burst, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

sakiri.skill_burst_packets_v1: Sakiri Devour Whole delivers Skill1 and Skill2 once each on target zero; Feast of Gluttony delivers UltraSkill1 five times and UltraSkill2 once. All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, eating mode or complete kit behavior.

sakiri.suppress_v1: Sakiri's first connected Ultimate packet per admitted input and actual recipient attempts the source-bound Suppress effect once. Child pulses and other recipients retain their causal command identity; switching does not rearm an earlier attempt. Suppress lasts 3 World seconds, or 6 with selected A1, using Sagiri_Suppress and Sagiri_lv1_Suppress. Only successful control applies the Impish Trick child DEF reduction: one shared target instance subtracts 10 percent of authored base DEF for 20 seconds, independently of the shorter control lifetime. If base_def is omitted, authored total DEF is also the assumed base; an explicit base 1000/total 1500 yields 1400, not 1350. The reduction refreshes at the next successful control and clamps effective DEF at zero. These choices bind the recovered SKILL_EVENT_AFTER_HIT -> suppress object -> control marker and DEF-child chain, not every damage input or mere preexisting airborne state. Native control immunity, hybrid-server routing, exact application/capture clocks and passive unlock dispatch remain unverified; the reviewed baseline enables the passive. Other floating/Skill control and A5 transitions retain their separate owner limits.

sets.crimson_v1: Crimson: Twin Butterflies binds Incantation_4_1/4_2/4_3 to the four-piece description (.06/6/10). Each connected delivered wearer hit grants one independent self ATK stack before same-time queued hits, including multi-packet inputs. The cap discards new applications without refreshing existing stacks. Each stack expires independently on world time, before equal-time hits; switching preserves stacks and allies cannot grant or receive them. The native trigger is AsyncTaskCharacterAttacked with an element check the frozen evidence does not fully resolve; hit-granted stacks are a tested hypothesis. Trigger timing and cap behavior are tested hypotheses; set count declares matching native geometry. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

sets.diabolos_v2: An equipped Diabolos four-piece wearer ignores twelve Chaos resistance percentage points for its own Chaos packets. On a qualified engine Esper Cycle admission that produces Nova or Scorch, both living outgoing/incoming actors are participants independently of captured reaction ownership; each equipped wearer receives one self-only twenty-second window before Cycle spend and reaction production. During that window the frozen twenty-four-point ignore replaces the baseline twelve, rather than adding to it. Further eligible participation refreshes the nonstacking window; field exit preserves its world-clock deadline and exact expiry restores the baseline. Ineligible switches, same-actor swaps, other reactions, nonwearers and non-Chaos packets receive no powered benefit. Participant effects are prepared atomically before publishing buffs/receipts. This extends the switch-based reaction model and supersedes v1's unconditional-only implementation; native participation dispatch and clock fidelity remain unverified.

sets.shadow_creed_v1: Shadow Creed binds Attack2_4_AtkUp/CD to the current four-piece description (.25/20), instead of conflicting Attack_4/CD (.35/10), as a description-matched hypothesis. It uses the selected ratio as a self base-ATK percentage. Successful Skill admission refreshes one nonstacking effect before its delivered hits; switching preserves it until world-time expiry. Set count declares matching geometry; native parameter-caller and clock applicability remain hypotheses. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.bit_game_v1: Blow up the Crowd (Beat King) increases the active character's ATK while the wearer is off-field, and dealing damage while off-field grants the active character an additional stacking ATK bonus up to 4 stacks with a 2.0s ICD, resetting when the wearer becomes active. While the wearer is active, it increases Psyche DMG dealt, and dealing Psyche DMG with Basic Attacks grants an additional stacking Psyche DMG bonus up to 10 stacks with a 0.3s ICD, resetting on character switch. Off-field damage detection, 2.0s and 0.3s ICDs, active-actor recipients, and switch resets are tested hypotheses. Release availability at the cutoff is unverified.

weapons.demon_blade_v1: Ravenous Blade adds its frozen Crit Rate ratio to the wearer's crit rate in the additive base-rate zone. Dealing Incantation DMG grants one wearer stack of Crit DMG through ProcCallback up to seven stacks, with a 0.3s trigger cooldown. Each trigger refreshes the group's duration to 15s, including at cap. Switching preserves stacks and cooldown; exact expiry precedes equal-time hits. Cooldown, stacking, and world-time clocks are tested hypotheses. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.good_boy_v3: Good Boy retains the once-compiled additive Charge Efficiency from v2 and its admitted-Ultimate shared team ATK window. A successful control receipt produced by that wearer's same admitted Ultimate upgrades the single active named window from its frozen base ATK ratio to base plus the frozen 6/7/8/9/10 percent refinement ratio. The extra ratio latches once per cast across recipients and survives the control status ending; it lasts only the remainder of the original 20-second world-time deadline. It never stacks per target, refreshes on repeated hit/control callbacks, or extends from control time. Expired windows, stale commands and an older wearer's control after another wearer replaced the shared snapshot cannot upgrade it. Ordinary Ultimate damage, mere airborne state, Boss metadata, other actors and non-Ultimate control are insufficient; the engine's actual successful-control receipt is required. This supersedes v2's missing-control-consumer limit under the explicit combat.control_effects_v1 model, currently produced by Sakiri Suppress. Native conditional capture, original application ordering and cross-wearer priority remain tested product assumptions. Legacy explicit TeamAtk-only procs default their omitted control ratio to zero; native projectors bind it at every refinement.

weapons.rose_break_extension_v1: Under an explicit target break_profile, a connected positive-damage hit by a Bohemian Rose wearer extends a target that was already in the content runner's Broken state by the frozen buff_Rose_UnbalTime once during that modeled Break generation. The deadline moves from its previous value by exactly the extension duration; the target Broken tag and recovery event follow it. A hit that itself causes the Break cannot extend it, and defeated targets, targets without an explicit profile, unbroken targets and repeated hits in the same Break do not extend. This is a bounded runner hypothesis, not native target-profile, packet-eligibility, recovery, or Break Effect evidence.

weapons.rose_v1: Bohemian Rose grants the wearer its frozen ATK percentage unconditionally, joining the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum. Each time the wearer deals DoT, one Chaos Thorn stack is granted (wearer-only timed buff, 3s, refresh on retrigger, 10-stack cap, 0.3s trigger ICD); each stack adds its frozen CRIT DMG ratio to the additive critical-damage zone. A Redirect Skill cast grants 10 stacks immediately, bypassing the DoT ICD. Redirect admission grants stacks before its hits; each connected wearer DoT packet grants after damage settlement and cannot enhance that same hit. DoT delivery is identified by the owner-declared State.Damage.Dot semantic tag, including delayed off-field packets. Native lacrimosa blood DoT scheduling remains pending. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

zankou.form_modifiers_v1: Zankou Reality/Illusion Normal and held actions grant self Hunt25percent damage or team Delusion25percent DoT critical damage during the admitted owner action. Positive contact projection extends only that action component. A legally adjacent entry/return Skill carries its existing component through setup; successful entry retains Hunt for eight World seconds and successful Soulcross retains Delusion for eight World seconds. World retention never follows montage pauses. Rejected input grants nothing; cancellation discards its action component and A0 field exit discards both retained components. Selected A1 instead keeps living-source self Hunt40percent and team Delusion50percent permanent on and off field, without double counting or extending the source after defeat. This explicit finite action/retention lifecycle interprets the current class and published duration contracts; it is not a certified native ability-task executor.

zankou.forms_v1: Current rolling Zankou source selects Reality entry or Illusion return from live owner state. Skill has a real five-second admission cooldown; selected rate-one montage transitions commit at496507us entry and2039354us return, independently of HP loss. Illusion lasts eight World seconds, half open; enhanced Soulcross is earned during its final3500000us. Enhanced entry requires a current eligible Reality action section. Field exit discards form and permissions without restoring them on return. Pending montage contacts and transition/grant notifications cancel on replacement or interruption while committed costs, cooldowns and launched DoT trains continue. Natural expiry uses a generation guard and does not cancel an already admitted Soulcross. Source coordinates and finite transition interpretation are bounded models, not certified native playback.

entries.label: Baicang · Scorch / Adler
assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

adler.a5_burst_energy_refund_v1: When Adler awakening effect 5 is selected, one successful native GA_Adler_UltraSkill admission schedules a same-time ProcCallback restoring 20 whole Ultimate Energy to the captured Adler. This flat refund uses restore_energy, so Charge Efficiency and fractional carry do not scale or consume it; capacity excess is overflow. It is independent of hit delivery, target count and later field switches, but requires the captured owner to remain alive when the callback runs. Frozen 1033AwakenEffect.json Effect5 localized text says Adler gains 20 Ultimate Energy when casting Tranquility and DT_AdlerEffectFigure.Adler_lv5=20; the exact native timing/applicability remains unverified. Optional PC_140 ChargeExecution20 does not establish runtime wiring. Other awakening mechanics remain pending.

adler.blessing_party_interception_v1: Adler Blessing shield acts as a party shield pool that protects the current living active actor, following field ownership on switch without resetting capacity, snapshot or expiry.

adler.blessing_r6_v1: At hit delivery, a living Adler with six selected awakening effects grants one additive +10 percentage-point Incantation damage bonus to all team Incantation packets while any living actor holds that Adler source's positive, nonexpired Blessing shield. The packet owner and active field actor do not affect eligibility; shield depletion, half-open expiry, recipient death or source Adler death removes the bonus. Multiple eligible sources enable the same single +10% contribution without stacking. This is a tested bounded hypothesis based on 1033AwakenEffect.json resonance_6 text; the referenced Buff_Adler033_Level6_extra blueprint does not expose its property or protected-actor predicate in frozen evidence. DamageUpIncantationBase identifies the matching native-style stat, and the bonus is modeled in the additive damage-bonus zone.

adler.blessing_shield_v1: On successful GA_Adler_Skill admission, capture the current active actor and Adler's exact effective DEF (base DEF scaled by static+live DefUp, then static+live flat DEF); a same-time ProcCallback grants that captured actor a shield using the native flat+coefficient curve at the effective Skill level. The grant samples Adler's static+live outgoing ShieldEfficiency and adds 20% capacity only when awakening effect 3 is selected, in the same additive shield-bonus zone, then rounds once. Resonance count does not substitute for effect 3. Recasting replaces only this Adler source shield on that recipient; the shield persists across switching, expires at its half-open deadline, and recipient death clears it. Shield amount is a cast-time snapshot. This is a tested bounded hypothesis because native source tables do not establish recipient snapshot, stat snapshot or ShieldEfficiency stacking.

adler.burst_intervals_v1: Adler Burst delivers five Sunya projectiles at 2.1851034s and a second conditional five-projectile volley at 2.343074s if exactly one dummy was living at admission. A1 (+20 Karma) and A5 (+20 flat Ultimate Energy) callbacks occur at UltraSkill.2 (2.343074s) if the source is alive.

adler.karma_v1: A connected modeled Deliverance normal-chain packet grants one held Karma stack; a connected aimed Liberation packet grants two; each grant is capped at 20. A successful Tranquility admission adds 20 stacks only when effect 1 is selected, up to the same cap. Skill admission captures and clears all held stacks before damage. Optional PC_140 decoded AdlerSkill_DamUp and Buff_AdlerQiHai_SkillDamUP assets reconstruct additive FinalDamageUp of 2% per captured stack, selected as 3% only when effect 2 is selected; Global cutoff applicability and runtime reachability are unproven. The frozen .01 Adler_lv2 figure and localized descriptions conflict, and a separate live-held A2 general damage bonus is omitted to avoid double application of this Skill carrier. Karma gain follows its connected packet; zero-damage, unmodeled melee siblings, and other Karma producers remain unsupported.

adler.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Adler character:1033 only, modeled ordinary Normal, aimed Normal, and GA_Adler_Skill native packets grant their exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. Skill2's native initial row has ChargeAdd 4; Skill3 siblings and Skill_Damage periodic rows have zero and grant nothing. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Adler INCANTATION are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, defensive passives, alternate forms, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.
adler.righteous_heart_v1: Adler Breakthrough 4 passive Righteous Heart adds .20 DEF% to Adler base-DEF zone, active in party on/off field.

adler.skill_all_in_range_dummy_v1: For one admitted GA_Adler_Skill command, capture every living scenario-declared dummy in ascending target_index at admission; the product scenario assumes each is in range and in the attack area, with no geometry, recipient cap, or distribution check. Schedule one modeled Skill2/Skill3x2 initial train and one +1s through +10s periodic train per captured target. The target-zero primary packet supplies its Skill2; child packets supply Skill2 on other captured targets. Initial packet delivery and each periodic stream recheck target survival; all streams share owner survival and the cast generation, so recasting replaces them together. One Skill command spends its action cost once. Additional Skill2 packets do not extend the currently target-zero-only energy adapter. This is a product dummy semantic, not a native target selection/count/cap/geometry claim.

adler.skill_train_v1: Under the separate adler.skill_all_in_range_dummy_v1 product assumption, schedule one Skill2 and two Skill3 coincident initial DEF packets and GE_Player_Adler_Skill_Damage at +1s through +10s inclusive for each living captured target. The mapped initial Skill2 row and published 70% DEF x3 description disagree about multiplicity; Skill3 activation is not proven, and using it twice is a bounded numeric-three-hit hypothesis. The 1s/10s frozen figure curves ground the tick train, but exact impact/refresh timing is assumed. At Skill admission, consumed Karma is captured and cleared; each captured stack adds 2% FinalDamageUp, or 3% only when Adler awakening effect 2 is selected, to every packet admitted by that Skill command, including initial packets that deliver after a later recast. This uses optional PC_140 decoded AdlerSkill_DamUp and Buff_AdlerQiHai_SkillDamUP evidence (Global cutoff applicability and runtime reachability unproven); the frozen .01 A2 figure and localized descriptions conflict, and no separate held-stack general A2 bonus is modeled to avoid double applying the reconstructed FinalDamageUp carrier. Recast cancels only the old periodic train; living owners continue off-field, defeated owners cancel, and each defeated target stops its own future ticks. One admission spends action cost once; complete kit behavior remains pending.

adler.temperance_v1: Living Breakthrough 2 Adler selects one of the three source-ordered Temperance target effects on each successful Scorch application or refresh, including off field. Selection uses a separate seeded unbiased uniform stream, an inference from the unweighted source candidate array. Each result has its own 15 World second cap-one timer: subtract 20% of original target ATK, reduce Physical, all six Esper channels and Mental resistance by 10 percentage points, or add 10 percentage points to incoming Break efficiency. Target defeat clears the statuses. Existing selections survive source defeat until expiry. Authored incoming damage is independent of dummy ATK.

baicang.actor_hitstop_v1: With the Power Word model, Baicang montage coordinates advance through causal positive-HP-contact pauses using exact PPM integration and earliest integer deadlines. Normal1/2/5 request .033s at .1; Normal3 requests .067s at .1 after .04s; each Normal4 contact requests .033s at .1 after .033s; Formless contacts request .1s at .3, Riposte .3s at .01, QTE .3s at .3. Coincident recipients share a request and overlaps use the strongest slowdown. Raw Normal/recovery/cancel coordinates replace baked local pause additions; Formless actors emit with the direct source marker and travel .25s. Released actors/projectiles, activated Words/field lifetimes, cooldowns, costs and combat time remain real. Unreleased producers, field activation, recovery and legal cancel windows follow caster progress across actions, including residual pauses after jump/interruption/switch. Execute requests .3s at .3 only for the owner's locked target (dummy0). No pause is invented for zero HP loss, missing duration, other actors or target AI.

baicang.judgment_of_autumn_domain_v1: A successfully admitted native Baicang GA_Cang_UltraSkill keeps the existing GE_Player_Cang_UltraSkill2_Damage expansion hit once and starts one generation of GE_Player_Cang_UltraSkill_Damage on target zero at cast+2s, +4s, and every 2s through the 12s endpoint inclusive (six ticks) or A5 16s endpoint inclusive (eight ticks). Each tick uses the admitted effective Burst talent coordinate and captured owner/action/packet metadata, samples the living owner's current ATK and buffs plus target mitigation at delivery, and retains native FixedCritRate 0.5 under damage.fixed_crit_rate_as_probability_v1. Recast replaces prior pending ticks; a living off-field owner continues, a defeated owner cancels, and a defeated target receives no later hit or revival. Domain buffs keep their existing half-open deadline, so the inclusive endpoint tick does not receive them. One target and the inclusive scheduling/endpoint rules are bounded hypotheses; this does not model the description's execute, fatal immunity, Power Words Silence/Objurgate/Bless, or the complete kit. If a domain expansion or tick leaves a living target below 10% HP, execution rejects because the required execute branch is unsupported; target kind is unavailable, so this conservatively uses the description's 10% threshold.

baicang.moderate_mischief_v1: Baicang breakthrough 2 refreshes the live locked target's existing Scorch once per generated Word, preserving its original offensive snapshot, attribution and tick phase. Ordinary Scorch stays capped at one; the existing Zankou extension retains its three-stack admission. Expired or absent Scorch creates no application and refresh cannot generate a Word.

baicang.normal_chain_v1: Baicang ordinary Normal advances five stages with multiplicities 1,1,1,7,1 from frozen neverness_cang descriptions and native DT_SkillDamageData coefficients. The chain loops after stage five and resets on a different admitted ability, field exit or a gap greater than 2 seconds between input starts. Reset rules, gap and ordered coincident delivery at the research primary impact time are tested hypotheses pending animation/cancel evidence. Heavy attack variations, freeze interactions and complete kit behavior remain unsupported.

baicang.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Baicang character:1023 only, a modeled Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Baicang INCANTATION are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, enhanced/alternate forms, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

baicang.power_words_v1: Baicang Normal 3rd input, Riposte, QTE, and derived Skills generate Power Words (Silence, Objurgate, Bless) with 3/4 storage cap, 3%/1.5% current-HP cost, 15s lifespan outside domain, and immediate or field-start domain activation.

character.adler.skill_dot_packet_semantics_v1: Treat only Adler GE_Player_Adler_Skill_Damage as State.Damage and State.Damage.Dot because its frozen periodic Skill description schedules this exact effect. This packet-semantic mapping is a bounded hypothesis; the separate Skill model owns scheduling, target scope, recast, and duration.

character.baicang.dot_packet_semantics_v1: Treat Baicang GE_Player_Cang_UltraSkill_Damage as a DoT damage source carrying State.Damage and State.Damage.Dot, as disclosed by the researched Judgment of Autumn description. This owner declaration maps packet semantics; the separate domain model owns scheduling and target scope.

combat.control_effects_v1: A content owner may request a finite control effect after a connected delivered hit. The anonymous dummy's authored control_immune flag defaults false and is independent of Boss classification, airborne inputs and damage magnitude. A living source can control a living nonimmune recipient; a defeated source/target or immune recipient produces no successful-control receipt or status. Positive exact hits that round to zero HP loss still reach after-hit control, distinct from positive-HP-loss consumers. Successful applications preserve source actor, actual target and parent command, record exact world-time duration/expiry and apply one target-scoped status. Control represents gameplay eligibility only, without movement, geometry or target AI. Source death does not erase an already applied finite target effect. Native immunity and after-hit ordering remain explicit scenario/owner hypotheses.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

daffodil.action_cancels_v1: Daffodil action cancels require ordinary_clock_v1. Jump and Skill use the selected native stage gates through the same owner lost-progress clock; an ordinary invalid early input does not interrupt. Accepted Jump/replacement removes unreached montage requests and resets the Normal pointer without refunding costs or captured Resonance. A new montage inherits any still-live owner pause, while World deadlines retain their exact remaining duration through shared pauses. Explicit forced interruption releases recovery and cancels pending montage work; pre-notify Skill starts3s cancel cooldown at interruption, post-notify retains its original16s deadline. A completed cast is not interrupted retroactively. This binds finite source gates and causal cancellation, not airborne geometry, paid Dodge, suspended combo or a recovered native interruption body.

daffodil.branch_entry_direct_packet_energy_v1: For Daffodil character:1054 only, an explicitly modeled GA_Daffodill_Melee Branch1-7 or EntryAttack1/2/4 direct packet grants its frozen DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the frozen source-element to recipient-element coefficient from DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (3/5 for Daffodil CHAOS), then applies their own Charge Efficiency, exact fractional carry, capacity and overflow accounting. This exact direct-input policy is a tested hypothesis, not evidence of native eligibility. Natural Branch/Entry dispatch, animation, timing, target rules, jump/dodge legality, stamina, costs, cadence, extra packets, other targets and callbacks remain unresolved; Branch6/7 are frozen packet rows without a published-tip binding.

daffodil.insight_break_capture_v1: Finale applies independent source-owned target Insight: one refreshed stack for 45 seconds, or up to two stacks with shared refreshed 9999-second expiry at selected A3.
