Self Eyes remains 30 seconds at every awakening. At a new target Break, selected A4 adds 0.15 Break bonus per own Insight stack and A5 adds one captured own contribution per stack. Capture uses this recipient and source only; marks survive field exit/source death, expire half-open, and clear on target death. Base roster contributions precede repeats in source-slot order; defeated recipients cancel pending contributions. This is a bounded owner model, not proof of native callbacks or montage timing; R6 Broken Chaos shred remains unbound.

daffodil.ordinary_clock_v1: Daffodil's selected finite Normal, ordinary/Echoes Skill and Finale montage coordinates advance on real combat time, rounded once to nearest microsecond. Each connected causal request adds its integrated native duration*(1-rate) lost progress only to this owner montage, once across all dummy recipients. Unconnected requests add no pause. Every request retains its native row, captured talent and distinct energy group; AoE does not multiply Charge or Cycle. Normal continuation lasts through actual recovery plus2s. Skill's16s cooldown begins at its reached ordinary.182290/Echoes.110328 marker; Finale costs120 and starts20s cooldown at admission, applying self Eyes and target Insight at progress0. Replacement/field exit cancels unreached montage requests without refund. This is the checked source-coordinate product model, not measured animation timing or a global time stop; secondary actions and entry have separate acceptance.

daffodil.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Daffodil character:1054 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Daffodil CHAOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, Branch, AirAttack, EntryAttack, PerfectEvadeAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

daffodil.phantom_step_v1: Daffodil Phantom Step is funded only by a successful Finale progress-0 reset to two uses with one World-time30s admission handle. A distinct-actor switch to a living Daffodil while the handle and a captured living target are live selects one Entry1/2/2_1/3/4 train; A2 adds Entry3_1. When a qualified entry also admits Support, use the QTE owner clock and the guarded AppearAttack transition at 1.150000 seconds of montage progress to start the full Step train. A successful pre-transition Support parry settles its finisher first. Each admitted Step spends one remaining charge. An explicit successful Daffodil parry before the Step final marker selects one AppearSuccess finisher; without it A2 alone selects that same single finisher. The one charge is committed at admitted entry and is not refunded by interruption, switching away or missing. The first positive finisher connection fills only Daffodil's energy pool to capacity once; other AoE recipients cannot duplicate it. The entry target and route are captured at admission. The owner-only Step clock uses source contact coordinates, pauses, and recovery; field exit or defeat cancels unreached packets while the independent charge deadline follows World time. The declared stationary-dummy model supplies no geometry or enemy response.

daffodil.resonance_skill_capture_v1: Each admitted native-role party Support grants one persistent Daffodil Resonance stack, capped at two. Skill consumes and captures its pool at admission: per stack general Skill damage +0.50 and additive Break Efficiency +1.25, replaced by +1.00 and +2.50 at selected A1. Two stacks select six Skill3 packets and one Skill4 finisher (Echoes). Later Supports affect only the next pool; failed admission consumes nothing. This bounded owner model does not establish native animation timing or automatic Support eligibility.

daffodil.secondary_actions_v1: Daffodil secondary actions require ordinary_clock_v1 and action_cancels_v1. Plunge uses authored positive landing time and height0..1, one native.424ATK level1 landing request, recovery.281249s and connected.0396s lost progress. Ordinary front/back Dodge pays shared declared stamina15 and its selected1.014541/1.007068s owner recovery, with immunity only until that action is cancelled or completes. One explicit successful paid Critical Dodge authorizes the next canonical Normal as Close Call, one1.04ATK level1 request with.874201s recovery and connected.297s lost progress; another non-Normal input, field exit or defeat clears authorization. Qualified adjacent-element switching admits one actual Support/QTE instead of a raw authored packet, at.745033s with.900691s recovery plus connected.34965s lost progress and.863029s switch lock. Its successful cast grants Resonance once regardless of target count; packet Charge5.6/Cycle0 remain separate from Riposte2.6/4.3 and plunge2.7/4.4. Causal AoE requests and inherited pause use the same owner clock. Suspended Displaced Edge, held Normal and charge-funded Phantom Step remain separate routes. This is the checked stationary dummy product model, not measured game animation or inferred automatic incoming success.

daffodil.skill_burst_packets_v1: Daffodil Resonance delivers eight Skill hits on target zero (two GE_Player_Daffodill_Skill1_Damage, five GE_Player_Daffodill_Skill2_Damage, and one GE_Player_Daffodill_Skill5_Damage); Finale delivers fourteen UltraSkill hits (three GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill1_Damage, three GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill2_Damage, seven GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill4_Damage, and one GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill5_Damage). All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, Phantom Step, Parry Attack or complete kit behavior.

damage.fixed_crit_rate_as_probability_v1: Interpret a nonzero native FixedCritRate scalar as the packet's replacement critical-hit probability. Preserve normal critical-damage calculation and only roll when the packet's damage kind is crit-eligible; this does not claim native stat-capture or periodic-tick timing semantics.

gear.cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Ultimate admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Weapon and set effects retain their own recipient, stacking and expiry policies. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis; native animation timing remains unresolved.

owner.action_role.character_1054_qte_v1: Classify this exact frozen character action as QTE because its DT_CharacterAbilityConfig identity names the owner action as QTE while DT_CharacterAbilityEffectConfig has no row; this role is an owner-reviewed model hypothesis for this ability only.

sakiri.burst_atk_v1: Current GA_Sagiri_UltraSkill activation independently requests ordinary Buff_Sagiri003_QDamUp and, only with node4, Buff_Sagiri003_Level4_1. Each adds30percent of the source GetAtkBase to other living teammates for20 World seconds, with no self grant. The separate cap1 carriers refresh rather than stack. Base includes compiled character and equipped weapon base ATK, excluding console flat/percent and recipient ATK. The selected managed snapshot lifetime survives source defeat; dead recipients receive no new grant and existing dead carriers contribute nothing. Actual admitted activation produces the grants, without hit or damage requirements. This explicit lifetime/recipient model does not simulate multiplayer global-component routing.

sakiri.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Sakiri character:1003 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Sakiri INCANTATION are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. The explicit GE_Player_Sagiri_AirAttack1_Damage packet input is excluded from this energy adapter; native plunge energy eligibility remains unresolved. Burst, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

sakiri.skill_burst_packets_v1: Sakiri Devour Whole delivers Skill1 and Skill2 once each on target zero; Feast of Gluttony delivers UltraSkill1 five times and UltraSkill2 once. All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, eating mode or complete kit behavior.

sakiri.suppress_v1: Sakiri's first connected Ultimate packet per admitted input and actual recipient attempts the source-bound Suppress effect once. Child pulses and other recipients retain their causal command identity; switching does not rearm an earlier attempt. Suppress lasts 3 World seconds, or 6 with selected A1, using Sagiri_Suppress and Sagiri_lv1_Suppress. Only successful control applies the Impish Trick child DEF reduction: one shared target instance subtracts 10 percent of authored base DEF for 20 seconds, independently of the shorter control lifetime. If base_def is omitted, authored total DEF is also the assumed base; an explicit base 1000/total 1500 yields 1400, not 1350. The reduction refreshes at the next successful control and clamps effective DEF at zero. These choices bind the recovered SKILL_EVENT_AFTER_HIT -> suppress object -> control marker and DEF-child chain, not every damage input or mere preexisting airborne state. Native control immunity, hybrid-server routing, exact application/capture clocks and passive unlock dispatch remain unverified; the reviewed baseline enables the passive. Other floating/Skill control and A5 transitions retain their separate owner limits.

sets.crimson_v1: Crimson: Twin Butterflies binds Incantation_4_1/4_2/4_3 to the four-piece description (.06/6/10). Each connected delivered wearer hit grants one independent self ATK stack before same-time queued hits, including multi-packet inputs. The cap discards new applications without refreshing existing stacks. Each stack expires independently on world time, before equal-time hits; switching preserves stacks and allies cannot grant or receive them. The native trigger is AsyncTaskCharacterAttacked with an element check the frozen evidence does not fully resolve; hit-granted stacks are a tested hypothesis. Trigger timing and cap behavior are tested hypotheses; set count declares matching native geometry. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

sets.diabolos_v2: An equipped Diabolos four-piece wearer ignores twelve Chaos resistance percentage points for its own Chaos packets. On a qualified engine Esper Cycle admission that produces Nova or Scorch, both living outgoing/incoming actors are participants independently of captured reaction ownership; each equipped wearer receives one self-only twenty-second window before Cycle spend and reaction production. During that window the frozen twenty-four-point ignore replaces the baseline twelve, rather than adding to it. Further eligible participation refreshes the nonstacking window; field exit preserves its world-clock deadline and exact expiry restores the baseline. Ineligible switches, same-actor swaps, other reactions, nonwearers and non-Chaos packets receive no powered benefit. Participant effects are prepared atomically before publishing buffs/receipts. This extends the switch-based reaction model and supersedes v1's unconditional-only implementation; native participation dispatch and clock fidelity remain unverified.

weapons.black_book_v1: Black Tome grants the wearer its frozen Break Intensity points unconditionally. The points join the break damage zone as 1 + BI/300 + break_bonus_sum; they do not enter gauge accumulation. Arc: Black Tome is sealed by two chains by default; each team Support Skill cast unleashes one chain. When fully unleashed, explicit Arc admission enters a 0.2-second startup. Successful startup summons the Black Tome for 20 seconds with no normal cooldown and reseals the Arc with two chains; an interruption during startup instead applies a 30-second cancellation cooldown and does not summon or reseal. A pending startup or live summon prevents overlapping activation. The summon designates an enemy at spawn and refreshes designation every 5 seconds, preferring living locked targets else lowest index. The wearer gains its frozen Chaos damage bonus against designated enemies. When a designated enemy takes Break damage while the summon is active, the wearer deals an immediate Chaos ATK hit. Switching preserves the summon; death during startup cancels it, while ticks and designation stop on wearer death and pending hits cancel postmortem. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.good_boy_v3: Good Boy retains the once-compiled additive Charge Efficiency from v2 and its admitted-Ultimate shared team ATK window. A successful control receipt produced by that wearer's same admitted Ultimate upgrades the single active named window from its frozen base ATK ratio to base plus the frozen 6/7/8/9/10 percent refinement ratio. The extra ratio latches once per cast across recipients and survives the control status ending; it lasts only the remainder of the original 20-second world-time deadline. It never stacks per target, refreshes on repeated hit/control callbacks, or extends from control time. Expired windows, stale commands and an older wearer's control after another wearer replaced the shared snapshot cannot upgrade it. Ordinary Ultimate damage, mere airborne state, Boss metadata, other actors and non-Ultimate control are insufficient; the engine's actual successful-control receipt is required. This supersedes v2's missing-control-consumer limit under the explicit combat.control_effects_v1 model, currently produced by Sakiri Suppress. Native conditional capture, original application ordering and cross-wearer priority remain tested product assumptions. Legacy explicit TeamAtk-only procs default their omitted control ratio to zero; native projectors bind it at every refinement.

weapons.jingmotingyuan_v1: Silent Garden grants one wearer-only additive CRIT DMG stack after positive settled HP consumption, capped at four with shared refreshed five-second world-time expiry. Zero consumption, dead actors, incoming damage and action tags alone grant nothing. The explicit arc input requires the living active wearer outside recovery and its source-bound 25-second cooldown. It consumes the source-bound 5% of current HP, rounded to nearest integer with exact halves upward and clamped to preserve one HP, then grants the consumption stack before damage. One independent seeded wearer stream chooses equally between five Incantation ATK packets and six with a doubled final coefficient; refinement curves remain source-bound. The bounded atomic timing model resolves ordered packets at activation without added recovery, across all in-range dummies, with one choice and cost per activation and no ordinary character-hit energy or chain advancement. Native attack intervals, recovery, recipient selection, HP rounding, probabilities and other ability HP costs remain unresolved; this model does not establish full weapon readiness. Switching preserves owner cooldown and RNG. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.tuansanlang_v1: Danzaburou grants its frozen Break Intensity points to every team member (including the wearer) whose Esper Type matches the wearer's, once the team holds 3 or more characters of that Esper Type. Esper Type is the character's native CharacterElementType. Grants through this path do not stack: when several wearers qualify for the same element, the largest bonus applies. Break Intensity points join the break damage zone as 1 + BI/300 + break_bonus_sum under the separate explicit target Break models. The roster threshold counts deployed slots, including defeated matching peers, while only living carriers supply the aura. Field presence is not required. Each new Break generation captures the eligible strongest aura with the other source parameters; subsequent carrier death does not alter accepted packets. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

baicang.actor_hitstop_v1: With the Power Word model, Baicang montage coordinates advance through causal positive-HP-contact pauses using exact PPM integration and earliest integer deadlines. Normal1/2/5 request .033s at .1; Normal3 requests .067s at .1 after .04s; each Normal4 contact requests .033s at .1 after .033s; Formless contacts request .1s at .3, Riposte .3s at .01, QTE .3s at .3. Coincident recipients share a request and overlaps use the strongest slowdown. Raw Normal/recovery/cancel coordinates replace baked local pause additions; Formless actors emit with the direct source marker and travel .25s. Released actors/projectiles, activated Words/field lifetimes, cooldowns, costs and combat time remain real. Unreleased producers, field activation, recovery and legal cancel windows follow caster progress across actions, including residual pauses after jump/interruption/switch. Execute requests .3s at .3 only for the owner's locked target (dummy0). No pause is invented for zero HP loss, missing duration, other actors or target AI.

baicang.judgment_of_autumn_domain_v1: A successfully admitted native Baicang GA_Cang_UltraSkill keeps the existing GE_Player_Cang_UltraSkill2_Damage expansion hit once and starts one generation of GE_Player_Cang_UltraSkill_Damage on target zero at cast+2s, +4s, and every 2s through the 12s endpoint inclusive (six ticks) or A5 16s endpoint inclusive (eight ticks). Each tick uses the admitted effective Burst talent coordinate and captured owner/action/packet metadata, samples the living owner's current ATK and buffs plus target mitigation at delivery, and retains native FixedCritRate 0.5 under damage.fixed_crit_rate_as_probability_v1. Recast replaces prior pending ticks; a living off-field owner continues, a defeated owner cancels, and a defeated target receives no later hit or revival. Domain buffs keep their existing half-open deadline, so the inclusive endpoint tick does not receive them. One target and the inclusive scheduling/endpoint rules are bounded hypotheses; this does not model the description's execute, fatal immunity, Power Words Silence/Objurgate/Bless, or the complete kit. If a domain expansion or tick leaves a living target below 10% HP, execution rejects because the required execute branch is unsupported; target kind is unavailable, so this conservatively uses the description's 10% threshold.

baicang.moderate_mischief_v1: Baicang breakthrough 2 refreshes the live locked target's existing Scorch once per generated Word, preserving its original offensive snapshot, attribution and tick phase. Ordinary Scorch stays capped at one; the existing Zankou extension retains its three-stack admission. Expired or absent Scorch creates no application and refresh cannot generate a Word.

The chain loops after stage five and resets on a different admitted ability, field exit or a gap greater than 2 seconds between input starts. Reset rules, gap and ordered coincident delivery at the research primary impact time are tested hypotheses pending animation/cancel evidence. Heavy attack variations, freeze interactions and complete kit behavior remain unsupported.

Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, enhanced/alternate forms, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

daffodil.action_cancels_v1: Daffodil action cancels require ordinary_clock_v1. Jump and Skill use the selected native stage gates through the same owner lost-progress clock; an ordinary invalid early input does not interrupt. Accepted Jump/replacement removes unreached montage requests and resets the Normal pointer without refunding costs or captured Resonance. A new montage inherits any still-live owner pause, while World deadlines retain their exact remaining duration through shared pauses. Explicit forced interruption releases recovery and cancels pending montage work; pre-notify Skill starts3s cancel cooldown at interruption, post-notify retains its original16s deadline. A completed cast is not interrupted retroactively. This binds finite source gates and causal cancellation, not airborne geometry, paid Dodge, suspended combo or a recovered native interruption body.

daffodil.branch_entry_direct_packet_energy_v1: For Daffodil character:1054 only, an explicitly modeled GA_Daffodill_Melee Branch1-7 or EntryAttack1/2/4 direct packet grants its frozen DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the frozen source-element to recipient-element coefficient from DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (3/5 for Daffodil CHAOS), then applies their own Charge Efficiency, exact fractional carry, capacity and overflow accounting. This exact direct-input policy is a tested hypothesis, not evidence of native eligibility. Natural Branch/Entry dispatch, animation, timing, target rules, jump/dodge legality, stamina, costs, cadence, extra packets, other targets and callbacks remain unresolved; Branch6/7 are frozen packet rows without a published-tip binding.

daffodil.insight_break_capture_v1: Finale applies independent source-owned target Insight: one refreshed stack for 45 seconds, or up to two stacks with shared refreshed 9999-second expiry at selected A3. Self Eyes remains 30 seconds at every awakening. At a new target Break, selected A4 adds 0.15 Break bonus per own Insight stack and A5 adds one captured own contribution per stack. Capture uses this recipient and source only; marks survive field exit/source death, expire half-open, and clear on target death. Base roster contributions precede repeats in source-slot order; defeated recipients cancel pending contributions. This is a bounded owner model, not proof of native callbacks or montage timing; R6 Broken Chaos shred remains unbound.

daffodil.ordinary_clock_v1: Daffodil's selected finite Normal, ordinary/Echoes Skill and Finale montage coordinates advance on real combat time, rounded once to nearest microsecond. Each connected causal request adds its integrated native duration*(1-rate) lost progress only to this owner montage, once across all dummy recipients. Unconnected requests add no pause. Every request retains its native row, captured talent and distinct energy group; AoE does not multiply Charge or Cycle. Normal continuation lasts through actual recovery plus2s. Skill's16s cooldown begins at its reached ordinary.182290/Echoes.110328 marker; Finale costs120 and starts20s cooldown at admission, applying self Eyes and target Insight at progress0. Replacement/field exit cancels unreached montage requests without refund. This is the checked source-coordinate product model, not measured animation timing or a global time stop; secondary actions and entry have separate acceptance.

daffodil.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Daffodil character:1054 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Daffodil CHAOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, Branch, AirAttack, EntryAttack, PerfectEvadeAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

daffodil.phantom_step_v1: Daffodil Phantom Step is funded only by a successful Finale progress-0 reset to two uses with one World-time30s admission handle. A distinct-actor switch to a living Daffodil while the handle and a captured living target are live selects one Entry1/2/2_1/3/4 train; A2 adds Entry3_1. When a qualified entry also admits Support, use the QTE owner clock and the guarded AppearAttack transition at 1.150000 seconds of montage progress to start the full Step train. A successful pre-transition Support parry settles its finisher first. Each admitted Step spends one remaining charge. An explicit successful Daffodil parry before the Step final marker selects one AppearSuccess finisher; without it A2 alone selects that same single finisher. The one charge is committed at admitted entry and is not refunded by interruption, switching away or missing. The first positive finisher connection fills only Daffodil's energy pool to capacity once; other AoE recipients cannot duplicate it. The entry target and route are captured at admission. The owner-only Step clock uses source contact coordinates, pauses, and recovery; field exit or defeat cancels unreached packets while the independent charge deadline follows World time. The declared stationary-dummy model supplies no geometry or enemy response.

daffodil.resonance_skill_capture_v1: Each admitted native-role party Support grants one persistent Daffodil Resonance stack, capped at two. Skill consumes and captures its pool at admission: per stack general Skill damage +0.50 and additive Break Efficiency +1.25, replaced by +1.00 and +2.50 at selected A1. Two stacks select six Skill3 packets and one Skill4 finisher (Echoes). Later Supports affect only the next pool; failed admission consumes nothing. This bounded owner model does not establish native animation timing or automatic Support eligibility.

daffodil.secondary_actions_v1: Daffodil secondary actions require ordinary_clock_v1 and action_cancels_v1. Plunge uses authored positive landing time and height0..1, one native.424ATK level1 landing request, recovery.281249s and connected.0396s lost progress. Ordinary front/back Dodge pays shared declared stamina15 and its selected1.014541/1.007068s owner recovery, with immunity only until that action is cancelled or completes. One explicit successful paid Critical Dodge authorizes the next canonical Normal as Close Call, one1.04ATK level1 request with.874201s recovery and connected.297s lost progress; another non-Normal input, field exit or defeat clears authorization. Qualified adjacent-element switching admits one actual Support/QTE instead of a raw authored packet, at.745033s with.900691s recovery plus connected.34965s lost progress and.863029s switch lock. Its successful cast grants Resonance once regardless of target count; packet Charge5.6/Cycle0 remain separate from Riposte2.6/4.3 and plunge2.7/4.4. Causal AoE requests and inherited pause use the same owner clock. Suspended Displaced Edge, held Normal and charge-funded Phantom Step remain separate routes. This is the checked stationary dummy product model, not measured game animation or inferred automatic incoming success.

daffodil.skill_burst_packets_v1: Daffodil Resonance delivers eight Skill hits on target zero (two GE_Player_Daffodill_Skill1_Damage, five GE_Player_Daffodill_Skill2_Damage, and one GE_Player_Daffodill_Skill5_Damage); Finale delivers fourteen UltraSkill hits (three GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill1_Damage, three GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill2_Damage, seven GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill4_Damage, and one GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill5_Damage). All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, Phantom Step, Parry Attack or complete kit behavior.

damage.fixed_crit_rate_as_probability_v1: Interpret a nonzero native FixedCritRate scalar as the packet's replacement critical-hit probability. Preserve normal critical-damage calculation and only roll when the packet's damage kind is crit-eligible; this does not claim native stat-capture or periodic-tick timing semantics.

fireflies.all_in_range_v1: Under the all-in-range dummy contract the source's "nearby enemy" condition is a declared scenario rule: every eligible scenario-declared dummy is nearby by definition, so no position, radius, shape or placement check gates the trigger on a connected Anima hit. Defeated dummies never produce connected hits and keep their existing skip rules; the source must be living. This is not a claim about native proximity radius or recipient selection; native trigger consumer behavior remains unresolved.

fireflies.team_anima_hit_v1: A connected, nonzero elemental Anima packet from any living team member grants one independent Fireflies CRIT DMG stack to each living team member wearing Fireflies, including off-field wearers. A wearer does not grant an extra stack merely for being the source; each wearer receives exactly one stack per packet.

gear.cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Ultimate admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Weapon and set effects retain their own recipient, stacking and expiry policies. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis; native animation timing remains unresolved.

linko.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Linko character:1072 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Linko NATURE are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, enhanced/alternate forms, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

linko.skill_four_hits_v1: One admitted GA_Radio072_Skill delivers the native Skill1 primary followed by Skill2, Skill3, and Skill4 once each on target zero, using the admitted effective Skill talent coordinate and sampling live modifiers per packet. Ordered coincident delivery at the primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis; animation intervals, travel, AoE, and summon behavior remain unresolved.

linko.xiaozhen_pet_v1: Linko's canonical Skill retains its four bombardment packets and deploys Xiaozhen once; companion deployment does not also instantiate the separate two-packet Throw route. An explicitly selected Throw primary keeps that two-packet route. The first autonomous pulse is eight World seconds after the admitted primary delivery, six with A1, and continuing pulses use the same interval without an extra energy pool. Pulses inherit the deploying Skill's effective native talent coordinate. Recasting replaces the generation without duplicating old pulses; field exit preserves the companion, while owner defeat clears permission and invalidates its generation. Source uses existing bounded caller action timing rather than measured native montage playback. This revisable selection separates ordinary and alternate Skill packets and retains the existing pulse resource policy.

owner.action_role.character_1054_qte_v1: Classify this exact frozen character action as QTE because its DT_CharacterAbilityConfig identity names the owner action as QTE while DT_CharacterAbilityEffectConfig has no row; this role is an owner-reviewed model hypothesis for this ability only.

sakiri.burst_atk_v1: Current GA_Sagiri_UltraSkill activation independently requests ordinary Buff_Sagiri003_QDamUp and, only with node4, Buff_Sagiri003_Level4_1. Each adds30percent of the source GetAtkBase to other living teammates for20 World seconds, with no self grant. The separate cap1 carriers refresh rather than stack. Base includes compiled character and equipped weapon base ATK, excluding console flat/percent and recipient ATK. The selected managed snapshot lifetime survives source defeat; dead recipients receive no new grant and existing dead carriers contribute nothing. Actual admitted activation produces the grants, without hit or damage requirements. This explicit lifetime/recipient model does not simulate multiplayer global-component routing.

sakiri.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Sakiri character:1003 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Sakiri INCANTATION are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. The explicit GE_Player_Sagiri_AirAttack1_Damage packet input is excluded from this energy adapter; native plunge energy eligibility remains unresolved. Burst, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

sakiri.skill_burst_packets_v1: Sakiri Devour Whole delivers Skill1 and Skill2 once each on target zero; Feast of Gluttony delivers UltraSkill1 five times and UltraSkill2 once. All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, eating mode or complete kit behavior.

sakiri.suppress_v1: Sakiri's first connected Ultimate packet per admitted input and actual recipient attempts the source-bound Suppress effect once. Child pulses and other recipients retain their causal command identity; switching does not rearm an earlier attempt. Suppress lasts 3 World seconds, or 6 with selected A1, using Sagiri_Suppress and Sagiri_lv1_Suppress. Only successful control applies the Impish Trick child DEF reduction: one shared target instance subtracts 10 percent of authored base DEF for 20 seconds, independently of the shorter control lifetime. If base_def is omitted, authored total DEF is also the assumed base; an explicit base 1000/total 1500 yields 1400, not 1350. The reduction refreshes at the next successful control and clamps effective DEF at zero. These choices bind the recovered SKILL_EVENT_AFTER_HIT -> suppress object -> control marker and DEF-child chain, not every damage input or mere preexisting airborne state. Native control immunity, hybrid-server routing, exact application/capture clocks and passive unlock dispatch remain unverified; the reviewed baseline enables the passive. Other floating/Skill control and A5 transitions retain their separate owner limits.

sets.crimson_v1: Crimson: Twin Butterflies binds Incantation_4_1/4_2/4_3 to the four-piece description (.06/6/10). Each connected delivered wearer hit grants one independent self ATK stack before same-time queued hits, including multi-packet inputs. The cap discards new applications without refreshing existing stacks. Each stack expires independently on world time, before equal-time hits; switching preserves stacks and allies cannot grant or receive them. The native trigger is AsyncTaskCharacterAttacked with an element check the frozen evidence does not fully resolve; hit-granted stacks are a tested hypothesis. Trigger timing and cap behavior are tested hypotheses; set count declares matching native geometry. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

sets.diabolos_v2: An equipped Diabolos four-piece wearer ignores twelve Chaos resistance percentage points for its own Chaos packets. On a qualified engine Esper Cycle admission that produces Nova or Scorch, both living outgoing/incoming actors are participants independently of captured reaction ownership; each equipped wearer receives one self-only twenty-second window before Cycle spend and reaction production. During that window the frozen twenty-four-point ignore replaces the baseline twelve, rather than adding to it. Further eligible participation refreshes the nonstacking window; field exit preserves its world-clock deadline and exact expiry restores the baseline. Ineligible switches, same-actor swaps, other reactions, nonwearers and non-Chaos packets receive no powered benefit. Participant effects are prepared atomically before publishing buffs/receipts. This extends the switch-based reaction model and supersedes v1's unconditional-only implementation; native participation dispatch and clock fidelity remain unverified.

weapons.black_book_v1: Black Tome grants the wearer its frozen Break Intensity points unconditionally. The points join the break damage zone as 1 + BI/300 + break_bonus_sum; they do not enter gauge accumulation. Arc: Black Tome is sealed by two chains by default; each team Support Skill cast unleashes one chain. When fully unleashed, explicit Arc admission enters a 0.2-second startup. Successful startup summons the Black Tome for 20 seconds with no normal cooldown and reseals the Arc with two chains; an interruption during startup instead applies a 30-second cancellation cooldown and does not summon or reseal. A pending startup or live summon prevents overlapping activation. The summon designates an enemy at spawn and refreshes designation every 5 seconds, preferring living locked targets else lowest index. The wearer gains its frozen Chaos damage bonus against designated enemies. When a designated enemy takes Break damage while the summon is active, the wearer deals an immediate Chaos ATK hit. Switching preserves the summon; death during startup cancels it, while ticks and designation stop on wearer death and pending hits cancel postmortem. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.good_boy_v3: Good Boy retains the once-compiled additive Charge Efficiency from v2 and its admitted-Ultimate shared team ATK window. A successful control receipt produced by that wearer's same admitted Ultimate upgrades the single active named window from its frozen base ATK ratio to base plus the frozen 6/7/8/9/10 percent refinement ratio. The extra ratio latches once per cast across recipients and survives the control status ending; it lasts only the remainder of the original 20-second world-time deadline. It never stacks per target, refreshes on repeated hit/control callbacks, or extends from control time. Expired windows, stale commands and an older wearer's control after another wearer replaced the shared snapshot cannot upgrade it. Ordinary Ultimate damage, mere airborne state, Boss metadata, other actors and non-Ultimate control are insufficient; the engine's actual successful-control receipt is required. This supersedes v2's missing-control-consumer limit under the explicit combat.control_effects_v1 model, currently produced by Sakiri Suppress. Native conditional capture, original application ordering and cross-wearer priority remain tested product assumptions. Legacy explicit TeamAtk-only procs default their omitted control ratio to zero; native projectors bind it at every refinement.

weapons.jingmotingyuan_v1: Silent Garden grants one wearer-only additive CRIT DMG stack after positive settled HP consumption, capped at four with shared refreshed five-second world-time expiry. Zero consumption, dead actors, incoming damage and action tags alone grant nothing. The explicit arc input requires the living active wearer outside recovery and its source-bound 25-second cooldown. It consumes the source-bound 5% of current HP, rounded to nearest integer with exact halves upward and clamped to preserve one HP, then grants the consumption stack before damage. One independent seeded wearer stream chooses equally between five Incantation ATK packets and six with a doubled final coefficient; refinement curves remain source-bound. The bounded atomic timing model resolves ordered packets at activation without added recovery, across all in-range dummies, with one choice and cost per activation and no ordinary character-hit energy or chain advancement. Native attack intervals, recovery, recipient selection, HP rounding, probabilities and other ability HP costs remain unresolved; this model does not establish full weapon readiness. Switching preserves owner cooldown and RNG. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.moon_v1: Stellar Veil adds its frozen Psyche ratio to matching delivered packets in the additive damage-bonus zone. Dealing Psyche DMG grants one wearer stack of Crit DMG through ProcCallback up to ten stacks, with a 0.1s trigger cooldown. Each trigger refreshes the group's duration to 5s, including at cap. Switching preserves stacks and cooldown; exact expiry precedes equal-time hits. Cooldown, stacking, and world-time clocks are tested hypotheses. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

entries.label: Blackbird · Nova
assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

blackbird.b2_nova_v1: Living breakthrough2 Blackbird captures baseATK per target Nova generation and accumulates actual positive applied HP loss during its half-open lifetime, excluding its triggering Support/QTE command and children, all ordinary Nova ticks and Blackbird settlement packets. At end, after pending shared damage, settle min(accumulatedHP/5,1000*capturedBaseATK) as fixed Mental HP damage unaffected by crit, DEF, RES or buffs, with no resources. The initial generation may create one fresh shared Nova with its own accumulator; that child cannot reapply. A new authored refresh takes precedence over the automatic child. Source defeat disables the extra/reapplication; target death cancels without postmortem settlement.

blackbird.coordinated_bird_v1: Ordinary Skill re-arms one Blackbird bird controller per cast generation, clears marks/count, starts ready at cast time and enforces an inclusive2s interval between accepted requests, with five accepted requests maximum. Each positive surviving Skill recipient refreshes its own15s mark without resetting the controller. Positive HP damage by a different currently active living ally to a live marked dummy accepts once per causal packet, selecting the first/lowest live marked recipient. Blackbird own/off-field/zero-HP/Nova/bird damage cannot request coordination. Dispatch one full uncapped native SkillAssist AoE after the causal packet HP/resource/Break settlement, using invested Skill talent, zero inferred travel, ordinary live stats and per-target RNG, one Charge/Cycle/Break opportunity across recipients. An accepted count is not refunded on target death. Recast cancels uncommitted old-generation requests; field exit preserves marks/count, owner death disables new requests. A6 positively connected birds grant4 exact Malice once outside form through the separate resource model. Autonomous receipts retain both the original Skill command and real earlier triggering hit without inventing an authored cast. Requires ordinary Malice; does not establish transformed action/form lifetimes.

blackbird.evolve_actions_v1: Bind Blackbird evolved abilities during active transformation form: GA_BlackBird_Evolve_Melee (5 stages delivering 2, 5, 6, 1, 6 primary packets with native progress and hit-pause .0297s, Melee5 .015s), GA_BlackBird_Evolve_Skill (4 packets, 1s cooldown, requiring and consuming the 30s permission granted by Melee5 at progress .351288s, healing 4x base ATK with A2, multiplied by 2.5 with A1), and GA_BlackBird_Evolve_UltraSkill (finishing Burst delivering 7 packets, removing form at commit, multiplied by 1.5 with R3). Each connected primary hit consuming Malice spends up to its native threshold (Melee1..5: .541591, .369949, .349951, 2.258020, .784891; Skill: 3.25) and enqueues one separate category A Extra packet at hit+.067s (Melee5 hit+.100s) with coefficient k*spent (k+k3 with A3, k reading Normal talent level). With A1 finisher first hit spends all remaining Malice (max 60) for one extra; without A1 finisher preserves Malice with no extra. Requires primary form and exact Malice models.

blackbird.normal_chain_v1: Blackbird ordinary Normal advances five stages with multiplicities 1,2,4,5,5 from frozen neverness_blackbird descriptions and native DT_SkillDamageData coefficients. The chain loops after stage five and resets on a different admitted ability, field exit or a gap greater than 2 seconds between input starts. Reset rules, gap and ordered coincident delivery at the research primary impact time are tested hypotheses pending animation/cancel evidence. Evolve forms, Malice, travel, AoE, plunge, riposte and complete kit behavior remain unsupported.

blackbird.ordinary_clock_v1: Bind ordinary Blackbird Normal1..5 and four-hit Skill to their native montage progress coordinates, rounded once to nearest microsecond, at rate1. Positive applied HP from each causal primary packet adds one .03s owner hit-pause at .01 rate, shared across AoE recipients; zero HP loss adds none. The shared exact HitlagTracker projects only pending montage contacts and owner recovery, retaining real cooldowns, marks, birds, buffs and other actors. Simultaneous recipients retain their already emitted packet time. Normal continuity extends through its actual full recovery and2 World seconds afterward, with stage wrap/reset on other actions or field exit. Ordinary Skill has16s real cooldown, independent of hit-pause; generic caller clocks remain the historical boundary when this model is absent. This bounded clock does not certify Burst/form replacement, transformed/secondary actions or early cancel gates, which retain their separately tracked owner admission dependencies.

blackbird.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Blackbird character:1042 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Blackbird PSYCHE are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, enhanced/alternate forms, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Switching preserves the summon; death during startup cancels it, while ticks and designation stop on wearer death and pending hits cancel postmortem. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.good_boy_v3: Good Boy retains the once-compiled additive Charge Efficiency from v2 and its admitted-Ultimate shared team ATK window. A successful control receipt produced by that wearer's same admitted Ultimate upgrades the single active named window from its frozen base ATK ratio to base plus the frozen 6/7/8/9/10 percent refinement ratio. The extra ratio latches once per cast across recipients and survives the control status ending; it lasts only the remainder of the original 20-second world-time deadline. It never stacks per target, refreshes on repeated hit/control callbacks, or extends from control time. Expired windows, stale commands and an older wearer's control after another wearer replaced the shared snapshot cannot upgrade it. Ordinary Ultimate damage, mere airborne state, Boss metadata, other actors and non-Ultimate control are insufficient; the engine's actual successful-control receipt is required. This supersedes v2's missing-control-consumer limit under the explicit combat.control_effects_v1 model, currently produced by Sakiri Suppress. Native conditional capture, original application ordering and cross-wearer priority remain tested product assumptions. Legacy explicit TeamAtk-only procs default their omitted control ratio to zero; native projectors bind it at every refinement.

weapons.twinbirds_v2: Crime and Punishment grants its wearer the frozen refinement Cycle Intensity as additive stat points while alive, including before the first cast and off field. Its permanent self-only cycle_intensity modifier adds with authored CI and other eligible live modifiers; Esper Cycle ownership and damage capture consume the resulting total. It never grants Cycle Energy and is not an ATK or damage percentage. The wearer's Psyche damage bonus and Ultimate-triggered fifteen-second shared team plus additional self critical-damage buffs retain the v1 rules, including refresh on retrigger. This supersedes v1's unapplied Cycle Intensity parameter. Trigger timing, recipients, source lifetime and stack/refresh rules are bounded modeled policies from the reviewed owner card; native dispatch and Global release availability remain unverified.

entries.label: Blackbird · Stain / Chaos
assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

blackbird.b2_stain_v1: A living Blackbird with breakthrough2 enhances newly applied Stain to20 World seconds and base multiplier1.3, replacing1.2 rather than multiplying it by1.1. Capture enhancement once per generation, retain it after field exit/source defeat, refresh without stacking, and use each eligible Psyche/Lakshana damage actor's live Cycle Intensity. No extra HP packet or resource grant is created.

blackbird.coordinated_bird_v1: Ordinary Skill re-arms one Blackbird bird controller per cast generation, clears marks/count, starts ready at cast time and enforces an inclusive2s interval between accepted requests, with five accepted requests maximum. Each positive surviving Skill recipient refreshes its own15s mark without resetting the controller. Positive HP damage by a different currently active living ally to a live marked dummy accepts once per causal packet, selecting the first/lowest live marked recipient. Blackbird own/off-field/zero-HP/Nova/bird damage cannot request coordination. Dispatch one full uncapped native SkillAssist AoE after the causal packet HP/resource/Break settlement, using invested Skill talent, zero inferred travel, ordinary live stats and per-target RNG, one Charge/Cycle/Break opportunity across recipients. An accepted count is not refunded on target death. Recast cancels uncommitted old-generation requests; field exit preserves marks/count, owner death disables new requests. A6 positively connected birds grant4 exact Malice once outside form through the separate resource model. Autonomous receipts retain both the original Skill command and real earlier triggering hit without inventing an authored cast. Requires ordinary Malice; does not establish transformed action/form lifetimes.

blackbird.evolve_actions_v1: Bind Blackbird evolved abilities during active transformation form: GA_BlackBird_Evolve_Melee (5 stages delivering 2, 5, 6, 1, 6 primary packets with native progress and hit-pause .0297s, Melee5 .015s), GA_BlackBird_Evolve_Skill (4 packets, 1s cooldown, requiring and consuming the 30s permission granted by Melee5 at progress .351288s, healing 4x base ATK with A2, multiplied by 2.5 with A1), and GA_BlackBird_Evolve_UltraSkill (finishing Burst delivering 7 packets, removing form at commit, multiplied by 1.5 with R3). Each connected primary hit consuming Malice spends up to its native threshold (Melee1..5: .541591, .369949, .349951, 2.258020, .784891; Skill: 3.25) and enqueues one separate category A Extra packet at hit+.067s (Melee5 hit+.100s) with coefficient k*spent (k+k3 with A3, k reading Normal talent level). With A1 finisher first hit spends all remaining Malice (max 60) for one extra; without A1 finisher preserves Malice with no extra. Requires primary form and exact Malice models.

blackbird.normal_chain_v1: Blackbird ordinary Normal advances five stages with multiplicities 1,2,4,5,5 from frozen neverness_blackbird descriptions and native DT_SkillDamageData coefficients. The chain loops after stage five and resets on a different admitted ability, field exit or a gap greater than 2 seconds between input starts. Reset rules, gap and ordered coincident delivery at the research primary impact time are tested hypotheses pending animation/cancel evidence. Evolve forms, Malice, travel, AoE, plunge, riposte and complete kit behavior remain unsupported.

blackbird.ordinary_clock_v1: Bind ordinary Blackbird Normal1..5 and four-hit Skill to their native montage progress coordinates, rounded once to nearest microsecond, at rate1. Positive applied HP from each causal primary packet adds one .03s owner hit-pause at .01 rate, shared across AoE recipients; zero HP loss adds none. The shared exact HitlagTracker projects only pending montage contacts and owner recovery, retaining real cooldowns, marks, birds, buffs and other actors. Simultaneous recipients retain their already emitted packet time. Normal continuity extends through its actual full recovery and2 World seconds afterward, with stage wrap/reset on other actions or field exit. Ordinary Skill has16s real cooldown, independent of hit-pause; generic caller clocks remain the historical boundary when this model is absent. This bounded clock does not certify Burst/form replacement, transformed/secondary actions or early cancel gates, which retain their separately tracked owner admission dependencies.

blackbird.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Blackbird character:1042 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Blackbird PSYCHE are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, enhanced/alternate forms, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

blackbird.ordinary_malice_v1: Track ordinary Blackbird Malice as an exact nonnegative pool capped60, separate from Charge and Cycle. Living combat initialization grants20 once; no four-second in-combat refill. Ordinary Skill.2 grants40 once per admitted cast, even without a connected recipient. Ordinary positive-HP Normal packets grant exact native amounts .857919/1.762896/1.089593/.933937/1.317647 for stages1..5, once per causal packet across uncapped AoE recipients; a complete17-packet chain grants20.000003. Cap excess remains visible in a conserved exact ledger through waits and switches. This bounded resource binding does not certify transformed spending/extras, coordinated birds, ordinary secondary actions, QTE/parry or out-of-combat transitions, whose admission and lifetimes require their owner models; legacy packet-only fixtures retain their existing boundaries.

blackbird.primary_form_v1: Bind primary Blackbird Burst to the declared successful zero-delay mesh callback, native100 Ultimate cost and20s World cooldown. Capture the non-hybrid21.5s on-field World form lifetime at accepted commit; its9 primary contacts use native progress with .067s/.3 owner pauses and5.118154s recovery progress. Form time includes local hitstop while shared World progression is enabled, stops off field, resumes remaining time on entry and ends before equal-time ordinary admission; cooldowns, team buffs, reactions, bird requests and committed packets keep their declared clock policies. UltraSkill.3 at progress3.166927s applies the15s team base-ATK20% buff, replaced by A4's25s plus general damage12%; A6 independently grants own Psyche25% for25s. Already applied buffs persist source death. A2 adds20% base DEF only while the form lives, including its off-field pause; no phantom CritDamage is added. R3 commit grants20 exact Malice once, while ordinary gains including A6 birds are suppressed in form. Natural/death cleanup retains resources/cooldowns and committed packet identity. This bounded lifetime/primary binding requires all ordinary owner models; reached evolved inputs and qualified transformed Support explicitly diagnose until their own bindings are supplied. Finisher permissions, evolved attacks/extras and mesh callback failure/timeout are separate required owner work, never fabricated as ordinary attacks or successful failed callbacks.

blackbird.skill_burst_packets_v1: Blackbird Netherplume Rite delivers four Skill hits on target zero; Requies Animarum delivers nine UltraSkill hits. All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, Evolve forms, Malice gauge or complete kit behavior.

blackbird.skill_cycle_fill_v1: An admitted ordinary Blackbird Skill executes its Skill.2 HeterochromeExecution once at activation, filling the owner's Cycle pool to100 before any damage even when all packets miss. Grant only the missing whole amount, independent of Cycle gain efficiency, preserve exact fractional carry and prior overflow/spend accounting, and keep Ultimate Energy unchanged. Connected Skill packets retain their independent HeterochromeAdd channels and cap overflow. Failed admission, other actions and field entry do not fill Cycle; evolved Skill is outside this binding.

chaos.ordinary_clock_v1: Requires chaos.ordinary_crime_v1 and binds ordinary Chaos Normal1..5 and both Skill bites to selected native progress at1/s, rounded once to microseconds. Positive HP once per primary packet delays pending owner contacts and recovery by the documented effective pause: Normal1/3 .0198s, Normal2 .005/.016, Normal4 first .0495, Skill .0495 per bite; other reached ordinary rows add0. These effective progress losses are represented as exact full-stop intervals after contact, a selected implementation rule rather than a claim about the native slow-motion curve. AoE never multiplies pause. Normal continuity uses actual recovery plus2s; cooldowns, Warrant and DPS time stay real. Skill CD is15s from its .243640 progress marker. Skill applies Warrant at .283733 progress to the first two living eligible dummies in stable order, before damage, for15 World seconds, with source-owned live B4 replacement bonus .30 instead of .20. Existing marks continue off field. Field exit cancels future montage requests and an unreached mark marker. No polling or hidden wait; early cancel gates and interrupted Skill3/15 CD remain separate bindings. Transformation/Burst requires the separately accepted primary form model and diagnoses if absent; secondary actions and natural QTE remain separate. Selected A5 counts living source-owned marks, independently of dummy count.

chaos.ordinary_crime_v1: Bind Chaos ordinary Normal and Skill positive-HP Crime to one exact pool starting0, capped1000. Misses/zero HP/dead owners grant nothing. These primaries use full uncapped AoE with shared packet identities and separately bind native Ultimate charge and HeterochromeAdd through their existing exact ledgers. Normal continuity lasts through caller-authored recovery and2 World seconds afterward, with reset on another action or field exit. Caller packet timing and existing Warrant dispatch remain explicit historical boundaries; this resource prerequisite does not implement Crime auto ticks/spending, transformation, held Verdict, qualified QTE or full-kit acceptance. chaos.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Chaos character:1071 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. chaos.primary_form_v1: Requires Chaos ordinary Crime and clock models. Burst spends100 Ultimate energy and starts15s cooldown at accepted commit; its four UltraSkill1 and one UltraSkill2 main contacts follow native progress2.807466/3.180295/3.501765/3.947290/4.792259, recovery4.915031 and independent switch lock4.944578. Commit immunity ends at progress4.802493, not at recovery or form expiry. Burst marks all living dummies at2.7 and enters Dread Echo at2.718888 for12 World seconds, with no added Burst hit pause. While living/on field, one30 Crime tick occurs every.2s, first entry+.2, through the final endpoint at entry+12; the final tick grants then expires form before equal-time action admission. Off-field ticks are skipped without banking or resetting phase; expiry follows World time. Recast invalidates the old generation. Selected A6 fills the Crime pool to1000 once at commit.
