chaos.qte_direct_packet_energy_v1: For Chaos character:1071 only, the exact explicit GA_Chaos071_QTE / GE_Player_Chaos_QTE1_Damage scenario input grants its frozen DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd (6.4) once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the frozen source-element to recipient-element coefficient from DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (3/5 for Chaos LAKSHANA), then applies their own Charge Efficiency, exact fractional carry, capacity and overflow accounting through the shared policy. Delivery-time recipient and source ownership follow the shared tested policy. This exact direct-input energy behavior is a bounded scenario hypothesis, not evidence of native QTE eligibility or dispatch. QTE trigger, legality, cost, timing, multiplicity, additional targets and callbacks remain unresolved; other QTE packets are unsupported.

chaos.qualified_support_v1: Requires Chaos ordinary clock and binds one engine-owned QTE after an eligible adjacent-element entry switch spending the outgoing owner's100 Cycle; incoming Ultimate energy is not spent or required. Its native H packet hits all living dummies once at.704643 progress, recovery1.376352, no hit pause or extra cooldown, using its own Support talent coordinate in ordinary/form state. Native channels6.4 charge,0 Cycle,2.5 Break and0 Crime apply once per packet across recipients. QTE's switch lock starts at.000100 and ends at.875734, before AnySkill recovery, granting no early switch. Successful full recovery authorizes one later authored Appear Normal with the ordinary Normal1 row and .217820 first contact; it never emits a hidden attack. Consuming that Normal or another action/exit clears the permission; interruption before completion cannot grant it. Its combo hold, when the Normal combo model is accepted, requires.25 real seconds within the montage and progress strictly above.3, choosing live form for the new branch. Preserve direct-QTE charge policy, party distribution and real form phase. This is selected qualified entry/timing/continuation behavior, not proof of native automatic montage dispatch.

chaos.skill_bites_v1: Chaos Doubtmark delivers the two native bites once per successful cast on target zero, with the admitted effective talent coordinate for both ATK coefficients. The primary Skill1 packet precedes Skill2 at the selected impact timestamp. Coincident delivery is a timing hypothesis pending native animation evidence; each bite samples current wearer/target modifiers and applies the existing Warrant model. Crime, additional targets and unrelated kit branches remain pending.

chaos.suppression_packets_v1: Chaos Retribution's Suppression delivers four GE_Player_Chaos_UltraSkill1_Damage packets followed by one GE_Player_Chaos_UltraSkill2_Damage packet on target zero from one successful cast. The primary UltraSkill1 is first; three more UltraSkill1 children and one UltraSkill2 child use the admitted effective Burst talent coordinate at the primary impact timestamp. Ordered coincident delivery is a timing hypothesis pending native animation evidence. Every packet samples live modifiers and runs Chaos Warrant, A2 DEF ignore, A5 single-target damage, and A6 Lakshana resistance reduction independently; A3's cast-granted Crit DMG buff is active for the train. Crime, extra targets, and unrelated branches remain pending.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.stain_switch_v1: Extends combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1 to qualified Psyche/Lakshana switches: spend exactly one hundred outgoing Cycle and apply one twelve-second Stain status to living locked target zero. Reapplication replaces its expiry without stacking; its captured applier may leave the field or die without removing the status, while target death clears it. Each elemental Psyche/Lakshana packet against that target multiplies a separate Stain zone by (6/5)*(1+(1/5)*CI/(CI+180)), using the damage actor's live authored plus buff CI, independently of the pair winner. Generic damage/final bonuses and crit retain their own zones; Mental Nova, other elements and other targets receive no Stain factor. Stain creates no independent damage packet, crit draw, energy or Break grant. The modeled status supplies the existing HunXiang target tag for equipped predicates without certifying the native reaction getter. Duration, switch admission, live capture and the selected factor are reviewed bounded owner-model decisions; native dispatch and owner-specific Stain enhancements remain unresolved.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

daffodil.action_cancels_v1: Daffodil action cancels require ordinary_clock_v1. Jump and Skill use the selected native stage gates through the same owner lost-progress clock; an ordinary invalid early input does not interrupt. Accepted Jump/replacement removes unreached montage requests and resets the Normal pointer without refunding costs or captured Resonance. A new montage inherits any still-live owner pause, while World deadlines retain their exact remaining duration through shared pauses. Explicit forced interruption releases recovery and cancels pending montage work; pre-notify Skill starts3s cancel cooldown at interruption, post-notify retains its original16s deadline. A completed cast is not interrupted retroactively. This binds finite source gates and causal cancellation, not airborne geometry, paid Dodge, suspended combo or a recovered native interruption body.

daffodil.branch_entry_direct_packet_energy_v1: For Daffodil character:1054 only, an explicitly modeled GA_Daffodill_Melee Branch1-7 or EntryAttack1/2/4 direct packet grants its frozen DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. This exact direct-input policy is a tested hypothesis, not evidence of native eligibility. daffodil.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Daffodil character:1054 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. daffodil.phantom_step_v1: Daffodil Phantom Step is funded only by a successful Finale progress-0 reset to two uses with one World-time30s admission handle. A distinct-actor switch to a living Daffodil while the handle and a captured living target are live selects one Entry1/2/2_1/3/4 train; A2 adds Entry3_1. daffodil.resonance_skill_capture_v1: Each admitted native-role party Support grants one persistent Daffodil Resonance stack, capped at two. Skill consumes and captures its pool at admission: per stack general Skill damage +0.50 and additive Break Efficiency +1.25, replaced by +1.00 and +2.50 at selected A1. Two stacks select six Skill3 packets and one Skill4 finisher (Echoes). Later Supports affect only the next pool; failed admission consumes nothing. This bounded owner model does not establish native animation timing or automatic Support eligibility.

daffodil.skill_burst_packets_v1: Daffodil Resonance delivers eight Skill hits on target zero (two GE_Player_Daffodill_Skill1_Damage, five GE_Player_Daffodill_Skill2_Damage, and one GE_Player_Daffodill_Skill5_Damage); Finale delivers fourteen UltraSkill hits (three GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill1_Damage, three GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill2_Damage, seven GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill4_Damage, and one GE_Player_Daffodill_UltraSkill5_Damage). All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, Phantom Step, Parry Attack or complete kit behavior.

gear.cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Ultimate admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Weapon and set effects retain their own recipient, stacking and expiry policies. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis; native animation timing remains unresolved.

iroi.action_clock_v1: Iroi ordinary Normal uses the selected rate-one montage coordinates rounded once to microseconds, with exact next-Basic boundaries and distinct Skill/movement/other gates. Positive normal contacts add one33000us actor pause at rate.1 per causal projectile, delayed33000us for stages4/5; a zero-duration stage3 rate supplies no pause. Normal1/2 select one living locked recipient per projectile with deterministic fallback; stages3/4/5 cover all living eligible stationary dummies. Stage3 spawns one finite world actor at268779us progress, first contact200000us later then100000us spacing for eight contacts; launched actors survive caster progression/field exit, while unborn montage notifies cancel. Owner death prevents future actor ticks. Resource channels remain per causal packet, and live stats are sampled at impact. Continuing stages require the exact native queued Basic boundary; an idle input restarts stage1. This is a selected source-coordinate/contact inference, not measured playback. Canonical tap Skill uses montage cooldown249777us, heal/carrier498799us, Gun birth498827us with1200000us travel, Syringe birth551115us with seven100000us-spaced world contacts, and Trumpet birth601775us. Connected Skill actors add100000us player pauses at rate.1 once per causal packet, including on a replacement player montage; overlapping windows use minimum rate and never delay world ticks. Skill cooldown is12 World seconds from its notify, or3 seconds from interruption before that notify. Actual healing grants16 Moon once outside Dream and the self-excluded capped flat-ATK buff; normal healing callbacks retain live stats and passives. The tiny Skill carrier grants its sourced10 Charge once per effect application to an eligible living target, even when fractional damage rounds to zero integer HP loss; this disclosed rounding interpretation uses the ordinary exact carry/team ledger without fake HP or double grants. Other packets require positive HP loss. Explicit interruption removes unborn notifications and preserves launched actors and committed cooldowns. Selected A2 Skill diagnoses until its native assist exists. Native Burst reserves Moon at input, heals at1925956us, emits its Ivory-only direct packet at3385389us, installs pulses at3882835us and releases Dream drain/periods at4004747us montage progress; switch gate3764482us differs from4015812us ordinary recovery. Its real16s cooldown never follows montage pause. Setup projections shift only this owner reservation and pending Dream deadlines. Interrupted setup before any carrier retains unspent Moon without a Dream; after installation, actual cancellation releases only installed carriers with their full remaining Moon lifetime. These are explicit interruption/lifecycle inferences. Native pulses retain the actual Burst command/talent and reach all eligible living stationary dummies, with no inferred recipient cap. Existing Dream threshold, strict-before-end periods and death/generation invalidation remain authoritative. Held Branch/Transform, Lucid Dream, A2 assists, secondary and Regression interactions remain concrete dependencies before source selection.

iroi.burst_primary_packet_v1: An ordinary Iroi UltraSkill cast delivers the canonical GE_Player_Oneiroi_UltraSkill_Damage primary packet once at the selected impact timestamp, using the admitted effective Burst talent coordinate and native ATK array. This hypothesis covers only the direct packet; the sourced one-time post-cast heal has its own bounded model assumption. Conditional continuous healing, continuous damage, Imagination threshold/cost, dream duration and Regression revival remain unsupported; no periodic ticks or extra targets are inferred.

iroi.dream_state_v1: Burst admission captures Moon >= 30 as Ivory (direct UltraSkill damage and pulses) or Horn (healing only). Initial pause release at 4.0047474s starts 8 Moon/s drain, blocking all Moon gains. Every 1s provides periodic team heal and Ivory pulse until Moon reaches 0.

iroi.live_atk_healing_v1: Iroi ordinary Skill and the currently bound one-time Burst healing scale their frozen 13-level .943/1.413 starting coefficients from live source final ATK, superseding the historical MaxHP model. The accepted owner card's recovered GetAtk calculator owns this stat choice; the native coefficients are unchanged. Read compiled source ATK plus base-scaled live ATK percentages and flat buffs, including applicable equipped passive stats, at each real recipient callback without creating a damage packet or applying damage/crit/target modifiers. Apply source outgoing and recipient incoming healing bonuses, including selected A3 exactly once, then round gross once and clamp to missing HP. Each living recipient gets its actual settlement and positive gross, including overheal, may trigger compatible equipment. Dead sources and recipients do not heal or trigger listeners. Effective admitted talent coordinates are preserved. Skill's existing callback-at-admission and Burst's existing post-impact callback timing remain explicitly bounded caller models; native montage dispatch, QTE/A2 healing, Dream periodic healing, Moon gains and application-level B4/A5 dispatch remain separate queued bindings. This does not certify a complete Iroi kit.

iroi.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Iroi character:1075 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Iroi NATURE are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

owner.action_role.character_1071_qte_v1: Classify this exact frozen character action as QTE because its DT_CharacterAbilityConfig identity names the owner action as QTE while DT_CharacterAbilityEffectConfig has no row; this role is an owner-reviewed model hypothesis for this ability only.

sets.devils_blood_v1: Equipped Devil's Blood four-piece adds its source-bound base bonus to the wearer's ordinary damage-bonus zone. At packet delivery, any live status on the selected target carrying Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun or Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.HunXiang adds the conditional bonus once, regardless of source or stack count; both tags still grant only one extra bonus. Off-field deliveries retain wearer ownership and target statuses expire at their half-open deadlines. These evaluation and lifecycle rules are a bounded tooltip/tag model. Native GetReactionResultType handling and automatic Nova/Stain application remain separate shared-system work; True damage retains its existing bonus bypass.

sets.diabolos_v2: An equipped Diabolos four-piece wearer ignores twelve Chaos resistance percentage points for its own Chaos packets. On a qualified engine Esper Cycle admission that produces Nova or Scorch, both living outgoing/incoming actors are participants independently of captured reaction ownership; each equipped wearer receives one self-only twenty-second window before Cycle spend and reaction production. During that window the frozen twenty-four-point ignore replaces the baseline twelve, rather than adding to it. Further eligible participation refreshes the nonstacking window; field exit preserves its world-clock deadline and exact expiry restores the baseline. Ineligible switches, same-actor swaps, other reactions, nonwearers and non-Chaos packets receive no powered benefit. Participant effects are prepared atomically before publishing buffs/receipts. This extends the switch-based reaction model and supersedes v1's unconditional-only implementation; native participation dispatch and clock fidelity remain unverified.

sets.street_boxer_v2: Equipped Street Boxer four-piece adds the frozen baseline crit ratio once in its wearer's additive crit-rate zone. Any qualified team Esper Cycle producing Stain or Remora gives each living equipped wearer a self-only twenty-second nonstacking window, including off-field wearers who are neither pair participant nor reaction owner. Reapplication resets expiry; field exit preserves the world-clock deadline. The window's frozen Lakshana_4_2 crit ratio replaces Lakshana_4_1, never adds to it, and expiry restores the baseline. Both frozen ratios equal fourteen percent; the causal window and native parameter receipts remain explicit despite unchanged current damage. Other reactions and ordinary/unqualified swaps do not refresh it; nonwearers get no bonus. All team equipment effects are prepared atomically before publication. This supersedes v1's unconditional-only scope; native dispatch/capture and clock fidelity remain unverified.

weapons.black_book_v1: Black Tome grants the wearer its frozen Break Intensity points unconditionally. The points join the break damage zone as 1 + BI/300 + break_bonus_sum; they do not enter gauge accumulation. Arc: Black Tome is sealed by two chains by default; each team Support Skill cast unleashes one chain. When fully unleashed, explicit Arc admission enters a 0.2-second startup. Successful startup summons the Black Tome for 20 seconds with no normal cooldown and reseals the Arc with two chains; an interruption during startup instead applies a 30-second cancellation cooldown and does not summon or reseal. A pending startup or live summon prevents overlapping activation. The summon designates an enemy at spawn and refreshes designation every 5 seconds, preferring living locked targets else lowest index. The wearer gains its frozen Chaos damage bonus against designated enemies. When a designated enemy takes Break damage while the summon is active, the wearer deals an immediate Chaos ATK hit. Switching preserves the summon; death during startup cancels it, while ticks and designation stop on wearer death and pending hits cancel postmortem. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.gold_wool_chaos_realfinish_v1: For Chaos's accepted ordinary owner clock, What's Desired retains its native permanent Lakshana bonus and one self20s40/50/60/70/80% CRIT DMG window, but selects the recovered callback distinction: ordinary Skill grants on successful REALFINISH at projected full recovery, while Burst grants on Q_SKILL_BEGIN/accepted commit. This overrides only the default gold_wool_v1 Skill-admission trigger for that selected profile. Finish is anchored to the real admitted command and owner montage, projected through reached positive-hit and inherited pauses; cancellation, exit or defeat before completion removes it. A rejected or cancelled Skill grants no new window, without deleting an already granted window. Equal-time ordinary next inputs see a completed grant; preexisting ordinary immunity/resource/mark clocks are unchanged. Refresh is once under the same nonstacking key, not admission plus finish, and world expiry/field-exit persistence remain. Other owners and legacy caller-timed inputs retain their separately disclosed default trigger. Native callback distinction is selected source evidence; real-clock conversion and lifecycle are checked owner-model semantics.

weapons.gold_wool_v1: What's Desired adds its frozen Lakshana ratio to matching delivered packets in the additive damage-bonus zone. Successful Redirect Skill or Ultimate admission refreshes one nonstacking self CRIT damage modifier before same-time hits, with world-time duration and delivery-time buff sampling. Switching preserves the modifier; exact expiry precedes equal-time hits. Cast order and clocks are tested hypotheses. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.the_wrong_gate_healing_v1: The Wrong Gate's static ATK percentage applies to the wearer on every hit. An Edgar Ultimate or Iroi ordinary Skill healing callback triggers only when the living equipped wearer heals a living team actor and the once-rounded pre-cap amount is positive; a full-HP overheal qualifies. After settlement, one shared-name reset effect grants the wearer Anima (NATURE) DMG and every other living configured team actor general DMG for 20 world seconds. Repeated triggers refresh at callback time; source attribution is the latest trigger and buffs capture a snapshot that persists if its source later dies. Failed/dead-recipient callbacks and nonpositive rounded healing do not trigger. These trigger, recipient, clock, order, snapshot, and shared-name rules are tested hypotheses because the frozen descriptions do not specify them. Global release availability remains unverified.

weapons.twinbirds_v2: Crime and Punishment grants its wearer the frozen refinement Cycle Intensity as additive stat points while alive, including before the first cast and off field. Its permanent self-only cycle_intensity modifier adds with authored CI and other eligible live modifiers; Esper Cycle ownership and damage capture consume the resulting total. It never grants Cycle Energy and is not an ATK or damage percentage. The wearer's Psyche damage bonus and Ultimate-triggered fifteen-second shared team plus additional self critical-damage buffs retain the v1 rules, including refresh on retrigger. This supersedes v1's unapplied Cycle Intensity parameter. Trigger timing, recipients, source lifetime and stack/refresh rules are bounded modeled policies from the reviewed owner card; native dispatch and Global release availability remain unverified.

entries.label: Blackbird · Stain / Hathor
assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

blackbird.b2_stain_v1: A living Blackbird with breakthrough2 enhances newly applied Stain to20 World seconds and base multiplier1.3, replacing1.2 rather than multiplying it by1.1. Capture enhancement once per generation, retain it after field exit/source defeat, refresh without stacking, and use each eligible Psyche/Lakshana damage actor's live Cycle Intensity. No extra HP packet or resource grant is created.

blackbird.coordinated_bird_v1: Ordinary Skill re-arms one Blackbird bird controller per cast generation, clears marks/count, starts ready at cast time and enforces an inclusive2s interval between accepted requests, with five accepted requests maximum. Each positive surviving Skill recipient refreshes its own15s mark without resetting the controller. Positive HP damage by a different currently active living ally to a live marked dummy accepts once per causal packet, selecting the first/lowest live marked recipient. Blackbird own/off-field/zero-HP/Nova/bird damage cannot request coordination. Dispatch one full uncapped native SkillAssist AoE after the causal packet HP/resource/Break settlement, using invested Skill talent, zero inferred travel, ordinary live stats and per-target RNG, one Charge/Cycle/Break opportunity across recipients. An accepted count is not refunded on target death. Recast cancels uncommitted old-generation requests; field exit preserves marks/count, owner death disables new requests. A6 positively connected birds grant4 exact Malice once outside form through the separate resource model. Autonomous receipts retain both the original Skill command and real earlier triggering hit without inventing an authored cast. Requires ordinary Malice; does not establish transformed action/form lifetimes.

blackbird.evolve_actions_v1: Bind Blackbird evolved abilities during active transformation form: GA_BlackBird_Evolve_Melee (5 stages delivering 2, 5, 6, 1, 6 primary packets with native progress and hit-pause .0297s, Melee5 .015s), GA_BlackBird_Evolve_Skill (4 packets, 1s cooldown, requiring and consuming the 30s permission granted by Melee5 at progress .351288s, healing 4x base ATK with A2, multiplied by 2.5 with A1), and GA_BlackBird_Evolve_UltraSkill (finishing Burst delivering 7 packets, removing form at commit, multiplied by 1.5 with R3). Each connected primary hit consuming Malice spends up to its native threshold (Melee1..5: .541591, .369949, .349951, 2.258020, .784891; Skill: 3.25) and enqueues one separate category A Extra packet at hit+.067s (Melee5 hit+.100s) with coefficient k*spent (k+k3 with A3, k reading Normal talent level). With A1 finisher first hit spends all remaining Malice (max 60) for one extra; without A1 finisher preserves Malice with no extra. Requires primary form and exact Malice models.

blackbird.normal_chain_v1: Blackbird ordinary Normal advances five stages with multiplicities 1,2,4,5,5 from frozen neverness_blackbird descriptions and native DT_SkillDamageData coefficients. The chain loops after stage five and resets on a different admitted ability, field exit or a gap greater than 2 seconds between input starts. Reset rules, gap and ordered coincident delivery at the research primary impact time are tested hypotheses pending animation/cancel evidence. Evolve forms, Malice, travel, AoE, plunge, riposte and complete kit behavior remain unsupported.

blackbird.ordinary_clock_v1: Bind ordinary Blackbird Normal1..5 and four-hit Skill to their native montage progress coordinates, rounded once to nearest microsecond, at rate1. Positive applied HP from each causal primary packet adds one .03s owner hit-pause at .01 rate, shared across AoE recipients; zero HP loss adds none. The shared exact HitlagTracker projects only pending montage contacts and owner recovery, retaining real cooldowns, marks, birds, buffs and other actors. Simultaneous recipients retain their already emitted packet time. Normal continuity extends through its actual full recovery and2 World seconds afterward, with stage wrap/reset on other actions or field exit. Ordinary Skill has16s real cooldown, independent of hit-pause; generic caller clocks remain the historical boundary when this model is absent. This bounded clock does not certify Burst/form replacement, transformed/secondary actions or early cancel gates, which retain their separately tracked owner admission dependencies.

blackbird.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Blackbird character:1042 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Blackbird PSYCHE are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, enhanced/alternate forms, summons, Branch, AirAttack, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

blackbird.ordinary_malice_v1: Track ordinary Blackbird Malice as an exact nonnegative pool capped60, separate from Charge and Cycle. Living combat initialization grants20 once; no four-second in-combat refill. Ordinary Skill.2 grants40 once per admitted cast, even without a connected recipient. Ordinary positive-HP Normal packets grant exact native amounts .857919/1.762896/1.089593/.933937/1.317647 for stages1..5, once per causal packet across uncapped AoE recipients; a complete17-packet chain grants20.000003. Cap excess remains visible in a conserved exact ledger through waits and switches. This bounded resource binding does not certify transformed spending/extras, coordinated birds, ordinary secondary actions, QTE/parry or out-of-combat transitions, whose admission and lifetimes require their owner models; legacy packet-only fixtures retain their existing boundaries.

blackbird.primary_form_v1: Bind primary Blackbird Burst to the declared successful zero-delay mesh callback, native100 Ultimate cost and20s World cooldown. Capture the non-hybrid21.5s on-field World form lifetime at accepted commit; its9 primary contacts use native progress with .067s/.3 owner pauses and5.118154s recovery progress. Form time includes local hitstop while shared World progression is enabled, stops off field, resumes remaining time on entry and ends before equal-time ordinary admission; cooldowns, team buffs, reactions, bird requests and committed packets keep their declared clock policies. UltraSkill.3 at progress3.166927s applies the15s team base-ATK20% buff, replaced by A4's25s plus general damage12%; A6 independently grants own Psyche25% for25s. Already applied buffs persist source death. A2 adds20% base DEF only while the form lives, including its off-field pause; no phantom CritDamage is added. R3 commit grants20 exact Malice once, while ordinary gains including A6 birds are suppressed in form. Natural/death cleanup retains resources/cooldowns and committed packet identity. This bounded lifetime/primary binding requires all ordinary owner models; reached evolved inputs and qualified transformed Support explicitly diagnose until their own bindings are supplied. Finisher permissions, evolved attacks/extras and mesh callback failure/timeout are separate required owner work, never fabricated as ordinary attacks or successful failed callbacks.

blackbird.skill_burst_packets_v1: Blackbird Netherplume Rite delivers four Skill hits on target zero; Requies Animarum delivers nine UltraSkill hits. All children use the admitted effective native talent coordinate and sample live modifiers independently. Ordered coincident delivery at the selected primary impact timestamp is a timing hypothesis pending animation intervals; it does not model travel, AoE coverage, Evolve forms, Malice gauge or complete kit behavior.

blackbird.skill_cycle_fill_v1: An admitted ordinary Blackbird Skill executes its Skill.2 HeterochromeExecution once at activation, filling the owner's Cycle pool to100 before any damage even when all packets miss. Grant only the missing whole amount, independent of Cycle gain efficiency, preserve exact fractional carry and prior overflow/spend accounting, and keep Ultimate Energy unchanged. Connected Skill packets retain their independent HeterochromeAdd channels and cap overflow. Failed admission, other actions and field entry do not fill Cycle; evolved Skill is outside this binding.

combat.control_effects_v1: A content owner may request a finite control effect after a connected delivered hit. The anonymous dummy's authored control_immune flag defaults false and is independent of Boss classification, airborne inputs and damage magnitude. A living source can control a living nonimmune recipient; a defeated source/target or immune recipient produces no successful-control receipt or status. Positive exact hits that round to zero HP loss still reach after-hit control, distinct from positive-HP-loss consumers. Successful applications preserve source actor, actual target and parent command, record exact world-time duration/expiry and apply one target-scoped status. Control represents gameplay eligibility only, without movement, geometry or target AI. Source death does not erase an already applied finite target effect. Native immunity and after-hit ordering remain explicit scenario/owner hypotheses.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.stain_switch_v1: Extends combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1 to qualified Psyche/Lakshana switches: spend exactly one hundred outgoing Cycle and apply one twelve-second Stain status to living locked target zero. Reapplication replaces its expiry without stacking; its captured applier may leave the field or die without removing the status, while target death clears it. Each elemental Psyche/Lakshana packet against that target multiplies a separate Stain zone by (6/5)*(1+(1/5)*CI/(CI+180)), using the damage actor's live authored plus buff CI, independently of the pair winner. Generic damage/final bonuses and crit retain their own zones; Mental Nova, other elements and other targets receive no Stain factor. Stain creates no independent damage packet, crit draw, energy or Break grant. The modeled status supplies the existing HunXiang target tag for equipped predicates without certifying the native reaction getter. Duration, switch admission, live capture and the selected factor are reviewed bounded owner-model decisions; native dispatch and owner-specific Stain enhancements remain unresolved.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

damage.fixed_crit_rate_as_probability_v1: Interpret a nonzero native FixedCritRate scalar as the packet's replacement critical-hit probability. Preserve normal critical-damage calculation and only roll when the packet's damage kind is crit-eligible; this does not claim native stat-capture or periodic-tick timing semantics.

gear.cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Ultimate admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Weapon and set effects retain their own recipient, stacking and expiry policies. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis; native animation timing remains unresolved.

hathor.burst_emergency_v1: Hathor composes tap_power_v1 with canonical Burst spending100 at commitment and starting15s cooldown. Emergency applies at source1.499991s, before two collision hits2.483287/2.883287s and landing3.816348s; next ability is4.530561s. These integer coordinates bind the selected two-periodic-plus-landing model, not an extra immediate collision tick or measured game timing. Nonhybrid Emergency lasts8 World seconds from application, snapshots then-current accepted Power n as0.15*n base-ATK percent once, and exposes the same live ATK to damage and source-stat consumers. Spending/loss does not recompute that snapshot. Source field exit/death ends it immediately; reporting periods do not reset it. Positive generation requests during Emergency consume their actual Gaze generation but reject before the Power pool, record requested/accepted0 in trace, give no energy/A5 count and never defer. It uses the selected ratio as a self base-ATK percentage. Successful Skill admission refreshes one nonstacking effect before its delivered hits; switching preserves it until world-time expiry. Set count declares matching geometry; native parameter-caller and clock applicability remain hypotheses. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

sets.street_boxer_v2: Equipped Street Boxer four-piece adds the frozen baseline crit ratio once in its wearer's additive crit-rate zone. Any qualified team Esper Cycle producing Stain or Remora gives each living equipped wearer a self-only twenty-second nonstacking window, including off-field wearers who are neither pair participant nor reaction owner. Reapplication resets expiry; field exit preserves the world-clock deadline. The window's frozen Lakshana_4_2 crit ratio replaces Lakshana_4_1, never adds to it, and expiry restores the baseline. Both frozen ratios equal fourteen percent; the causal window and native parameter receipts remain explicit despite unchanged current damage. Other reactions and ordinary/unqualified swaps do not refresh it; nonwearers get no bonus. All team equipment effects are prepared atomically before publication. This supersedes v1's unconditional-only scope; native dispatch/capture and clock fidelity remain unverified.

weapons.bit_game_v1: Blow up the Crowd (Beat King) increases the active character's ATK while the wearer is off-field, and dealing damage while off-field grants the active character an additional stacking ATK bonus up to 4 stacks with a 2.0s ICD, resetting when the wearer becomes active. While the wearer is active, it increases Psyche DMG dealt, and dealing Psyche DMG with Basic Attacks grants an additional stacking Psyche DMG bonus up to 10 stacks with a 0.3s ICD, resetting on character switch. Off-field damage detection, 2.0s and 0.3s ICDs, active-actor recipients, and switch resets are tested hypotheses. Release availability at the cutoff is unverified.

weapons.gold_wool_chaos_realfinish_v1: For Chaos's accepted ordinary owner clock, What's Desired retains its native permanent Lakshana bonus and one self20s40/50/60/70/80% CRIT DMG window, but selects the recovered callback distinction: ordinary Skill grants on successful REALFINISH at projected full recovery, while Burst grants on Q_SKILL_BEGIN/accepted commit. This overrides only the default gold_wool_v1 Skill-admission trigger for that selected profile. Finish is anchored to the real admitted command and owner montage, projected through reached positive-hit and inherited pauses; cancellation, exit or defeat before completion removes it. A rejected or cancelled Skill grants no new window, without deleting an already granted window. Equal-time ordinary next inputs see a completed grant; preexisting ordinary immunity/resource/mark clocks are unchanged. Refresh is once under the same nonstacking key, not admission plus finish, and world expiry/field-exit persistence remain. Other owners and legacy caller-timed inputs retain their separately disclosed default trigger. Native callback distinction is selected source evidence; real-clock conversion and lifecycle are checked owner-model semantics.

weapons.gold_wool_v1: What's Desired adds its frozen Lakshana ratio to matching delivered packets in the additive damage-bonus zone. Successful Redirect Skill or Ultimate admission refreshes one nonstacking self CRIT damage modifier before same-time hits, with world-time duration and delivery-time buff sampling. Switching preserves the modifier; exact expiry precedes equal-time hits. Cast order and clocks are tested hypotheses. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.raging_flames_v1: Raging Flames adds its frozen Lakshana ratio to matching delivered packets in the additive damage-bonus zone. Successful wearer Ultimate admission refreshes a wearer-only 10-second window before same-time hits and clears Redirect Skill stacks; each admitted Redirect Skill during the active window adds one stack before same-time hits, capped at two, without extending the window. The base bonus applies to delivered native E/Q packets; per-cast stacks apply only to delivered native E packets. Input action role gates cast admission, while delivered packet category gates damage bonuses. Switching preserves the window and stacks; exact expiry precedes equal-time hits. Ultimate refresh clearing stacks is a tested lifecycle hypothesis because native buff lifecycle details are unavailable. Cast order and clocks are tested hypotheses. Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.

weapons.rishi_v2: Eclipse grants the wearer its frozen ATK percentage unconditionally, joining the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum. The ratio is not a final, special, or multiplicative factor. Arc: Eclipse: explicit Arc admission by the living active wearer outside recovery creates a 40s Eclipse field; each wearer-credited enemy defeat during the field restores flat frozen energy (6/7/8/9/10 per T1-T5) up to 5 defeats per field; re-creating the field waits a 300s arc cooldown. Arc activation uses the shared action admission and cooldown service, with no HP or energy cost and no added recovery under the bounded instantaneous field-creation model. Ultimate casts alone create no field. Wearer-kill credit (not team kills), field-window boundaries, charge scaling and instantaneous activation remain tested hypotheses. The energy grant flows through actor.grant_energy, so it scales by charge_multiplier (tested; native scaling unknown). Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog. A dead wearer cannot claim further field defeats or activate pending field/energy callbacks. A grant already reserved before death is skipped without changing energy, overflow or carry; its consumed defeat slot and admitted cooldown are not refunded. Living off-field wearers remain eligible. Delivery-time living eligibility is a bounded inference consistent with living-recipient team generation and absence of a revival rule, not native callback proof.

zero.a1_first_hit_v1: Zero A1 triggers on the first nonzero connected Skill hit per admitted activation and target, only when target level <= Zero level. Prefer the explicit Chinese not-above-level condition over the English lower-level translation; child packets cannot retrigger and retain the struck target.

zero.burst_a3_crit_rate_v1: Zero A3 Anomalies Record adds 0.50 to ordinary crit rate for each native Burst packet, in addition to static, live, and gear crit rate; normal packet eligibility and the shared 1.0 crit-rate clamp still apply. The native 1046AwakenEffect Effect3 text and DT_Female051EffectFigure Female051_LV3 support the value; additive stacking is the tested interpretation.

zero.burst_a4_damage_bonus_v1: Zero A4 Undecided Factors adds min(compiled base ATK × DT_Female051EffectFigure Female051_LV4_2, Female051_LV4_3) to the ordinary damage-bonus zone for native Burst packets. The 1046AwakenEffect Effect4 text and Female051_LV4_1/2/3 figures bind the formula; assignment to the additive damage-bonus zone is an explicit tested hypothesis.

zero.burst_all_in_range_v1: Zero Burst delivers its ordered seven-packet train to every eligible scenario-declared dummy under the all-in-range dummy contract: by scenario definition all eligible dummies are in range and inside attack areas, so no position, radius, shape, or placement check gates delivery. Targets are delivered in ascending target_index order; for each target, UltraSkill1, UltraSkill2 four times, UltraSkill3, then UltraSkill4 (target-major order), all at the admitted primary impact time. Defeated or otherwise ineligible dummies keep their existing skip rules. This is a declared scenario rule, not a claim about native AoE geometry; native recipient caps/selection/distribution and packet spacing remain unresolved.

zero.burst_packets_v1: Zero Burst delivers native UltraSkill1 once, UltraSkill2 four times, UltraSkill3 once, and UltraSkill4 once, in that order, matching DT_GameplayAbilityTipsData.GA_Female046_UltraSkill.GALevelUpArray[0] and each native DT_SkillDamageData row. All seven packets use the admitted primary impact time and target 0, the simulator's current default target. Native packet intervals remain unresolved.

zero.cosmos_cycle_atk_v1: Resonance 6 Zero grants each living party member, including Zero, 12% base-ATK-scaled ATK for 20 World seconds on a qualified Cosmos Cycle for which Zero pays the outgoing Cycle cost. The outgoing payer identifies the trigger independently of the higher-CI reaction damage owner. The same carrier refreshes without stacking and persists through field exit. The published trigger wording and frozen amount/duration inform this selected ownership and lifetime model.

zero.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Zero character:1046 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Zero COSMOS are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Burst, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

zero.skill_packets_v1: Zero ordinary Skill delivers Skill1, Skill2, Skill3, and Skill4 once each from one admitted cast, matching the four ordered ratios in frozen neverness_zero and native DT_SkillDamageData rows. The admitted Skill fills this owner's Cycle pool to its existing capacity of 100 once, including semantic Hotori replay, independently of damage recipient count, ordinary energy and hit-generated channels. Existing charge is retained without duplicate grant or overflow. Cast-time fill is the selected interpretation of the published instant-Cycle Skill; native callback timing remains unverified. Children use the admitted primary impact time; animation intervals and travel are unresolved.

entries.label: Shinku · Charge
assumptions: ability_index.primary_action_role_v1: Interpret DT_CharacterAbilityConfig.CharacterAbilityList[].Value.AbilityIndex values 1, 2, 3, and 4 as Normal, RedirectSkill, Ultimate, and Qte action roles. This is an explicit model mapping kept separate from AbilityGameplayTag and does not establish native timing, reachability, cost, or weapon trigger semantics.

combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1: A switch admitted between two living actors whose native elements form an adjacent DT_ReactionData pair qualifies for an Esper Cycle when the outgoing actor's declared Cycle pool holds at least 100: admission spends exactly 100 outgoing Cycle, retains the incoming pool, and creates the pair's reaction on the living locked target zero. Ownership snapshots the higher-Cycle-Intensity participant (static authored cycle_intensity plus live cycle_intensity buffs; ties select the outgoing actor), capturing owner level, CI, element and crit damage at admission. Blossom creates one party-capped (3, oldest replaced, replaced buds spend their pending emissions) bud that emits five pistils at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10s, each exploding once on every living target with base(level)*(1+CI/600)*live DEF factor*live NATURE resistance, no crit. Scorch applies a 15s target status (ntesim.status.scorch and Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.ZhouAn tags) ticking fifteen times at +0.99s multiples with base*(1+CI/600)*fixed-50 crit draw with captured crit damage*live DEF*live owner-element resistance; reapplication replaces the snapshot and refreshes expiry while retaining the existing tick phase; target death cancels remaining ticks. Nova applies a 5.1s target status (Ability.Player.Buff.Reaction.AnHun) and settles one Mental packet at +5.0s with base*(1+CI/600)*live generic resistance, bypassing DEF and crit; a qualified reapplication before the packet detonates the pending generation once immediately, and a fired generation never duplicates. Hexed, Stain and Remora pairs are recognized by the table but their follow-up effects remain unimplemented. Reaction damage never crits except Scorch's fixed draw, grants no energy/Cycle/Break, and settles through the ordinary HP/death path with receipts. Scenarios without a full outgoing Cycle pool, same-element or nonadjacent switches and dead locked targets stay ordinary. Switch-based admission, ownership capture, phase retention, refresh detonation, the declared Cycle input (no fabricated accrual) and the authored-CI input (no evidenced native attribute) are bounded model hypotheses from the reviewed cycle cards; native aura application/consumption, activation ICD and GetReactionResultType remain unresolved.

combat.live_break_damage_v1: Each new modeled Break generation snapshots one elemental HP-damage contribution per living deployed actor in slot order. Select the exact DT_GlobalCommonData.UnbaldamagePara key at character level 1..80. Damage is base*(1+live BI/300+eligible Break bonus)*(original capacity/3)*DEF*source-element RES*eligible special factors, with exact intermediates and one nearest-integer HP settlement per contribution. Static source BI, eligible live break_intensity/def_ignore buffs, Film - MANISH and Black Tome wearer BI, and the strongest eligible Danzaburou same-element roster aura add within their zones. Danzaburou requires three matching deployed slots and a living carrier; duplicate auras do not stack. Daffodil has intrinsic Break bonus .20 and selected A6 DEF ignore .15; reached unbound Insight A4/A5 and R6 dependencies diagnose. Contributions snapshot together after Broken admission, retain causal command/generation and individual owners, do not crit or consume RNG, ignore ordinary ATK/damage bonuses and grant no ordinary energy/Cycle/gauge/proc callbacks. Target defeat invokes shared defeat callbacks and cancels remaining group deliveries; accepted snapshots survive later source death/field changes. Source selection, living eligibility, capture and callback policy are a bounded content model, not native consumer or game-timing proof.

combat.packet_cycle_accrual_v1: An owner-bound native damage packet grants its exact frozen HeterochromeAdd once after positive actual target HP loss, independent of AoE recipient count. Only the living source owner receives Cycle, scaled by declared cycle_gain_efficiency (default 1), with integer cap 100, exact fractional carry and explicit integer overflow. Qualified switches spend 100 without resetting carry; grants and spends reconcile the owner ledger. No Ultimate team distribution, Charge Efficiency, reaction damage, execute, hit-count inference or unbound owner rows grant Cycle.

combat.relative_clock_policy_v1: Relative combat time is absolute elapsed microseconds minus the union of executed Ultimate cinematic and Hotori active Time Stop pauses. Retrieved pause components and owner montage end notifies inform bindings; an unavailable notify, including Zero, uses the consumed owner action-completion fallback. This is a selected bounded timer model, not recovered native countdown execution. Ordinary cooldowns, independent buffs/statuses, periodic phases, passive recovery and refund/recording windows use paused world time. Finite current-cast and permitted Hotori direct replay/Katana contexts progress; another non-exempt cinematic dominates. Object lifetime pauses in cinematics and advances in active Time Stop while ordinary autonomous production pauses; living Hotori B2 exempts Vita Bud attacks only from active Time Stop. Frozen Scorch phase and progressing deployed-object lifetime are disclosed conservative and lower-confidence choices. Charge grants no energy or deferred grants in active Time Stop. Local hitlag remains separate; waits, receipts, support rates and field-time use absolute time. Relative DPS is unavailable at zero relative duration, independently of combat completion.

combat.remora_charge_v1: Extends combat.esper_cycle_reactions_v1 to qualified Lakshana/Cosmos switches: spend one hundred outgoing Cycle and apply one refreshed nonstacking five-second Remora to living locked target zero. Its accepted duration survives field exit and source death; target death clears it. Stationary dummies have no movement or attack-slow DPS behavior. Each continuing Blossom pistil that hits at least one living target with active Remora grants ten Ultimate Energy once to the currently active living actor, through that recipient's Charge Efficiency, exact fractional carry and cap/overflow ledger. Multi-target hits do not multiply grants, and no qualifying target or defeated active recipient grants nothing. Charge does not consume Remora or the bud, create damage/critical draws, distribute to peers, or grant Cycle/Break. The fifth emission qualifies normally. Slow decay, owner-specific Remora extensions and native dispatch fidelity remain outside this bounded stationary-target model.

combat.unbal_value_as_target_gauge_v1: For a living target with an explicit break_profile, each positive-damage delivered packet with a positive frozen UnbalValue removes that exact value times the outgoing Break efficiency multiplier from the target gauge. The multiplier is the source-bound UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase (or explicit scenario value, default one) plus summed live break_efficiency bonuses at ReactionOrBreak settlement, honoring buff recipients, expiry and source lifetime; zero removes no gauge. For an explicitly selected target stat pack, multiply once more by its exact nonnegative UnbalAntiAccrueEfficiencyBase (including inherited row defaults); zero prevents gauge loss. Targets without a stat pack use one. This selects a direct incoming multiplier, not one minus resistance or the enemy outgoing UnbalAccrueEfficiencyBase; the native consumer mapping remains unproved. Reaching zero applies the content-owned ntesim.status.broken tag for the profile duration, then restores gauge to capacity. Rose may extend this modeled Broken deadline only through its separate weapons.rose_break_extension_v1 hypothesis. This is an explicit scenario hypothesis: no target profile means no gauge model; no native efficiency consumer, enemy profile, break damage, BI settlement, or native recovery rule is inferred.

gear.cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Ultimate admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Weapon and set effects retain their own recipient, stacking and expiry policies. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis; native animation timing remains unresolved.

gear.skill_cast_buff_before_hits_v1: Successful Skill admission activates equipped cast-triggered ATK buffs after costs and before same-time delivered hits. Source-owned recipient, stacking and expiry rules still apply. This cast-to-hit order is a tested timing hypothesis.

hathor.b2_remora_v1: A qualifying real Cosmos/Lakshana Remora generation captures living party Hathor breakthrough2 Delay Warning: duration12 World seconds instead of5 and target-conditioned allied CR+.10. Reapplication resets one shared target status and chooses the then-living source policy; no duplicate stack or explosion. The captured generation survives Hathor exit/defeat, while a later generation cannot acquire a dead source's enhancement. Only living ordinary damage actors against that specific enhanced target receive the bonus, live before ordinary CR clamping; native fixed-critical/no-critical overrides keep precedence. Charge uses the same half-open extended status lifetime. No unconditional team crit, per-hit energy, orphan native explosion row or additional reaction damage is inferred. These are selected description/lifecycle semantics pending native consumer-body recovery.

hathor.burst_emergency_v1: Hathor composes tap_power_v1 with canonical Burst spending100 at commitment and starting15s cooldown. Emergency applies at source1.499991s, before two collision hits2.483287/2.883287s and landing3.816348s; next ability is4.530561s. These integer coordinates bind the selected two-periodic-plus-landing model, not an extra immediate collision tick or measured game timing. Nonhybrid Emergency lasts8 World seconds from application, snapshots then-current accepted Power n as0.15*n base-ATK percent once, and exposes the same live ATK to damage and source-stat consumers. Spending/loss does not recompute that snapshot. Source field exit/death ends it immediately; reporting periods do not reset it. Positive generation requests during Emergency consume their actual Gaze generation but reject before the Power pool, record requested/accepted0 in trace, give no energy/A5 count and never defer. Selected A3 adds0.15 per living explicitly non-Boss dummy, evaluated live; selected A6 gives0.30 additional CRIT damage and R6 gives0.10 DEF ignore only while Emergency is live. Ordinary cooldowns and Gaze/gear/world timers continue. This prerequisite binds Burst/ordinary passives; Cyclone admission/spending/ATK-only retention and secondary/combat controls remain separate full-kit requirements. Skill input during live Emergency diagnoses its unsupported Cyclone replacement.

hathor.cyclone_v1: Hathor composes burst_emergency_v1 with admitted finite Cyclone stages costing1/2/3 actual Power without refund. Canonical Skill input during Emergency replaces ordinary Tap/hold, bypasses its continuing hidden cooldown and restores that original deadline at state end before equal-time admission. Six Power funds seven Skill5, three Skill6/7/8 and two Skill9/10 contacts; native GA_Hathor_Skill2 child rows retain ordinary purchased Skill talent plus resonance. Source coordinates round to integer microseconds and actual connected owner pause projects damage, success markers, combo windows and recovery on the real clock. Stage1/2 transitions select60fps notify-start offsets1.116684/1.433341s inside their authored windows, and never skip a stage or implicitly wait. A4 snapshots prior successful-stage count k as0.25*k CR for that stage only, with source counter cap10; positive damage plus Skill.1 marker1.066650/1.366748s increments once, stage3 increments at successful completion. Interruption before success or zero damage never increments. An admitted stage grants100 percent own base DEF through the shared live-DEF consumer until real finish/interruption/field exit/death. Emergency expiry immediately removes A4/A6/R6 and further admission; only captured ATK may remain through an already admitted Cyclone until its finish or2s safety deadline, whichever is earlier. Spending to zero does not erase already admitted stage effects or recompute ATK. World cooldowns/marks/gear/RNG continue. This checked causal model is not measured native timing; secondary and combat controls remain separate full-kit requirements.

hathor.gaze_v1: Hathor's intrinsic ordinary Gaze uses explicit anonymous stationary-dummy proximity and attack-start assumptions, without enemy identities, skill catalogs or AI. Default proximity is true. Five uninterrupted unmarked seconds apply one nonrefreshing five-second generation independently per living dummy, including while Hathor is off field. Expiry or consumption starts a fresh five-second unmarked interval; explicit proximity changes reset accumulation, while an existing mark retains its original expiry. An authored AttackStart is a qualifying skill-begin directed at the named living party member, independent of whether any later damage lands; it consumes one generation and requests1 Power exactly once. Normal expiry requests1 only with selected A2. Consumption, target/source death and proximity changes do not count as natural completion; dead sources cannot rearm. Expiry precedes an equal-time attack start, and proximity changes precede accumulation completion. This composes tap_power_v1 and its accepted-delta cap/energy/A5 ledger. Enhanced Five-Star Tracking and incoming-contact provenance remain separate held-Skill requirements. Each meaningful deadline is scheduled once, bounded by the authored horizon; no readiness polling or damage is synthesized.

hathor.held_skill_v1: Hathor composes tap_power_v1 and gaze_v1 with stationary unreserved Skill holds: below0.22s takes ordinary tap; otherwise total hold caps at5s, actor birth is0.686667s and real ticks begin0.936667s every0.25s strictly before release. Full hold emits17 Power ticks and its ten-contact PowerEnd, while release at or below1s takes three-contact ShortEnd and requests tap2 once. Each End packet preserves its source coefficients, talent, resources and connected owner pause. Held cooldown starts16s at0.236652s if reached before release, otherwise at the ShortEnd0.016368s marker; pre-marker interruption starts3s and later cancellation retains the actual deadline. First actual held birth with selected A1 requests6 and consumes its once-per-battle marker even at cap; field exit/death/reporting periods do not reset it. Every actual timer tick applies one five-second nonrefreshing enhanced Gaze per eligible living all-in-range dummy, regardless of rounded HP damage, replacing ordinary Gaze without a completion award. Attack-start or explicitly dummy-attributed positive incoming HP/shield contact consumes one enhanced generation for3 requested Power, deduplicated by removal before callback; A2 alone pays3 on natural expiry. Release/interrupt/field exit/death cancels unissued actor ticks and End requests. The separate empty0.5s actor-table row emits no damage. All source coordinates round to integer microseconds; this is a selected causal model, not measured native timing. Burst/Emergency/Cyclone, remaining passive/secondary actions and combat leave/reentry remain separate full-kit requirements.

hathor.hybrid_emergency_v1: With burst_emergency_v1, select the checked hybrid interpretation: Emergency still applies at the actual state event, but its5s admission timer starts at initial Burst recovery rather than consuming that animation's remaining time. An explicit interruption after state application ends the initial animation immediately and resumes5s from that interruption; field exit/death ends state outright. Only this owner's Emergency timer is suspended: ordinary cooldowns, hits, marks and the real DPS clock continue. This is an explicit source-mode hypothesis, not a global Time Stop or measured native hybrid scheduler.

hathor.ordinary_clock_v1: Hathor's canonical zero-cost Normal follows the selected five-stage1/5/2/3/2 contact train and source next-ability coordinates rounded once to microseconds per input. All eligible stationary dummies receive full coefficients; energy, Cycle and pause occur once per connected causal packet, regardless of recipient count. Source pause onset16.666ms is separate for Melee1/2/3; their reached zero-rate intervals and other flat intervals retain native duration. Melee5_1 integrates the selected linear rate knots over133.333ms with constant endpoints, quantized to whole microseconds/integer PPM. Melee4_2's negligible native rate rounds to0 PPM; no geometry/global Time Stop is invented. Contacts, recovery and later contacts advance on this owner clock; world time, cooldowns and resource carry continue normally. Exactly queued recovery advances the chain, while explicit idle, another admitted input, interruption or field exit resets it and cancels unissued contacts. A miss causes no pause or resource award. This prerequisite binds Normal only; held/Branch/plunge/Skill/Burst and secondary state bindings remain separate requirements, and source montage coordinates are not measured game timing.

hathor.ordinary_hit_energy_v1: For Hathor character:1025 only, an ordinary Normal or Skill native packet grants its exact nonnegative DT_SkillDamageData.ChargeAdd once after positive actual HP loss against target zero. Fatal damage qualifies; zero HP loss, unavailable targets and cancelled packets do not. The living source owner receives 1x; each other living configured recipient receives the explicit source-element to recipient-element coefficient from frozen DT_SkillTeamChargeRelationData (the six recipient-element rows for Hathor LAKSHANA are 0.6). Each recipient applies their own Charge Efficiency and exact fractional carry, then existing capacity and overflow accounting. Delivery-time owner and source attribution survive switching. Direct Branch/AirAttack inputs are excluded from this ordinary policy and use hathor.branch_airattack_direct_packet_energy_v1; natural dispatch, Burst, enhanced/alternate forms, summons, QTE, non-native branches, additional targets and callbacks outside the modeled packet train remain unsupported. Eligibility, cadence, recipient and off-field rules are tested hypotheses because native caller evidence is unavailable; ChargeAdd and relation coefficients are frozen native rows.

hathor.secondary_actions_v1: Hathor composes combat_lifecycle_v1 and cyclone_v1 with explicit paid grounded Dodge/Jump controls, one ready Critical Riposte response and engine-qualified Support or ordinary entry. Dodge spends shared15 stamina with0.9s cooldown; front/back any recovery is0.996277/1.009564s, Skill gates0.267501/0.331208s and Jump0.082544/0s. Only an authored successful Critical Dodge or explicit living-active parry inside that paid window arms one response. Riposte preserves two native Z packets at0.341403/0.649874s, recovery1.183548s, Skill/Jump cancel0; its first positive contact requests1 Power through a five-second nonrefreshing reward gate once across all recipients/contacts. The gate begins on the real request, including cap/Emergency rejection, retains its world deadline through field exit and clears at battle exit. Reward settlement follows the causal AoE packet, so A5 cannot boost later recipients of the same contact. New battle identity rejects old deferred rewards. Field exit/death removes response/on-field effects without resetting A1/A5 or the continuing world clock. QTE keeps its own native role and does not receive R3 Normal/Skill/Burst talent uplift. This is a checked stationary causal model, not measured timings; Branch/airborne descent and full owner acceptance remain separate.

hathor.tap_power_v1: Hathor composes the selected Normal clock with canonical unheld Skill, exact continuing Power0..6 and accepted-delta rewards. Tap requests2 Power once at0.283333s, starts16s cooldown at0.300073s and emits Skill1 at0.516245/0.699503 plus Skill11 at0.916369 on the source action clock. Connected Skill1/11 integrate their selected linear rate curve over0.033333/0.083333s, once per packet rather than per recipient.
